title: HR Specialist, PXT Programs, One Medical PXT
descriptionHtml:
The One Medical (OM) PXT team seeks an exceptional HR Specialist to establish program management excellence and drive strategic HR initiatives. This role will focus on leading policy projects, supporting TM and L&D programs, and help drive integration work between Amazon and One Medical.

What Success Looks Like:
You'll influence diverse leaders while anticipating risks and planning proactively. Working closely with the OM PXT leadership team, you'll own and execute strategic priorities that strengthen our HR foundation. As you gain deep knowledge of Amazon Primary Care and Healthcare Services, you'll leverage your HR expertise to deliver transformative outcomes.

What We're Looking For:
The ideal candidate brings a proven track record of leading large-scale programs with a strong programmatic or product mindset. You're a hands-on builder who drives organizational change at enterprise scale. You thrive in ambiguity, connect details to the bigger picture, and maintain flexibility while diving deep when needed.

Key job responsibilities
Implement and help build new PMO frameworks, tools, and processes to drive accountability and visibility across PXT initiatives

Lead the evolution and optimization of HR policies in partnership with Legal and HRBPs to align with Amazon standards and support business objectives

Partner with PXT and business leaders across Clinical Care Delivery and Clinical Operations to gather requirements and prioritize integration initiatives

Structure, organize, and deliver complex project plans with multiple dependencies and stakeholders

A day in the life
Your morning starts with a project status review, updating dashboards that track progress across the PXT portfolio. You identify a project at risk and quickly schedule a working session with stakeholders to remove blockers.

Mid-morning, you facilitate a policy review session with Legal and HRBPs, walking through proposed updates to ensure alignment with Amazon standards while addressing One Medical's unique clinical environment. You document decisions, assign action items, and update the project timeline.

After lunch, you meet with Clinical Operations leaders to gather requirements for an upcoming initiative. You ask probing questions to understand their needs, identify dependencies, and assess impact across employee populations.

Your afternoon includes refining project plans, updating risk registers, and preparing materials for next week's leadership review. You also coach a project owner on effective stakeholder communication and help them structure their approach to a complex deliverable.

You end the day reviewing incoming requests, prioritizing them against strategic objectives, and planning tomorrow's critical path activities.

About the team
You will be joining the OM PXT Business Operations (BizOps) team. Functions of the team include business operations including the rhythm of business for OM PXT, data management and reporting, systems integration, and PM support or PMO function.

Basic qualifications

- Bachelor's degree or equivalent in Business, Program Management, Human Resources, Employment Law, Computer Science, Finance, Computer Information Systems, Engineering, Operations Research or a related field
- 5+ years of HR, talent acquisition, management consulting, or project/program management experience

Preferred qualifications

- Experience in making data driven business decisions

title: Spacecraft Design CAD, Mech Engineer, Configuration Management
descriptionHtml:
Amazon Leo is Amazon's low Earth orbit satellite network. Our mission is to deliver fast, reliable internet connectivity to customers beyond the reach of existing networks. From individual households to schools, hospitals, businesses, and government agencies, Amazon Leo will serve people and organizations operating in locations without reliable connectivity.

We’re working on the future. If you are seeking an iterative, fast-paced environment where you can drive innovation, apply state-of-the-art technologies to solve real-world challenges, and provide visible benefit to end-users, this is your opportunity.

We’re looking for a Mechanical Design Engineer who combines superb 3D CAD capabilities with a demonstrated ability to get the right work done quickly and effectively. This person must have experience working in a multidisciplinary environment and producing top-notch CAD designs for spacecraft-class hardware. This person must be comfortable working with large databases with complex constraints—managing the full lifecycle of mechanical design data from concept through production release within Siemens NX and Teamcenter.

You will be embedded within a team of engineers driving the mechanical design of satellite systems—translating engineering intent into production-ready CAD models, drawings, and BOMs that flow cleanly through our product lifecycle management infrastructure. Your work directly enables the velocity of satellite development and production.

Export Control Requirement: Due to applicable export control laws and regulations, candidates must be a U.S. citizen or national, U.S. permanent resident (i.e., current Green Card holder), or lawfully admitted into the U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum.

Key job responsibilities
• CAD Design Creation & Management: Create, iterate, and manage CAD designs for large spacecraft system databases; maintain model integrity across complex assemblies with hundreds of interdependent components
• Drawing Production & Release: Manage the creation, checking, issuing, and revision of engineering drawings for parts and assemblies—ensuring compliance with Leo drawing standards and GD&T best practices
• BOM Lifecycle Management: Manage CAD BOM through the product lifecycle management system (Teamcenter); ensure BOM accuracy from design through release to manufacturing
• Multidisciplinary Collaboration: Work with a team of engineers across multiple disciplines—mechanical, thermal, electrical, structural, manufacturing, metrology, tooling, assembly, and test—in the ideation and creation of system concepts
• Supplier & Vendor Interface: Engage with suppliers and vendors as needed for CAD definition of sourced components and systems; develop procurement-ready technical data packages
• Manufacturing Source Review: Work with procurement and sourcing in identification and review of manufacturing sources; ensure designs are optimized for producibility
• Configuration Control: Support change management workflows, revision control, and design data integrity within the PLM ecosystem
• Database Organization: Maintain CAD database organization, naming conventions, and file management standards to enable team-wide efficiency at scale

Basic qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in Mechanical or Electrical Engineering, or 1+ years of electrical or mechanical engineering experience
- 3+ years of CAD experience in complex mechanical/electro-mechanical assemblies, machines, structures, or systems
- 1+ years of experience in the creation, manipulation, iteration, and optimization of mechanical designs with complex interactions and constraints
- 1+ years of experience interfacing with a range of engineering disciplines, and understanding the scope of those inputs and requirements

Preferred qualifications

- Expert-level capability with Siemens NX (4+ years of experience in advanced CAD assemblies)
- Manufacturing and test knowledge (forming, machining, finishing, tooling, assembly, testing)
- Awareness of adhesives, finishes, material properties, and selection criteria that influence selection for harsh environments (space-grade thermal cycling, radiation, vacuum)
- Experience optimizing design features for part cost (material handling, manufacturing, finishing, measurement)
- Hands-on experience with manufacturers, machinists, and part producers
- Experience developing fabrication drawings for a range of manufacturing methods (rapid prototyping, machining, forming, composite manufacturing)
- Experienced in CAD database management, CAD Bill of Materials management, and Product Life Cycle Management (PLM) using Teamcenter
- Experience with change control and management through ERP/MRP systems to manufacturing/assembly personnel
- Hands-on support in prototyping, assembly, and test
- Excellent CAD database organization and management skills
- Organized, with demonstrable ability to set priorities and meet deadlines in a fast-paced satellite development environment

title: Transportation Specialist, Amazon Intermodal (AZIM)
descriptionHtml:
Amazon’s Intermodal (AZIM) Operations team is seeking highly skilled and motivated Transportation Specialists to join this rapidly growing team. AZIM Operations drives the end to end operational execution of all loads (internal and external) shipped on our 1P network. The team supports regions and shippers across the Supply Chain network and is tasked with ensuring on-time pickup and delivery of freight from vendors, Amazon fulfillment centers (FCs), rail yards and shipper hubs. In the case of disruptions, the Operations team is responsible for addressing the disruption, keeping all stakeholders informed and ensuring timely resolution of the issue. The AZIM Operations team is the first line of defense in understanding network trends, delays, dwells and other exceptions that impact AZIM’s ability to deliver a world class transportation product that serves its customers on time.

Key job responsibilities
- Communication with customers (Carriers, Rail Road partners, Vendors/Suppliers) and stakeholders (Program Managers, Fulfillment Centers, Amazon Managed carrier programs).
- Pull data from numerous databases (using Excel, SQL and/or other data management systems) and to perform ad hoc reporting and analysis as needed.
- Understand performance metrics to assist with driving business results.
- Rectify disruptions, breaks in process and follow standard work to make decisions that make sense based on available data.
- Provide real-time customer experience by working in a fast paced operating environment.
- Knowledge to systematically escalate problems or variance in the information and data to the relevant owners and teams.
- Deliver follow through on the resolutions to ensure the information is delivered.
- Work within various time constraints to meet critical business needs, while measuring and identifying activities performed.
- Communication, both verbal and written as their data and findings are critical to tracking trends and performance inefficiencies.
- Identifying possible disruptions in a route and fixing/rerouting it in a timely manner.
- Deliver positive carrier and driver experience/solutions, in a contact center environment, through researching, problem-solving, setting appropriate expectations and working within the Amazon Transportation network to get trailers/trucks back on track when disruptions occur.


A day in the life
The AZIM Transportation Operations Specialist facilitates the continued flow of Amazon’s supply chain by passing information to key stakeholders and resolving disruptions that impact customer experience or the flow of information impacting performance and delivery. The Specialist checks on a list of shipments and makes sure everything is as it should be, then optimizes the driver’s intermodal portions of the trip as much as possible while providing any necessary information to avoid disruptions. Will be required to make real-time decisions to resolve issues and cancelations. Will also be apart of new and inventive programs designed to bridge a gap or improve overall business. The Specialist addresses or escalates any concerns arising during the lifecycle of freight leaving rail ramps, shipper hubs, Amazon fulfillment centers, or transiting between rail to OTR carriers. The day-to day role requires the specialist to provide resolutions by researching and querying internal tools and making real-time decisions in accordance with their guidance and standard work processes. In this role, the Transportation Operations Specialist will be able to understand the process and requirements/be able to analyze data and notice trends and be able to drive Customer Experience without compromising on time. This position will need to have the experience to understand Logistics and should be able to communicate clearly in the written and oral form.

Basic qualifications

- 1+ years of working with computers and Microsoft Office (including Outlook, Word, and Excel) experience
- High school or equivalent diploma
- Speak, write, and read fluently in English
- Can lift up to 49 pounds, stand/walk during shifts lasting up to 12 hours, and be able to frequently push, pull, squat, bend, and reach
- Work 40 hours/week, and overtime as required
- Work a flexible schedule/shift/work area, including weekends, nights, and/or holidays
- Are 18 years of age or older

Preferred qualifications

- Experience in a logistics/operations environment

title: Spacecraft Hardware Development Specialist, Amazon Leo DevOps
descriptionHtml:
Amazon Leo is Amazon's low Earth orbit satellite network. Our mission is to deliver fast, reliable internet connectivity to customers beyond the reach of existing networks. From individual households to schools, hospitals, businesses, and government agencies, Amazon Leo will serve people and organizations operating in locations without reliable connectivity.

This role is for a highly dynamic and motivated individual that will work on development hardware to meet the needs of Amazon Leo. We are looking for an individual who works well with engineering teams under minimal oversight to take hardware from concept to production. You'll partner directly with design engineers to iterate hardware quickly and qualify it for space, following that hardware through the full arc of development — initial prototyping, development builds, testing, and rigorous qualification testing. You'll also help shape the lab spaces themselves, adapting layout and equipment as designs change to keep labs clean, well-organized, and set up to serve their engineering customers. This will be an R&D focused position, and the work covers the full range of hardware development lab support — assembly, troubleshooting, testing, equipment upkeep, and documentation — so expect the day-to-day to shift as project needs change.

Export Control Requirement: Due to applicable export control laws and regulations, candidates must be a U.S. citizen or national, U.S. permanent resident (i.e., current Green Card holder), or lawfully admitted into the U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum.

Key job responsibilities
- Able to work with minimal guidance and instruction
- Partner directly with design engineers to iterate hardware quickly, optimize manufacturability, and qualify hardware for space
- Support hardware through the full development arc — initial prototyping, development builds, testing, and rigorous qualification testing
- Mechanical and electrical assembly of various spacecraft mechanisms
- Troubleshoot hardware and test setup issues, working through problems to root cause
- Engineer and adapt lab spaces and equipment to meet evolving customer needs, keeping labs clean, organized, and functioning well for their intended purpose, including tracking equipment calibrations
- Develop custom automation equipment to support test and build needs
- Maintain clear work documentation, including build notes and test records
- Accurately estimate time required to complete tasks, and meet deadlines as assigned
- Participate constructively and take ownership in the success of interdisciplinary projects
- Familiarity with aerospace/space quality standards for mechanical and electrical components

About the team
The Amazon Leo Development Operations (DevOps) team builds and maintains the labs and hardware infrastructure that let engineering teams design, prototype, and test satellite hardware quickly. We support projects from first prototype through qualification testing, and our team members cross-train across assembly, test, and lab equipment so we can flex to wherever the work is needed. Priorities shift fast as designs evolve, and you'll often move between projects to keep pace with what engineering teams need next. We take pride in keeping our labs and equipment in excellent shape, and we hold ourselves to a high standard because the hardware we build and test directly impacts what makes it to space.

Basic qualifications

- Knowledge of tools and measurement devices (oscilloscope, frequency analyzer, or equivalent)
- Can lift up to 49 pounds, stand/walk during shifts lasting up to 12 hours, and be able to frequently push, pull, squat, bend, and reach
- Associate's degree or equivalent relevant experience in Electronics, Mechanics, -Product Design, Manufacturing Technologies, or other STEM discipline
- 4+ years in a Space/Aerospace/Military/Precision fabrication/Test environment
- 1+ year experience working with precision mechanical and electrical fabrication/testing
- Must be able to climb a ladder and work at heights above 6 feet

Preferred qualifications

- 6+ years in a Space/Aerospace/Military/Precision fabrication/Test environment
- Experience in a R&D/development/Test role highly desirable
- Experience supporting hardware qualification testing (vibration, thermal vacuum, shock, etc.)
- Familiarity with basic machining operations (manual mill, lathe, etc.)
- Experience designing or building custom test fixtures and tooling
- Familiarity with hardware testing procedures and instrumentation setups (data acquisition, strain gauges, load cells, etc.)
- Experience reading and interpreting engineering drawings, schematics, and GD&T
- Experience organizing or maintaining a lab or shop space, including equipment calibration tracking
- Exposure to production equipment and processes
- A&P certificate, IPC 620, 610 or J-STD

title: Principal Business Development Tech, APAC, Prime Video Ads
descriptionHtml:
Amazon Publisher Monetization（APM）は、Amazonが運営するストリーミングサービス（Prime Videoを含む）において、ブランドがオーディエンスにリーチするための広告ソリューションを開発・提供する組織です。Prime Video Adsは、映画・ドラマシリーズ・ライブスポーツ・オリジナル作品といったプレミアムかつブランドセーフなストリーミングTV広告枠を提供し、全世界で数億人の月間視聴者にリーチしています。広告事業が国内外で急速に拡大する中、アジア太平洋地域におけるストリーミングTV広告の未来を描く戦略リーダーチームの構築を進めています。

本ポジションでは、APAC地域（日本、オーストラリア/ニュージーランド、インド）におけるPrime Video Adsの広告事業成長戦略を一気通貫で担うPrincipalレベルのBusiness Development - Technologyリーダーを募集します。APAC地域の広告需要に対する戦略的ゼネラルマネージャーとして、新規広告主セグメント・新規市場への拡大を推進しながら、Prime Videoの収益成長を牽引します。新規ビジネス機会の発掘、既存広告チャネルのスケール拡大、複数年にわたる戦略策定の推進、そしてSales、Product、Finance、Marketingの各チームと連携したプロダクト戦略・プライシング・Go-to-Market戦略への提言が主な責務です。

Principalレベルのリーダーとして、APACの広告ポートフォリオ全体の戦略方針を策定し、ストリーミングTV広告市場のホワイトスペースや新興トレンドを特定し、シニアリーダーシップに対して投資フレームワークや長期的な需要戦略を提言していただきます。エグゼクティブレベルでのエージェンシー・ブランドとの折衝、プロダクトの商業化に関する議論、社内ビジネスレビューのいずれにおいても同等のレベルで活躍し、広告主の需要シグナルとAmazonの広告プロダクトエコシステムを繋ぐハブとして機能していただきます。

求める人材像としては、広告戦略、プロダクト商業化、クライアントリレーションシップマネジメントの交差領域に深い専門性を持つビジネスデベロップメントリーダーです。広告、メディア、またはストリーミング業界での10年以上の実務経験を有し、うちアジア太平洋地域での実績が相当程度あることを期待します。大規模な収益目標のオーナーシップを持ち、定量的なビジネス成果を創出してきた実績に加え、エージェンシーホールディングカンパニー、ブランド広告主、社内クロスファンクショナルチームなど、複雑なマルチステークホルダー環境を推進してきた経験を求めます。

Amazon Publisher Monetization (APM) is responsible for developing and delivering advertising solutions that enable brands to reach audiences across Amazon's owned and operated streaming properties, including Prime Video. Prime Video Ads offers premium, brand-safe streaming TV inventory across movies, series, live sports, and originals, reaching hundreds of millions of monthly viewers globally. As our advertising business continues to scale rapidly in new and existing international markets, we are building a team of strategic leaders who will shape the future of streaming TV advertising in the Asia-Pacific region.

We are seeking a Principal Business Development - Technology leader to own the end-to-end advertising growth strategy for Prime Video Ads across APAC (Japan, Australia/New Zealand, and India). This individual will serve as the strategic general manager for the region's advertising demand, leading expansion into new advertiser segments and markets while driving revenue growth for Prime Video. They will be responsible for identifying new business opportunities, scaling existing advertiser channels, leading multi-year strategic planning efforts, and influencing product, pricing, and go-to-market strategies in collaboration with Sales, Product, Finance, and Marketing teams.

As a principal-level leader, you will set the strategic direction for APAC's advertising portfolio, identify whitespace opportunities and emerging trends in the streaming TV advertising market, and influence senior leadership on investment frameworks and long-term demand strategy. You will operate with equal fluency across executive-level agency and brand engagements, product commercialization discussions, and internal business reviews, serving as the connective tissue between advertiser demand signals and Amazon's advertising product ecosystem.

The ideal candidate is a seasoned business development leader with deep expertise at the intersection of advertising strategy, product commercialization, and client relationship management. They bring 10+ years of progressive experience in advertising, media, or streaming, with significant time spent in markets across the Asia-Pacific region. They have a demonstrated track record of owning revenue outcomes at scale, driving measurable business results, and navigating complex multi-stakeholder environments involving agency holding companies, brand advertisers, and cross-functional internal teams.

Key job responsibilities
- 日本、オーストラリア/ニュージーランド、インドにおけるPrime Video Adsの需要戦略を、2〜3年の計画視野で一気通貫でオーナーシップを持つ
- Sales、Product、Finance、Engineeringの各チームのステークホルダーと緊密に連携しながら、広告主の需要創出、プロダクト導入促進、収益の多角化に焦点を当てたビジネスプランを策定・実行する
- 新たな業種や顧客セグメントへの広告主基盤の拡大戦略を特定・実行し、ポートフォリオの集中リスクを低減しながら、持続可能な長期収益基盤を構築する
- 市場セグメンテーション、広告主インサイト、競合インテリジェンスに基づきビジネスゴールを定義し、導入状況をトラッキングしセールスの実行を最適化するための仕組みを構築する
- 新たな広告プロダクトの商業化をリードし、ProductチームおよびSalesチームと連携してプライシング、パッケージング、Go-to-Market戦略を策定する
- APAC地域全体において、エージェンシーホールディングカンパニーやブランド広告主とのエグゼクティブレベルのリレーションシップを構築・維持し、戦略プランニングの場においてPrime Video Adsのサブジェクトマターエキスパートとしての役割を担う
- 広告主からのフィードバック、競合動向、業界トレンドなどのシグナルを統合・分析し、Productロードマップの優先順位付けに反映するとともに、組織の投資判断に影響を与える
- Sales、Marketing、Product、Programの各チームと連携し、広告主のニーズへの対応、プロダクトの改善、成長を阻害する商業的・オペレーショナルな障壁の解消をクロスファンクショナルにリードする
- ビジネスレビュー、戦略プランニング資料、複数年フォーキャスト、セグメント別ディープダイブを作成し、シニアリーダーシップにプレゼンテーションを行う
- 広告主の獲得・維持、マルチプロダクト導入、収益の質を向上させるための主要ビジネスメトリクスを定義・分析する
- APAC地域の主要な業界イベントや戦略的な広告主エンゲージメントにおいて、Prime Video Adsを代表する


- Own end-to-end demand strategy for Prime Video Ads across Japan, Australia/New Zealand, and India, with a 2 to 3 year planning horizon
- Develop and execute business plans focused on advertiser demand generation, product adoption, and revenue diversification, working closely with stakeholders across Sales, Product, Finance, and Engineering teams
- Identify and implement strategies to expand the advertiser base into new verticals and customer segments, reducing portfolio concentration and building sustainable long-term revenue streams
- Define business goals based on market segmentation, advertiser insights, and competitive intelligence, then establish mechanisms to track adoption and optimize sales execution
- Lead product commercialization for new advertising capabilities, including defining pricing, packaging, and go-to-market strategies in partnership with Product and Sales teams
- Build and maintain executive-level relationships with agency holding companies and brand advertisers across the region, serving as the Prime Video Ads subject matter expert in strategic planning conversations
- Synthesize signals across advertiser feedback, competitive dynamics, and industry trends to inform Product roadmap priorities and influence organizational investment decisions
- Lead cross-functional collaboration to address advertiser needs, refine product offerings, and resolve commercial or operational barriers to growth in partnership with Sales, Marketing, Product, and Program teams
- Prepare and present business reviews, strategic planning documents, multi-year forecasts, and segment deep dives to senior leadership
- Define and analyze key business metrics to drive advertiser acquisition, retention, multi-product adoption, and revenue quality
- Represent Prime Video Ads at key industry events and in strategic advertiser engagements across the region

A day in the life
このポジションでは、APAC地域におけるPrime Video Adsの複数年にわたる成長戦略の策定と実行に注力します。日常業務としては、地域のビジネスヘルスメトリクスをレビューして差異や新たなトレンドを特定すること、エージェンシーやブランドのリーダーとの戦略的な対話を通じて市場ニーズを把握すること、そしてSalesチームやProductチームとクロスファンクショナルに連携して広告主の成長を阻害する障壁を解消することが含まれます。広告主のセグメンテーションデータや競合動向の分析に時間を費やし、その後、戦略的な提言、ロードマップの優先順位、収益パフォーマンスを伝えるリーダーシップレビュー向けの資料作成に取り組みます。新たな広告プロダクトの商業化をリードし、ProductチームやFinanceチームと連携してプライシングやパッケージング戦略を策定します。また、シニアセールスリーダーシップと直接連携し、地域の優先事項のアラインメントを図り、エージェンシーのプランニングサイクルにおいてPrime Video Adsが効果的にポジショニングされるようにします。本ポジションでは、複数のタイムゾーンや広告市場の成熟度が異なるマーケットを横断して活動することに抵抗がないことが求められます。

In this role, you will focus on developing and executing the multi-year growth strategy for Prime Video Ads across APAC. A typical day includes reviewing regional business health metrics to identify variances and emerging trends, engaging in strategic conversations with agency and brand leaders to understand market needs, and partnering cross-functionally with Sales and Product teams to resolve barriers to advertiser growth. You will spend time analyzing advertiser segmentation data and competitive dynamics, then shift to preparing materials for leadership reviews that communicate strategic recommendations, roadmap priorities, and revenue performance. You will lead commercialization efforts for new advertising products, working with Product and Finance teams to define pricing and packaging strategies. You will also work directly with senior Sales leadership to align on regional priorities and ensure Prime Video Ads is positioned effectively in agency planning cycles. The role requires comfort operating across multiple time zones and markets with different levels of advertising maturity.

About the team
私たちは、Amazon Publisher Monetization内の戦略チームであり、Prime Videoの広告事業における将来の需要を形作ることに注力しています。私たちのBDT組織は、戦略インテリジェンスおよび需要形成のレイヤーとして機能し、新たなビジネス機会の特定、プロダクト導入の推進、そして複数年にわたる収益成長を実現するための商業戦略の構築を担っています。Sales、Product、Marketing、Finance、Engineeringと緊密に連携し、広告主と視聴者の双方に意義のある成果をもたらす広告ソリューションを市場に届けています。チームはAmericas、EMEA、APACをカバーしており、各リーダーがそれぞれの担当地域ポートフォリオにオーナーシップを持ちながら、グローバルイニシアチブにも貢献しています。

Our BDT organization operates as a strategic intelligence and demand-shaping layer that identifies emerging opportunities, drives product adoption, and builds the commercial strategies that unlock multi-year revenue growth. We partner closely with Sales, Product, Marketing, Finance, and Engineering to bring advertising solutions to market that deliver meaningful results for advertisers and viewers alike. The team covers Americas, EMEA, and APAC, with each leader owning a defined regional portfolio and contributing to global initiatives.

title: Regional Safety Manager , Data Center Health and Safety
descriptionHtml:
Join the world-class safety culture at Amazon Web Services (AWS) and be part of supporting the largest cloud computing infrastructure team as a Regional Safety Manager. This role owns the Health and Safety function for the Germany and Sweden and supervises a team of Health and Safety professionals across both countries.

You will be part of a regional and global team that works with internal and external partners to maintain and enhance the safety of operations. Close collaboration with onsite physical security, vendors, compliance officers, risk management, and fire/life safety systems is required. Additionally, you will work with employees and contractors to achieve specific safety objectives.

You will set the vision and define the safety strategy for your regional portfolio, design the right team structure and mechanisms to meet long-term business goals, and achieve consensus on priorities with senior operations partners. The ADC portfolio is in a period of growth, expanding across established sites and new builds, so you will anticipate future capacity needs and build a workforce strategy to match.

The candidate must hold a valid Fachkraft für Arbeitssicherheit (SIFA) certification and will be responsible for ensuring compliance with all applicable German occupational safety legal obligations, including risk assessments (Gefährdungsbeurteilungen), employee safety training, Safety Committee (ASA) participation, incident reporting, and regulatory requirements under the Arbeitsschutzgesetz (ArbSchG), DGUV Regulation 1, and SGB VII, as well as ensuring full adherence to all AWS safety policies and management systems.

This role sits within the EMEA Data Center Health and Safety team, where English is the working language for all business communication, collaboration, and reporting. Interviews will be conducted in English, and advanced English proficiency (written and spoken) is required.

This role is based in Germany. Regular travel across Germany and Sweden is required.


Key job responsibilities
Strategy & Leadership

• Own the safety strategy for Germany and Sweden, translating regional and global priorities into a multi-year execution roadmap with measurable outcomes.
• Operate as a core member of the EMEA DCHS regional leadership team, contributing to regional strategy development and representing Germany and Sweden in regional and global programme forums.
• Lead the end-to-end delivery of regional and global health and safety programmes from inception through execution, ensuring consistent rollout across assigned clusters.
• Deliver MBR and QBR narratives incorporating leading/lagging indicators, trend analysis, and strategic responses to performance gaps.
• Anticipate growth and investment needs and build workforce and succession strategy to match a scaling portfolio.

Team Management & Development

• Manage and develop a team of Health and Safety professionals across Germany and Sweden, driving hiring, coaching, performance management, and succession planning.
• Recruit and retain safety talent, ensuring the team structure supports current and future operational needs.

Regulatory Compliance & Risk Management

• Ensure compliance with German occupational safety legislation (ArbSchG, ASiG, DGUV Vorschrift 2, BG requirements) and Swedish legislation (Arbetsmiljölagen, AFS provisions).
• Lead documented Gefährdungsbeurteilungen (risk assessments) per ArbSchG §5-6, including psychosocial risk assessments, and coordinate with the appointed Betriebsarzt (occupational physician) under the ASiG dual-appointment model.
• Navigate the German dual inspection system and partner with AWS compliance and legal teams on regulatory interpretations across both jurisdictions.

Operations & Continuous Improvement

• Conduct health and safety audits and inspections of data centers to ensure compliance with regulatory and life safety requirements.
• Implement safety management systems, training programmes, risk assessments, and industrial hygiene assessments that meet or exceed regulatory standards.
• Review investigation quality and own escalation decisions for high-severity events.
• Partner with construction managers to identify and mitigate risks before new capacity goes live.

Basic qualifications

- Experience working effectively across cross-functional teams and partnering well with people at all levels within an organization
- Experience working with and influencing senior level stakeholders
- Experience in a leadership role
- Speak, write, and read fluently in German and English at C1 level or above
- A bachelor's degree or equivalent qualification in accordance with the European Qualifications Framework (EQF) in occupational safety, health and safety, engineering, or a related field.
- Certification as an Occupational Safety Specialist (Fachkraft für Arbeitssicherheit / SiFa) in accordance with Section 6 of the German Occupational Safety Act (ASiG) and DGUV Vorschrift 2.
- Minimum 5 years of professional experience working within the German and/or European occupational health and safety regulatory environment.
- In-depth knowledge of European and German occupational health and safety legislation.
- Relevant experience leading a team of health and safety professionals.

Preferred qualifications

- Experience leading organizational change initiatives across multiple locations
- Experience in a fast paced, dynamic organization
- 10+ years of increasing responsibility in safety programmes in data centers, critical infrastructure, manufacturing, or equivalent operational environments.
- NEBOSH International Diploma in Occupational Health and Safety, or equivalent international qualification.
- Experience with the Swedish Work Environment Act (Arbetsmiljölagen) and Arbetsmiljöverket regulatory framework.
- Experience navigating the German Berufsgenossenschaft / DGUV system, including Unfallverhütungsvorschriften (accident prevention regulations).
- Knowledge of ISO 45001 occupational health and safety management systems.
- Experience with Betriebsrat (works council) co-determination processes on health and safety matters under the Betriebsverfassungsgesetz (BetrVG).
- Experience in remote management of safety teams across multiple countries.
- Strong strategic narrative writing skills, including QBR and operating plan inputs for Director and VP audiences.
- Experience leading and communicating with a wide range of stakeholders, including peers, employees, and senior leaders.
- High ethical standards with a proven ability to handle highly confidential and sensitive information.
- Experience defining, designing, and implementing safety programmes, processes, and procedural documentation at scale.

title: Software Development Engineer, AWS Contract Onboarding
descriptionHtml:
Are you passionate about applying AI and compilation techniques to automate legal contract processing at AWS scale? The AWS Contract Onboarding team is looking for a Software Development Engineer to build systems that parse, interpret, and ingest Private Pricing Agreements - enabling AWS to bill customers accurately and sign contracts faster. You'll work with LLMs, distributed event pipelines, and customer-facing consoles processing billions of dollars in AWS revenue.

Key job responsibilities
As a Software Development Engineer, you will own all aspects of the software development lifecycle - design, architecture, implementation, testing, and operations. Your team builds systems to capture contractual data from AWS Private Pricing Agreements in electronic format, enabling automated billing at global scale.

In this role, you will…

- Design and build contract parsing and term extraction pipelines using AI/LLM techniques.
- Own and operate distributed systems processing confidential contractual data under demanding SLAs.
- Build event-driven architectures using AWS services (Lambda, Step Functions, SQS, DynamoDB).
- Collaborate with Product Managers and partner engineering teams to define scope and technical direction.
- Contribute to planning, design, implementation, testing, operations, and process improvement.
- Write high-quality, testable code in Java, Kotlin, Python, and TypeScript.
- Build highly available, secure systems at Amazon scale.
- Mentor and support the growth of other developers.


A day in the life
On a typical day, you might design an LLM extraction pipeline for a new contract type, debug a distributed event processing issue, review a teammate's architecture for a customer-facing API, or deep-dive into billing data to validate that automated discounts are applied correctly. You'll collaborate across and ship features that directly impact how AWS customers are billed. We move fast, own what we build, and measure our impact in contracts automated per day.

About the team
The Contract Onboarding team builds tools and services to auto-generate and auto-ingest AWS Private Pricing Agreements. We enable the AWS Billing organization to sign contracts faster, compute bills accurately, and apply customized discounts - enhancing the experience for AWS's largest customers. Our systems combine AI/LLM-powered contract parsing, distributed event processing, and customer-facing consoles to automate what was previously a manual, error-prone process.

title: Tecnico Sicurezza sul Lavoro
descriptionHtml:
Garantire la sicurezza e il benessere dei nostri dipendenti sul luogo di lavoro è una priorità assoluta in Amazon. I nostri Safety Technician svolgono un ruolo fondamentale per renderlo possibile. Questo ruolo rappresenta un'opportunità per avviare la tua carriera nella sicurezza sul lavoro e crescere in un'azienda internazionale. Collaborerai a stretto contatto con i nostri esperti per monitorare il tuo sito, potendo così constatare ogni giorno la differenza che fai per il benessere delle persone.

Il contratto collettivo nazionale di lavoro applicabile a questo ruolo è Logistica, Trasporti e Merci. La posizione è inquadrata al livello 3 del CCNL di riferimento.

Key job responsibilities
- Eseguire valutazioni del rischio e audit.
- Monitorare il sito per assicurarsi che i processi siano conformi alle procedure di sicurezza di Amazon.
- Creare e aggiornare i report sulle metriche di sicurezza da sottoporre ai colleghi.
- Collaborare con i colleghi di Operations e di tutta l'azienda su compiti relativi alla sicurezza e offrire indicazioni sui processi.
- Supportare l'implementazione di nuove misure di sicurezza.

A day in the life
Lavorerai in uno dei nostri siti. Questo significa che potrai seguire da vicino ciò che accade e i colleghi potranno rivolgersi a te con domande durante i loro turni. Questo ruolo consiste nell'individuare potenziali problemi prima che si verifichino. Dedicherai molto tempo a controllare il sito e a osservare come le persone utilizzano le attrezzature. Comprendendo il funzionamento di ogni attività e di ogni macchinario, sarai in grado di individuare il modo migliore per mantenere i processi sicuri.

Sarai anche una delle persone che mettono in atto i cambiamenti in materia di sicurezza, il che significa che lavorerai a stretto contatto con molte persone. Oltre alle tue mansioni quotidiane e settimanali, offrirai supporto al team Operations su attività ad hoc legate alla sicurezza.

La sicurezza è fondamentale per Amazon, e ci aiuterai a raccogliere i dati essenziali che ci permettono di tenere sotto controllo i nostri processi e di prevenire qualsiasi problema. Condividerai questi dati con i colleghi di tutta l'azienda e collaborerai con altri team per assicurare che la sicurezza sia sempre al primo posto.

Il team Workplace Health and Safety (WHS) svolge un ruolo fondamentale nel garantire il benessere mentale e fisico dei nostri dipendenti sul luogo di lavoro. Il nostro team collabora con responsabili, associati e autorità locali in tutti i nostri siti, assicurando il rispetto delle politiche di Amazon e delle normative vigenti, e garantendo la sicurezza dei nostri ambienti di lavoro. Il team offre una varietà di opportunità, dai Safety Technician ai Programme Manager. title: Logistics Coordinator, Global Transportation & Logistics
descriptionHtml:
The Global Transportation & Logistics (GTL) team is seeking a Transportation Coordinator to support daily North America transportation operations in service of Tech Supply Chain customers and Global RAD Operations. In this role, you will be the operational backbone of outbound transportation execution — scheduling palletized freight shipments and small parcel packages, tracking shipments in transit, resolving exceptions and delays, and ensuring every delivery meets our customer promise.

You will work directly with carriers, customer service teams, and RAD Operations shipping teams to coordinate daily pickup projections, set customer delivery appointments, investigate shipment inquiries, and identify transportation consolidation opportunities that reduce cost while protecting service quality. You will provide solutions for customers by proactively resolving shipping exceptions, recommending optimal service levels, and ensuring every delivery commitment is met. This role requires someone who can balance customer obsession with frugality — making smart service-level decisions on every shipment while delivering an exceptional customer experience.

If you thrive in a fast-paced logistics environment, enjoy solving problems in real time, and take pride in keeping shipments moving, this is the role for you.



Key job responsibilities
Transportation Scheduling & Execution
- Schedule and coordinate both less than truckload and full truckload palletized freight shipments and small parcel packages across North America fulfillment locations
- Use multiple carrier platforms and shipping systems to generate labels, book shipments, and confirm carrier pickups
- Rate quote customer shipping requests and make service-level decisions balancing customer obsession and frugality
- Identify transportation consolidation opportunities to optimize cost and reduce shipment volume

Shipment Tracking & Exception Management

- Track shipments in transit from origin to destination, monitoring status across parcel, LTL, and ground networks
- Action shipments with exceptions and delays, escalating with carriers and customer service teams to drive resolution
- Conduct shipment inquiries, file freight claims and support customer shipment investigations, providing timely updates to stakeholders
- Troubleshoot shipping errors and resolve issues end-to-end, escalating complex problems when necessary

Customer Experience & Delivery Support

- Provide customer experience support by setting and managing customer delivery appointments when required
- Communicate daily pickup projections and volume forecasts to carriers to ensure capacity alignment
- Support RAD Operations shipping teams with transportation coordination and shipment execution needs

Carrier & Stakeholder Communication

- Communicate professionally via email and phone with parcel, LTL, and FTL transportation providers
- Serve as the transportation liaison between GTL, RAD Operations, and cross-functional partners
- Maintain carrier compliance records including arrival and departure times for scorecard development
- Coordinate with business partners, stakeholders, and peers to ensure seamless daily operations

About the team
Global Transportation & Logistics (GTL) is the logistics solutions execution arm supporting the Global RAD Operations business across North America. We manage multi-modal transportation in support of Amazon internal customers— parcel, LTL, FTL, flatbed and auto transport. Our team operates with customer obsession and solutions mindset at the core, balancing service quality with cost optimization every day. We are a collaborative, fast-paced team that values ownership, communication, and continuous improvement.

Basic qualifications

- High school or equivalent
- 1+ years of Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, and Outlook) experience
- Can lift up to 49 pounds, stand/walk during shifts lasting up to 12 hours, and be able to frequently push, pull, squat, bend, and reach
- Work 40 hours/week, and overtime as required
- 1+ years of transportation and supply chain experience

Preferred qualifications

- 2+ years of Microsoft Office products and applications experience
- Experience using tracking platforms for high volume customer shipments, investigating shipment exceptions, delays, and customer inquiries
- 2+ years of experience in transportation coordination, freight scheduling, or logistics operations
- Experience with Transportation Management Systems (TMS), carrier platforms, or shipping software
- Experience scheduling both palletized freight (LTL/FTL) and small parcel shipments
- Experience investigating shipment exceptions, delays, and customer inquiries

title: Senior Financial Analyst, EU Amazon Logistics - Process Excellence & Engineering Finance
descriptionHtml:
Amazon Logistics is transforming its last-mile delivery network at pace, opening new delivery stations, expanding faster delivery options for customers, and handling steadily growing volumes across Europe. Two things decide how cost-effectively that network runs, how efficiently each delivery station operates, and how well we invest the capital that improves and automates it. Process Excellence sets the standard for station efficiency through process governance, quality, and defect reduction, while Engineering decides how the network is built and automated through process engineering, automation, and station design. Finance partners closely with both, making sure every efficiency gain and every euro of capital is grounded in solid analysis and delivers the return it promised.

We are looking for a Senior Financial Analyst who is excited to partner with Process Excellence and Engineering and influence how the network invests. You will own the financial partnership across process governance, quality, and defect reduction on the Process Excellence side, and the ROI of automation, process engineering, and design investments on the Engineering side, so that a single automation or design decision that can shape the cost of running a station for years is grounded in the rigour you bring to sizing the opportunity, testing the assumptions, and tracking the return.

With the reporting automated and much of the recurring analysis now taking care of itself, the value you bring is in reading the numbers better than anyone else, testing whether a business case holds before the capital is committed, and partnering with operators and engineers to invest where it earns the most. You will draw on the team's own AI and automation tools to spend your time exactly there, on the analysis and the partnership that move performance, on a team that keeps setting itself a higher standard and will look to you to help shape what comes next.


Key job responsibilities
• Own the financial partnership for Process Excellence, connecting process governance, quality, and returns performance to financial outcomes and identifying where efficiency is falling short of benchmark.
• Review the ROI of Engineering investments (automation, process engineering projects, design change requests), sizing the opportunity, quantifying the trade-off, and making thoughtful judgement calls in ambiguous environments where data may be difficult to procure.
• Review capital investment cases, making sure they are rigorous, complete, and grounded in credible assumptions before they move forward, and connect performance back to the original investment.
• Track investment actuals against business case, closing the loop through to benefits realisation and feeding lessons back into planning.
• Contribute to the cross-functional programs that reduce cost and defects on the Process Excellence side.
• Communicate the drivers behind process, quality, and investment performance to senior stakeholders, turning analysis into decisions.
• Partner with data and technology teams to automate recurring analysis, and support the adoption of the team's AI and automation tools across the wider finance community.


A day in the life
You will be at the center of how the network invests in its own performance, so on any given day you might be working with a business partner to understand whether an efficiency gain is genuine or an artefact of the benchmark, pressure-testing an automation or design business case together to see whether the payback holds once you stress the assumptions, or turning what the numbers are telling you into a clear recommendation that moves an investment decision forward.

Some of the questions you will help answer:

• Is this efficiency gain a genuine improvement, or is the benchmark flattering us?
• Does this automation or design investment still pay back once we stress the assumptions, and how will we know once it ships?
• Where should the network put its next euro of capital to build the most performance?

No two days look the same, but the thread that ties them together is that you will use data, judgement, and financial rigour to help the network invest where it earns the most, working alongside operators and engineers to get there.


About the team
As part of the EU AMZL Central Finance team, you will join a team that is passionate about numbers, data, and how to use them to generate insights and improve our business. We partner across countries and delivery stations to strengthen the productivity plan, protect the cost base, and shape where the network invests next, and we are the trusted business advisors to Central Operations leadership, working with our partners to make sure they have the most reliable information and make the best possible decisions.

Basic qualifications

- Bachelor's degree or above
- Experience in a finance role leading a project or program and partnering with multiple stakeholders within a business
- Experience working with Excel, reporting tools, and large-scale data mining tools, such as Power BI, Python, SQL, or Tableau
- Experience in financial modeling

Preferred qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in Finance, Mathematics, or Economics
- Experience troubleshooting problems and offering solutions to streamline complex challenges
- Experience working in a large team or fast-paced corporate environment
- Experience making strategic business decisions and managing internal relationships

title: Supervisor/a de Mantenimiento
descriptionHtml:

Este equipo se asegura de que las herramientas y tecnologías que utilizamos evolucionen y se adapten a los cambios al mismo ritmo que Amazon. Como técnico/a sénior de ingeniería de mantenimiento y fiabilidad, nos ayudarás a ir siempre un paso por delante, adoptando las últimas tecnologías e identificando formas nuevas y más eficientes de trabajar. En este puesto, prestarás especial atención a nuestros procesos para ayudar a cumplir los exigentes estándares por los que nos regimos y pondrás en marcha mejoras para continuar avanzando.

Key job responsibilities
- Aplicar las mejores prácticas en el uso seguro de los equipos y supervisar al personal para garantizar que todos siguen los procesos correctamente.
- Garantizar el rendimiento de los dispositivos mediante comprobaciones visuales, controles de estado y tareas de mantenimiento preventivo, y programar revisiones adicionales cuando sea necesario.
- Supervisar al personal técnico que esté de turno para apoyar su desarrollo y actuar como primer punto de contacto para los/las ingenieros/as de mantenimiento y fiabilidad.
- Resolver problemas en los equipos para reducir los tiempos en los que las operaciones se detienen, para que se puedan procesar los paquetes lo antes posible.
- Ayudar a encontrar formas de mejorar constantemente los sistemas y homogeneizar los procesos en toda la red de la UE.

A day in the life
En cada turno, estarás al frente de un equipo asegurándote de que todos sus integrantes cuentan con el material necesario y de que este funcione perfectamente. Eso implica la supervisión de los procesos para velar por el cumplimiento de las normativas y políticas, así como garantizar que se lleva a cabo el mantenimiento preventivo pertinente para aumentar el tiempo de actividad de los equipos.
A partir de lo que observes en tus turnos, propondrás mejoras destinadas a incrementar la eficiencia y la productividad de nuestros sistemas y, más adelante, implantarás dichos cambios en todos nuestros centros de la UE. También deberás emplear herramientas como Scada, para supervisar los procesos a fin de garantizar su rendimiento, además de colaborar estrechamente con tu supervisor directo en las tareas administrativas.
Tu lugar de trabajo estará en uno de nuestros centros operativos. Trabajarás por turnos, lo que pueden incluir algunos fines de semana y noches. A medida que vayas ganando experiencia en este sector tan fascinante de Amazon, podrás progresar hacia puestos más sénior.

About the team
Nuestro equipo de ingenieros de mantenimiento y fiabilidad (RME) se encarga de que nuestros sistemas funcionen a pleno rendimiento. Nos caracterizamos por nuestra gran aptitud técnica y nuestra excelente capacidad para el trabajo en equipo, liderados por unos responsables con gran experiencia. Nuestro trabajo comprende el mantenimiento, la reparación y la solución de problemas relacionados con los equipos en toda nuestra red mundial de centros de distribución. El equipo cuenta con una serie de perfiles de dirección que se encargan de supervisar el desarrollo de tecnologías fascinantes, algunas de las cuales solo existen en Amazon.
Nuestro equipo se ocupa de la mayoría de los aspectos técnicos de Amazon, desempeñando tareas que van desde la instalación de sistemas automatizados de embalaje hasta la supervisión del mantenimiento general de un centro o la reparación de equipos clave de distribución. Esto incluye adaptar los edificios a la legislación vigente, para que todo el personal esté seguro y nuestras instalaciones funcionen con la mayor eficiencia posible. El equipo de RME, al igual que ocurre en otros departamentos de Amazon, ofrece numerosas oportunidades de progresar profesionalmente.
Todo nuestro trabajo gira en torno a reducir los periodos de inactividad en los centros de operaciones cruciales de Amazon, para que los clientes reciban sus pedidos a tiempo. Con frecuencia, trabajamos de madrugada o a altas horas de la noche para poder realizar las tareas de mantenimiento ocasionando las mínimas molestias, por lo que hacemos turnos nocturnos. Si descubrimos que hay una forma mejor de hacer algo, tenemos la capacidad y la posibilidad de desarrollar e introducir procesos totalmente nuevos o tecnología punta, como Amazon Robotics y nuestro clasificador de artículos complejos.

title: Transportation Specialist, Amazon Intermodal (AZIM)
descriptionHtml:
Amazon’s Intermodal (AZIM) Operations team is seeking highly skilled and motivated Transportation Specialists to join this rapidly growing team. AZIM Operations drives the end to end operational execution of all loads (internal and external) shipped on our 1P network. The team supports regions and shippers across the Supply Chain network and is tasked with ensuring on-time pickup and delivery of freight from vendors, Amazon fulfillment centers (FCs), rail yards and shipper hubs. In the case of disruptions, the Operations team is responsible for addressing the disruption, keeping all stakeholders informed and ensuring timely resolution of the issue. The AZIM Operations team is the first line of defense in understanding network trends, delays, dwells and other exceptions that impact AZIM’s ability to deliver a world class transportation product that serves its customers on time.

Key job responsibilities
- Communication with customers (Carriers, Rail Road partners, Vendors/Suppliers) and stakeholders (Program Managers, Fulfillment Centers, Amazon Managed carrier programs).
- Pull data from numerous databases (using Excel, SQL and/or other data management systems) and to perform ad hoc reporting and analysis as needed.
- Understand performance metrics to assist with driving business results.
- Rectify disruptions, breaks in process and follow standard work to make decisions that make sense based on available data.
- Provide real-time customer experience by working in a fast paced operating environment.
- Knowledge to systematically escalate problems or variance in the information and data to the relevant owners and teams.
- Deliver follow through on the resolutions to ensure the information is delivered.
- Work within various time constraints to meet critical business needs, while measuring and identifying activities performed.
- Communication, both verbal and written as their data and findings are critical to tracking trends and performance inefficiencies.
- Identifying possible disruptions in a route and fixing/rerouting it in a timely manner.
- Deliver positive carrier and driver experience/solutions, in a contact center environment, through researching, problem-solving, setting appropriate expectations and working within the Amazon Transportation network to get trailers/trucks back on track when disruptions occur.


A day in the life
The AZIM Transportation Operations Specialist facilitates the continued flow of Amazon’s supply chain by passing information to key stakeholders and resolving disruptions that impact customer experience or the flow of information impacting performance and delivery. The Specialist checks on a list of shipments and makes sure everything is as it should be, then optimizes the driver’s intermodal portions of the trip as much as possible while providing any necessary information to avoid disruptions. Will be required to make real-time decisions to resolve issues and cancelations. Will also be apart of new and inventive programs designed to bridge a gap or improve overall business. The Specialist addresses or escalates any concerns arising during the lifecycle of freight leaving rail ramps, shipper hubs, Amazon fulfillment centers, or transiting between rail to OTR carriers. The day-to day role requires the specialist to provide resolutions by researching and querying internal tools and making real-time decisions in accordance with their guidance and standard work processes. In this role, the Transportation Operations Specialist will be able to understand the process and requirements/be able to analyze data and notice trends and be able to drive Customer Experience without compromising on time. This position will need to have the experience to understand Logistics and should be able to communicate clearly in the written and oral form.

Basic qualifications

- 1+ years of working with computers and Microsoft Office (including Outlook, Word, and Excel) experience
- High school or equivalent diploma
- Speak, write, and read fluently in English
- Can lift up to 49 pounds, stand/walk during shifts lasting up to 12 hours, and be able to frequently push, pull, squat, bend, and reach
- Work 40 hours/week, and overtime as required
- Work a flexible schedule/shift/work area, including weekends, nights, and/or holidays
- Are 18 years of age or older

title: Senior Robotics SDE, Safe Autonomy, Compass
descriptionHtml:
We are seeking a robotics Software Dev Engineer to join Compass. In this role, you will own the integration of the Compass software into various platforms, including mobile robots, mobile manipulators, and legged robots. You will interface with motion planning, sensing and perception, and safety firmware and create abstractions that enable the Compass software to be easily deployed across millions of robots.

Key job responsibilities
• Design, implement, and maintain the software integration layer that enables Compass safety modules to interface with diverse robot platforms (mobile robots, manipulators, dynamically stable robots)

• Collaborate with motion planning, perception, and controls teams to ensure seamless data flow and real-time performance between safety systems and autonomy stacks
• Develop and maintain interfaces to safety-rated firmware and hardware, ensuring compliance with functional safety requirements
• Architect scalable, production-grade software that can operate reliably across millions of deployed robots

title: Sr. GenAI/ML Specialist Solutions Architect, AGS Specialist Solutions Architects
descriptionHtml:
Application deadline: Applications will be accepted on an ongoing basis

Are you passionate about Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, and GenerativeAI? Are you passionate about helping customers build solutions leveraging the state-of-the-art AI/ML/GenAI tools on Amazon Web Service (AWS)? Come join us!

At Amazon, we’ve been investing deeply in artificial intelligence for over 20 years, and many of the capabilities customers experience in our products are driven by machine learning. Amazon.com’s recommendations engine is driven by machine learning (ML), as are the paths that optimize robotic picking routes in our fulfillment centers. Our supply chain, forecasting, and capacity planning are also informed by ML algorithms. Alexa is fueled by Natural Language Understanding and Automated Speech Recognition deep learning; as is Prime Air, and the computer vision technology in our new retail experience, Amazon Go. We have thousands of engineers at Amazon committed to machine learning and deep learning, and it’s a big part of our heritage.

Within AWS, we’re focused on bringing that knowledge and capability to customers through three layers of the AI stack: 1) Frameworks and Infrastructure with tools like Apache MxNet and TensorFlow, 2) Machine Learning Platforms such as Amazon SageMaker for data scientists, and, 3) API-driven Services like Amazon Bedrock, Amazon Lex, Amazon Kendra, Amazon Transcribe, Amazon Comprehend, and Amazon Rekognition to quickly add intelligence to applications with simple API calls.

AWS is looking for a Machine Learning Solutions Architect (ML SA), who will be the Subject Matter Expert (SME) for helping customers in the AMERICAS design solutions that leverage our ML services. As part of the team, you will work closely with customers in one or more industry verticals (Financial Services, Media and Entertainment, Manufacturing, Technology, Health Care and Life Sciences, Retail, etc.) to enable large-scale use cases, design ML pipelines, and drive the adoption of AWS for the AI/ML platforms. You will interact with other SAs in the field, providing guidance on their customer engagements, and you will develop white papers, blogs, reference implementations, and presentations to enable customers to fully leverage AI/ML on AWS. Additionally, as the voice of the customer, you will work closely with the service teams, and submit product feature requests to drive the platform forward.

You must have deep technical experience working with technologies related to artificial intelligence, machine learning and/or deep learning. A strong mathematics and statistics background is preferred in addition to experience building complex machine learning models. You will be familiar with the ecosystem of software vendors in the GenAI space, and will leverage this knowledge to help AWS customers in their selection process.

title: Applied Scientist, Linear Personalization Experience Team (LPEX)
descriptionHtml:
Prime Video is a first-stop entertainment destination offering customers a vast collection of premium programming in one app available across thousands of devices. Prime members can customize their viewing experience and find their favorite movies, series, documentaries, and live sports – including Amazon MGM Studios-produced series and movies; licensed fan favorites; and programming from Prime Video add-on subscriptions such as Apple TV+, Max, Crunchyroll and MGM+. All customers, regardless of whether they have a Prime membership or not, can rent or buy titles via the Prime Video Store, and can enjoy even more content for free with ads.

Are you interested in shaping the future of entertainment? Prime Video's technology teams are creating best-in-class digital video experience.

As a Prime Video technologist, you’ll have end-to-end ownership of the product, user experience, design, and technology required to deliver state-of-the-art experiences for our customers. You’ll get to work on projects that are fast-paced, challenging, and varied. You’ll also be able to experiment with new possibilities, take risks, and collaborate with remarkable people.

We’ll look for you to bring your diverse perspectives, ideas, and skill-sets to make Prime Video even better for our customers. With global opportunities for talented technologists, you can decide where a career Prime Video Tech takes you!

Prime Video is disrupting traditional media with an ever-increasing selection of movies, TV shows, Emmy Award-winning original content, add-on subscriptions, and live events like Thursday Night Football. Within this expanding ecosystem, Linear TV with its 24/7 scheduled broadcast-style programming has emerged as one of our fastest-growing segments, with viewership hours increasing significantly year over year. This growth demonstrates that even in the streaming era, customers deeply value the lean-back, curated experience that Linear TV provides.

Key job responsibilities
As an Applied Scientist on LPEX, you will be a technical owner and science leader across the following areas:
* Design, develop, and deploy machine learning models for content recommendation, viewer engagement optimization, and real-time personalization at the scale of hundreds of millions of Prime Video customers.
* Own the complete ML lifecycle: problem formulation, data analysis, feature engineering, model development, offline and online evaluation, and reliable production deployment.
* Build and continuously optimize recommendation systems with strict real-time latency requirements, ensuring that personalization decisions are delivered at speed and scale.
* Design and execute rigorous A/B and multivariate experiments to measure recommendation quality, understand causal drivers of engagement, and iterate rapidly toward customer impact.
* Partner with software engineering teams to productionize ML models, defining requirements for serving infrastructure, data pipelines, and model monitoring and observability.
* Collaborate with product managers and cross-functional stakeholders to translate ambiguous business problems into well-scoped, tractable science solutions.
* Mentor scientists and engineers on the team, setting a high bar for scientific rigor, experimental discipline, and ML engineering best practices.

A day in the life
We are looking for an Applied Scientist who will own the end-to-end machine learning lifecycle from problem formulation and research through experimentation and production deployment, building systems that help millions of customers discover the right content at the right time. It's Day 1 for personalizing the linear TV experience on Prime Video, and you will be at the forefront of this innovation.

About the team
The Linear Personalization Experience (LPEX) team is building next-generation, AI-powered personalization and recommendation systems to enhance this natural engagement and deliver a best-in-class Linear TV experience for Prime Video customers worldwide.

The LPEX team's vision is to surface the breadth and depth of Prime Video's linear selection at exactly the right moment for each customer curating the most relevant programming, tailored to individual tastes, purchase behaviors, schedules, and viewing habits, while simultaneously elevating awareness of our extensive live and linear catalog.

Our mission is to anticipate and exceed viewers' expectations, fostering deeper connections with the content they love. We adapt to viewers' preferences and propensities for both live and on-demand viewing, enriching the overall entertainment journey. The team operates at the intersection of machine learning research, large-scale distributed systems, and consumer product strategy, partnering closely with product management, engineering, and business development.

Basic qualifications

- PhD, or Master's degree and 4+ years of CS, CE, ML or related field experience
- 3+ years of building models for business application experience
- Experience programming in Java, C++, Python or related language
- Experience in any of the following areas: algorithms and data structures, parsing, numerical optimization, data mining, parallel and distributed computing, high-performance computing

Preferred qualifications

- Experience in state-of-the-art deep learning models architecture design and deep learning training and optimization and model pruning
- Experience building complex recommendations or personalization systems that have been successfully delivered to customers at significant scale.

title: Startup Senior Partner Sales Manager, France, Startup Partner Sales
descriptionHtml:
Are you passionate about startups and the Partner ecosystem that powers them? We're looking for a driven Partner Sales Manager to join our Startup Partner Sales team, covering France out of Paris.

In this role, you'll work at the intersection of AWS's most innovative Technology Partners — ISVs, SaaS companies, resellers, and systems integrators — and the fast-growing startup customers they serve. Unlike a traditional alliance role, this is deeply embedded in the startup ecosystem: you'll engage with the communities, accelerators, and venture-backed companies that are shaping the future of technology.

You'll build and execute Partner go-to-market strategies that drive AWS adoption among startups, develop joint value propositions with Partners, and grow a healthy pipeline through co-sell motions. France's startup scene is one of the most dynamic in Europe, and you'll be at the center of it.

This role is ideal for someone who thrives in fast-paced environments, is comfortable navigating ambiguity, and has a genuine curiosity for emerging technologies and disruptive business models. If you understand both the Partner landscape and the startup mindset, we want to talk to you.

Key job responsibilities
Drive joint Partner-to-startup co-sell engagements by connecting AWS Technology Partners (ISVs, SaaS platforms, resellers) with Startup Account teams to generate qualified pipeline and close deals.

Build and execute a quarterly go-to-market plan with priority Partners, ensuring alignment with startup customer needs and AWS revenue goals.

Develop deep relationships with Partner field sales and executive leadership, positioning AWS as their preferred cloud platform for startup customers.

Identify and activate reseller Partners in the French startup ecosystem — a segment where reseller motions are more prominent than in other customer segments.

Engage with local startup communities, accelerators, VCs, and tech hubs across France to surface new partnership and co-sell opportunities.

Collaborate with AWS Startup Business Development, Solutions Architects, and Partner Solution Architects to deliver joint technical and commercial value propositions.

Own and report on pipeline metrics, co-sell revenue targets, and Partner engagement KPIs through structured business reviews.

Support contract negotiations and commercial constructs (e.g., partner private pricing, funding programs) by liaising with internal stakeholders.



A day in the life
Your morning might start with a call alongside a Partner's sales team pitching a joint solution to a Series B startup in Station F. By midday, you're reviewing pipeline with your top reseller Partners in Paris, ensuring upcoming deals are tracking. In the afternoon, you join a startup accelerator demo day to spot emerging co-sell opportunities. You end the day prepping a business review for your leadership, highlighting how a new ISV partnership drove 30% of quarterly pipeline. Every day is different — but every day is about connecting the dots between Partners and startups.

About the team
The Startup Partner Sales team is a tight-knit group within AWS that sits at the crossroads of two of the most dynamic ecosystems: Partners and Startups. We work with the leading-edge and most innovative Technology Partners — from fast-growing ISVs to specialist resellers — helping them co-sell into the startup segment. Our team covers EMEA, and we operate with a startup mindset ourselves: we move fast, experiment, and obsess over results. If you're energized by new technology, enjoy building from scratch, and want a front-row seat to innovation, you'll feel at home here.

Basic qualifications

- 5+ years of experience in partner sales, business development, channel management, or alliance management
- Experience working in or with the technology startup ecosystem (e.g., as a vendor, Partner, or in a startup-focused role)
- Experience building and executing go-to-market plans with technology partners that resulted in measurable pipeline or revenue growth
- Demonstrated track record of meeting or exceeding revenue targets
- Fluent in English and French (native or near-native French proficiency)

Preferred qualifications

- Experience working in or selling to startups or scaleups in France
- Relationships or active involvement in French startup communities, accelerators, or VC ecosystems
- Experience managing reseller or distribution partnerships (not just direct SI/ISV alliances)
- Familiarity with cloud computing and IaaS/PaaS platforms
- Experience with Partner-led sales motions (e.g., co-sell, referral programs, marketplace)
- MBA or advanced degree in business, technology, or related field

* Realizowanie projektów o wysokim priorytecie zgodnie z najwyższymi standardami oraz wykazywanie się umiejętnością osiągania wyników

* Analizowanie danych w celu identyfikacji wyzwań operacyjnych i możliwości poprawy

* Proponowanie i testowanie rozwiązań oraz współpraca z zespołem przy wdrażaniu tych najbardziej skutecznych

* Rozwijanie umiejętności komunikacyjnych i pracy zespołowej poprzez współpracę z przełożonymi, interesariuszami i pracownikami pierwszej linii.

* Przemieszczanie się po budynku w celu współpracy z różnymi zespołami. Obejmuje to aktywne zdobywanie wiedzy poprzez udział w takich działaniach, jak wstępne odprawy, spotkania dotyczące przepływu pracy oraz dyskusje z kierownictwem i współpracownikami.

* Niezbędnym elementem tego stanowiska jest umiejętność poruszania się po miejscu pracy i przemieszczania się między różnymi obszarami.

* Wykazywanie elastyczności w zakresie pracy w różnych harmonogramach i systemach zmianowych stosownie do potrzeb.

* Potencjalna relokacja do wyznaczonego miejsca pracy.



A day in the life
Dzień z życia stażysty
Nasze staże to okazja do zdobycia wiedzy, która pozwoli Ci jako naszemu przyszłemu przełożonemu przekonać się, w jaki sposób zarządzamy zespołami pracowników i rozwijamy ich kompetencje. Poznasz dynamiczny i złożony świat naszych centrów logistycznych, centrów sortowania oraz stacji dostaw i zobaczysz, w jaki sposób nasi kierownicy motywują swoje zespoły do spełniania oczekiwań klientów.

Dzięki temu stażowi znajdziesz się w samym centrum naszych działań, co pozwoli Ci prześledzić drogę zamówienia klienta. Zyskasz realistyczny obraz pracy w pełnym wymiarze czasu, która czeka na Ciebie w naszej organizacji.

Dowiesz się, w jaki sposób nasi przełożeni tworzą bezpieczne i produktywne środowisko pracy, w pełni wykorzystując potencjał swoich zespołów dzięki skutecznym strategiom angażowania pracowników i zarządzania wynikami pracy. To szansa na rozwinięcie umiejętności, które pomogą Ci rozpocząć satysfakcjonującą karierę w Amazon.


About the team
O zespole
Społeczność stażystów:

* Jako stażysta Amazon będziesz częścią dynamicznej, wspierającej społeczności, która pomoże Ci się rozwijać. Będziesz współpracować ze stażystami z całego świata, nawiązywać kontakty i uczestniczyć w wydarzeniach towarzyskich, aby poszerzyć swoje horyzonty. Wsparcie:

Sesje szkoleniowe:

* Dzięki specjalnym sesjom szkoleniowym jeszcze bardziej rozwiniesz swoje umiejętności, uzyskując dostęp do najnowocześniejszych platform szkoleniowych Amazon i wiedzy liderów branży. Te ustrukturyzowane możliwości rozwoju przygotują cię do kolejnego kroku w karierze.

Możliwości:

Dodatkowo otrzymasz konkurencyjne miesięczne wynagrodzenie, wsparcie w relokacji oraz dostęp do szeregu świadczeń pracowniczych.

Daty rozpoczęcia stażu w ciągu roku:

title: Maintenance Engineering Planner, Reliability Maintenance Engineering
descriptionHtml:
We are looking for motivated, customer-focused people who want to join our team as a Reliability Maintenance Engineering Planner. The Reliability Maintenance Engineering Planner is responsible for asset and spares management, preventative maintenance planning and machine history data. They are the site lead for the CMMS (Computerized Maintenance Management System) software and are required to extract information from it to support the site engineering manager.

Key job responsibilities
- Be the site level SME (Subject Matter Expert) on the CMMS (Computerized Maintenance Management System) software, train the local engineering team in its use and escalate issues as required to the Global team.
- Ensure the system is run in line with IntlRME standards and participate in IntlRME coordinated projects and improvement programs to roll out new functionality, procedures, scheduling or reports.
- Ensure site level equipment, spare parts and minimum holding levels are correctly recorded in the system in order to ensure technicians are never without the parts they need.
- Ensure the system accurately forecasts and assigns all required preventative maintenance to technicians within the team to provide a high level of equipment availability to our internal customers.
- Compile equipment information, performance metrics and machine histories and make recommendations for improvements based on their findings.
- Manage spare parts stock levels, place and track orders as required. Work with procurement and the wider BR network to find savings or efficiencies.

About the team
Amazon Operations sits at the heart of the Amazon customer experience. We look after everything from the moment a customer clicks buy, to the moment their item is delivered – from desktop to doorstep.

Across Mexico we have several Fulfillment Centers, Sort Center and Delivery Stations, thousands of machines, and thousands of employees, all working together in harmony to make sure the right item gets delivered to the right person, in the right place, at the right time.

Working in Amazon Operations is for people who like to be active and give their all. We work in a busy, dynamic environment and are part of a bigger team delivering on the expectations of millions of customers every single day.

We are open, inclusive and welcome individuality and diversity. The culture in our Operation is built on the way teams bond and the work ethic that enables our business run like clockwork. Our teams take pride in a job well done, looking out for one another, ensuring the highest safety standards and playing their part in delivering the quality service Amazon is known for around the world.

Join us in the Amazon Reliability Maintenance Engineering team. We maintain and optimize technologies in the Global Amazon Warehouse & Delivery Network.

Basic qualifications

- Experience working with CMMS software
- Experience in MS Office including Excel
- 1+ years of maintenance planner/scheduler in industrial maintenance, manufacturing, or distribution industries experience
- Experience in operations or inventory management
- Bachelor's degree
- Experience in oral and written communication in English

Preferred qualifications

- Experience in auditing, risk management, compliance, program management, or quality management systems
- Experience working with CMMS software
- Experience in training, performance management and coaching/mentoring
- Experience at Amazon, or experience with end-to-end project management
