title: Safety Investigations Analyst, Middle Mile Investigations
descriptionHtml:
At Amazon, we're dedicated to becoming the most customer-centric company on Earth. To achieve this goal, we seek exceptionally talented, bright, and driven individuals. Amazon is currently looking for a Safety Investigations Analyst to join Middle Mile Investigations (MMI) within NAST Safety and Compliance.

The Safety Investigations Analyst owns investigation of Middle Mile transportation incidents end to end, from intake through documented finding, across Amazon's carrier programs: Relay Motor Carrier (RMC), Relay Motor Carrier LineHaul (RMCLH), Relay Motor Carrier Box Truck (RMCBT), and Amazon Freight Partner (AFP).

In this role you will conduct comprehensive incident investigations using telematics, video, and law enforcement records; apply FMCSA Crash Preventability Determination Program criteria; identify trends across regions, programs, and carriers; recommend enforcement action under published authority matrices; and serve as incident point of contact to internal stakeholders and external counsel. Findings inform network-level changes intended to reduce incident frequency and severity.

The successful candidate writes clearly for senior audiences, reaches defensible conclusions from incomplete information, and works independently across competing deadlines.

Key job responsibilities
Investigation

- Own assigned incident investigations end to end, from intake through documented finding, across RMC, RMCLH, RMCBT, and AFP.
- Collect and preserve evidence including telematics, dash camera footage, law enforcement records, and carrier documentation.
- Apply FMCSA Crash Preventability Determination Program criteria and video review standards.
- Write investigation narratives documenting what occurred and the factors identified, each sourced to verifiable data.
- Serve as incident point of contact to internal stakeholders and, when assigned, external counsel.

Analysis and enforcement

- Identify trends across regions, carrier programs, and individual carriers, and surface them to the Program Manager.
- Recommend enforcement action under published authority matrices.
- Query multiple data systems to extract and reconcile investigation data.

Operating rhythm

- Maintain case records and queue status in the systems of record, keeping tracking current and auditable.
- Review recurring vendor investigation reports for completeness, and escalate vendor performance issues.
- Report investigation status, closure metrics, and case aging to the Program Manager on a recurring cadence.
- Propose improvements to investigation process and standard work.

A day in the life
Your morning starts with the queue: new incidents overnight, open evidence requests, cases aging. You pull telematics and video on an assigned collision and chase the law enforcement report and carrier documentation. By afternoon you are writing the narrative, sourcing every line. Some events bring outside counsel into the file, and you are the person who knows what happened. A pattern you flagged last month across two regions becomes a recommendation your Program Manager takes to an enforcement decision. No two investigations are the same, and what you document today shapes what the network changes next quarter.

About the team
Middle Mile Investigations (MMI) sits within NAST Safety and Compliance. We investigate transportation incidents across Amazon's Middle Mile carrier programs, document what happened from verifiable evidence, and surface patterns that inform how the network operates. The team is small and geographically distributed. Analysts own their cases rather than a shared queue, and the written product carries to senior leaders who act on it. We are building our standard work now, so you will help shape how this function operates rather than inherit a finished process. If you want ownership and are comfortable with ambiguity, you will do well here.

Basic qualifications

- 2+ years of professional or military experience
- 1+ years of working with computers and Microsoft Office products and applications experience
- High school or equivalent
- Are 18 years of age or older

Preferred qualifications

- Experience with end-to-end project management

title: Human Resources Specialist I, Relocation Services
descriptionHtml:
Amazon's Workforce Solutions Assignments team is launching a new concierge service line dedicated to international assignment support, and we need you to help bring it to life. As a Human Resources Specialist I, you will provide critical operational support for Amazon's international assignment program, keeping case files current, tracking deadlines across Relocation, Immigration, and Tax partners, and ensuring Assignment Managers and Specialists have everything they need to deliver an exceptional employee experience. You will use an internal case management tool, Microsoft Office products, and Amazon Q to manage your work and continuously improve how we serve assignees. This is a chance to join a global team of subject matter experts at a moment when the program is expanding to offer highly customized, high-touch support to assignees and their families, with real opportunities to deepen your expertise in global mobility and benefits or policy administration.

Key job responsibilities
- Provide operational support to Assignment Managers and Specialists by maintaining case records, processing documentation, managing data entry, and ensuring case files are complete and accurate in the case management system.
- Execute vendor and partner follow-ups with Relocation, Immigration, Tax, and other providers, confirming task completion, tracking outstanding items, and reporting status back to case owners.

A day in the life

Along the way, you will spot patterns and suggest improvements to how the team manages cases, building your expertise in global mobility and policy administration. Your work keeps cases moving forward on time and with complete documentation.

The Assignment Concierge Service sits within Amazon's Workforce Solutions Relocation Services team. title: Electronics Engineer – Carrier Board, RIVR
descriptionHtml:
RIVR, an Amazon company, is building Physical AI by deploying autonomous robots for real-world doorstep delivery. Operating daily in diverse urban environments, RIVR's robots continuously learn from and navigate the millions of scenarios encountered during deliveries. By owning the full stack from software to hardware, RIVR is purpose-built for safety, reliability, and the customer from day one.

As a Electronics Engineer – Carrier Board, you will own the design of GPU/SoC carrier boards for our robotic compute platform — from schematic capture through PCB layout, bring-up, and production release. You will integrate high-speed digital interfaces and sensor front-ends into compact, reliable board designs for mobile Physical AI applications. Beyond technical depth, you will manage supplier and partner relationships, define development priorities, and drive sourcing decisions. You are the technical owner of the carrier board, not just a layout executor.

Key job responsibilities
Design and own carrier boards for GPU/SoC compute modules end-to-end: requirements → schematic → layout → bring-up → production release.

Integrate high-speed digital interfaces such as multi-gigabit Ethernet, DDR4, PCIe, MIPI CSI-2, GMSL SerDes, and USB 3.x.

Design electrical front-ends for sensors and modules including cameras, LIDARs, RADARs, and wireless connectivity (WiFi/5G).

Manage supplier and partner relationships: SoC vendors, connector suppliers, contract manufacturers, and module providers.

Evaluate and select components and suppliers based on cost, availability, quality, and roadmap fit.

Define and own development milestones and timelines; coordinate across internal teams and external partners.

Make trade-off decisions (features vs. schedule vs. cost) and communicate them clearly to stakeholders.

Perform board bring-up, debug, and validation of high-speed interfaces.

Provide signal integrity guidance for PCB layout (impedance control, length-matching, stackup definition).

Collaborate closely with firmware, mechanical, and systems engineering teams.

Basic qualifications

- 5+ years designing carrier boards or motherboards for GPU/SoC compute modules.
- Proven track record integrating high-speed digital interfaces (e.g., DDR4, PCIe, multi-gig Ethernet, GMSL) at board level.
- Experience owning a board design end-to-end from requirements through production release.
- Ideally worked in mobile, edge-compute, or automotive-adjacent applications (robotics, autonomous vehicles, drones, mobile AI platforms).
- Hands-on schematic capture and PCB layout skills (Altium, OrCAD, or equivalent).
- Strong understanding of signal integrity fundamentals.
- Demonstrated ability to manage supplier and partner relationships and drive sourcing decisions.
- Comfortable defining priorities, timelines, and trade-offs for a board development project.
- Strong problem-solving skills and ability to debug high-speed interfaces during bring-up.
- Master’s degree or higher in Electrical Engineering, Electronics, or a closely related field.

Preferred qualifications

- Experience with NVIDIA Jetson, Orin, or Drive platform carrier board design.
- Signal integrity simulation experience (eye-diagram analysis, S-parameter extraction).
- Familiarity with automotive-grade design requirements (temperature range, vibration, component qualification).
- Experience with power delivery design for high-current GPU modules.
- Knowledge of thermal management integration at PCB level.
- EMC/EMI pre-compliance testing experience.

descriptionHtml:
Als Nachwuchsführungskraft wirst du in unserem 11-wöchigen internen Onboarding Programm auf deine neue Aufgabe als Führungskraft vorbereitet.
Nach dieser umfangreichen Einarbeitung übernimmst du Führungsverantwortung für dein eigenes Team und sorgst dafür, dass unsere Kunden Ihre Waren pünktlich und in guter Qualität erhalten. In dieser Position bist du wichtiger Teil unseres globalen Unternehmens und arbeitest Hand in Hand mit deinen Mitarbeitenden vor Ort. Zudem arbeitest du standortübergreifend an Themen wie Arbeitssicherheit, Prozessoptimierung, Nachhaltigkeit und technischem Fortschritt.


Key job responsibilities
- Sicherstellung der Einhaltung der Arbeitssicherheitsvorschriften und des Umweltschutzes
- Ableitung von Handlungsempfehlungen und konkreten Maßnahmen zur Prozessverbesserung auf Basis von Kennzahlen wie Arbeitssicherheit, Produktivität und Qualität
- Leitung und Weiterbildung eines Teams (bis zu 100 Mitarbeitende)

- Teilnahme in übergeordneten Projekten zur Optimierung der Kundenzufriedenheit
- Effektives Ressourcen- und Workflowmanagement
- Zusammenarbeit mit den vor- und nachgelagerten Abteilungen vor Ort

A day in the life
Du arbeitest in einer unserer Schichten (Früh-, Spät- oder Nachtschicht). Dabei ist das Einhalten der Sicherheitsstandards an deinem gesamten Standort für dich höchste Priorität. Als Schichtleitung führst du routinemäßig Teammeetings durch und führst Feedbackgespräche mit deinen Mitarbeitenden und deinen Stakeholdern. Mit Hilfe von Datenauswertungen nimmst Du Einfluss auf die Produktivität und die Qualität deines Standortes. Als wichtiges Mitglied des Teams vor Ort arbeitest Du mit anderen Abteilungen, sowie externen Stakeholdern zusammen und sorgst dafür, dass wir die Anforderungen unserer Kundschaft, ebenso wie unsere eigenen Vorgaben jederzeit erfüllen. Durch die Analyse von Daten mit Führungskräften und die Besprechung der betrieblichen Vor- und Nachteile von technischen Verbesserungen mit den Fachabteilungen trägst du zu „best in class“ Lösungen bei.

About the team
Die Logistikabteilung bei Amazon (AMZL) ist für die „Last-Mile-Logistik“ zuständig – also die Auslieferung unserer Pakete in Partnerschaft mit Drittanbietern. Wir denken kreativ und realisieren Initiativen zur kontinuierlichen Verbesserung, um Millionen von physischen Produkten an unsere Kund:innen zu liefern. Unser Ziel ist es, das Liefererlebnis für unsere Kund:innen so reibungslos wie möglich zu machen und globale Lieferlösungen für unsere neuesten Angebote einzuführen, darunter Amazon Fresh, Prime Now und Amazon Restaurants.
Diese Tätigkeiten werden von zwei Mitarbeitergruppen ausgeführt. Unsere „internen“ Mitarbeitenden bereiten Millionen von Produkten auf den Versand an unsere Lieferteams vor. Unser Team ist menschenorientiert und hilfsbereit. Das ist besonders wichtig, weil viele unserer Mitarbeitenden in Nachtschichten arbeiten. Unser Fokus liegt vorwiegend auf dem operativen Betrieb. An den meisten unserer Standorte wird rund um die Uhr gearbeitet.
Unsere „Außendienst“-Mitarbeitenden arbeiten währenddessen mit Amazon Flex – einem Auftragnehmer-Netzwerk für die Lieferung. Jedes Jahr setzen wir neue Maßstäbe in puncto Kundenerlebnis und bieten neue, innovative Lieferdienste an. Wir suchen nach neuen Möglichkeiten, um branchenweite Logistikherausforderungen zu überwinden, sowie nach neuen Ideen, um unseren CO2-Fußabdruck zu reduzieren. Ein Fuhrpark innovativer Fahrzeuge (einschließlich E-Fahrzeugen) und modernste Technologie unterstützen uns dabei.

title: Data Center Facility Manager II- Nights
descriptionHtml:
Join our dynamic team and become a critical technical leader who ensures the heartbeat of our global infrastructure remains strong and resilient. In this pivotal role, you'll be the guardian of our data center operations, driving reliability and performance while optimizing operational efficiency across complex technical environments.

Data Center Facility Manger role acts as Amazon’s front line when it comes to hands-on electrical and mechanical equipment troubleshooting. They will maintain, operate, and troubleshoot mission-critical data center facility equipment including electrical support equipment such as stand-by diesel generators and related fuel systems, 3 phase electrical systems that include but not limited to switchgear, UPS units, PDUs, and wet cell batteries and associated systems. Mechanical equipment includes CRAC units, centrifugal chillers, cooling towers/water chemical systems, air handlers and associated systems, pumps, and motors. Additional support equipment is included in the scope of the role which includes fire suppression systems, building automation systems, and general facilities equipment.

AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

Effective May 15, 2017, logical access to the AWS GovCloud region will be restricted to Amazon employees who are U.S. Citizens. (GovCloud may NOT be accessed from outside of the United States)

Key job responsibilities
- Oversee all aspects of the data center's critical infrastructure. Ensure that all work performed within the space is done to high quality and without impact to internal/external customers
- Oversee the safety, security, availability, quality, and performance of the team, while driving a positive customer experience across multiple shift schedules
- Manage teams of 24x7 engineering technicians and Facility Managers in all facets of their career
- Engage in improvement projects, often requiring reaching out to a variety of support teams, and drive them from conception to completion
- Ensure staffing levels are maintained and grow with expansions
- Be actively involved in ongoing construction activities
- Coordinate daily with a multitude of third-party vendors ensuring adherence to contracted SLAs
- Effectively and efficiently manage the operations budget and expenditures

Basic qualifications

- 5+ years of in a managerial/supervisory role with 5 or more direct reports experience
- 3+ years of electrical or mechanical experience
- 3+ years of engineering, installation, or startup/commissioning of electrical and mechanical systems experience

Preferred qualifications

- Knowledge of the electrical and mechanical systems involved in critical data center operations including systems such as feeders, transformers, generators, switchgear, UPS systems, ATS units, PDU units, chillers, pumps, air handling units, and CRAC units
- Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or a related field, or 3+ years of relevant work in a data center or other critical environment experience
- Experience communicating technical details verbally and in writing
- Can work in cramped spaces or in elevated locations while adhering to health & safety guidelines
- Experience conducting interviews and making effective hiring decisions

title: Senior Machine Learning Engineer, Sustainability Science and Innovation
descriptionHtml:
Join us at the forefront of Amazon's sustainability initiatives to work on environmental and social advancements to support Amazon's long term worldwide sustainability strategy. At Amazon, we're working to be the most customer-centric company on earth. To get there, we need exceptionally talented, bright, and driven people.

The Worldwide Sustainability (WWS) organization capitalizes on Amazon’s scale and speed to build a more resilient and sustainable company. We manage our social and environmental impacts globally, and drive solutions that enable our customers, businesses, and the world to become more sustainable.

We are looking for an engineer to build the software and infrastructure that help scientists develop, evaluate, and deploy machine learning models for sustainability applications. You will work directly with applied scientists, turning production-grade science artifacts into reliable systems and building reusable tools that reduce the engineering work required for each new model.

The work spans research workflows and production systems: preparing data for experiments, automating training and evaluation, and making models available through dependable interfaces. A central design challenge is deciding what the platform should handle consistently and where researchers need flexibility. Good abstractions let scientists change a model or transformation without rebuilding the surrounding infrastructure, while keeping the underlying system accessible when something needs to be understood or fixed.

You will also develop interfaces and workflows that support AI-assisted engineering. This includes making platform capabilities understandable to coding agents and building checks that verify their changes before those changes reach production.

Key job responsibilities
- Build reusable data and ML infrastructure. Develop libraries, configuration-driven interfaces, and infrastructure-as-code components for data processing, model training, and inference.

- Build tools for repeatable experiments and model comparisons, preserving the data, code, and configuration needed to investigate results.

- Develop and evaluate AI-assisted workflows. Create tooling that helps coding agents use the platform correctly. Assess their output through automated checks and appropriate review, and measure whether the workflows improve engineering productivity without weakening reliability.

- Support adoption and evolution. Work with platform users to identify recurring needs, document design trade-offs, and maintain compatibility as shared components change.

About the team
Our team brings together applied scientists and engineers to develop models and software for sustainability applications. We work across research and production, building both scientific methods and the systems needed to use them reliably. That combination keeps platform development close to the practical needs of researchers and the people who depend on their models.

We build reusable tools so that each new research project does not require its own infrastructure. The engineering challenge is to make experimentation easier while preserving the checks and evidence needed to understand results and operate models in production. Scientists and engineers work together on those decisions, including where a shared approach helps and where a scientific problem requires something different.

Basic qualifications

- 5+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
- 5+ years of programming with at least one software programming language experience
- 5+ years of leading design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
- Experience as a mentor, tech lead or leading an engineering team

Preferred qualifications

- 5+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience
- Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent

title: Delivery Station Customer Service Associate, DSL
descriptionHtml:
At Amazon, our mission is to be Earth’s most customer-centric company. To achieve this goal, we strive to exceed expectations by innovating and providing best-in-class customer support as we expand our logistics products and services including improving how we fulfill and deliver customer orders. We’re making history and the good news is that we’ve only just begun. At Amazon you get to Work with smart, passionate people who are building new products and services every day on behalf of our customers.

As a Delivery Station Customer Service Associate, you will help improve the customer experience by providing in station real-time, hands-on support to ensure our customers receive their packages on time, as promised. The role will also help connect customers with experts who can provide them the most accurate and up-to-date information about their packages. The work is beyond fulfilling and delivering customer orders; it’s making sure we put smiles on customer’s faces.

Key job responsibilities
As a Delivery Station Customer Service Associate, you will be responsible for:

- Communicating with customers directly in-person, in addition to communicating via phone and email
- Empathizing with and prioritizing customer needs
- Upholding company values and respecting every customer
- Resolving issues and setting appropriate expectations with customers
- Clearly understanding and responding appropriately to the issues that customers present
- Consistently composing grammatically correct, concise, and accurate written responses to customer issues
- Approaching problems logically and with good judgment to ensure the appropriate customer outcome
- Making quick and effective decisions on behalf of the customer
- Working a flexible Full-Time (40+ hours per week) schedule


Performing the following tasks, with or without reasonable accommodation:

- Carry, lift, push and pull up to 49 pounds
- Frequently push, pull, squat, bend and reach
- Stand and walk during shifts lasting up to 12 hours
- Work in an environment where the noise level varies and can be loud (hearing protection will be provided)
- Work in an environment where the temperature may vary due to outside weather conditions and is not controlled

A day in the life
You’ll be based at one of our last-mile delivery warehouses, where Amazon’s leading logistics system operates. As orders are dispatched and delivered, you’ll be in contact with our warehouse, associates, delivery partners and customers when they need guidance. Where a customer needs to reschedule a delivery, you’ll be informing our delivery partners. Where you notice a delivery issue, you’ll get to work resolving it straight away, so that our customers get a great experience every time without having to contact Amazon.

Operating at the heart of Amazon’s logistics, you’ll develop logistical and customer expertise that sets Amazon apart. You’ll connect with our customers every day, using your in-depth understanding of our supply chain and local knowledge of delivery connections and warehouses.

About the team
Our mission is to be Earth’s most customer-centric company, and few departments have as direct an impact on that mission as our Customer Service team. We're an inclusive team who empower and look after our people, so they have the time and energy to focus on our customers’ happiness. Our goal is to reduce customer effort every way we can, helping them get the best results quickly and efficiently. We support our self-service channels to offer expert insights into our customers’ most complex issues.

Within Customer Service, there are opportunities in process improvement, customer experience, data analysis and customer retention. The CS team is always looking for ways to make Amazon’s customer service even better, and we need excellent people to make that happen.

Basic qualifications

- High school or equivalent
- Experience in Customer Service
- Experience working with computers and Microsoft Office (including Outlook, Word, and Excel)
- Experience prioritizing and managing time effectively in dynamic environments
- Experience working with computer and web based tools

Preferred qualifications

- Bachelor's degree or equivalent
- Experience in understanding performance metrics and developing them to measure progress against key performance indicators
- Experience with written and verbal communication and presentation
- Experience working on a merchandising/brand ambassador team for a nationally recognized consumer brand

title: Senior Applied Scientist
descriptionHtml:
At Audible, we believe stories have the power to transform lives. It’s why we work with some of the world’s leading creators to produce and share audio storytelling with our millions of global listeners. We are dreamers and inventors who come from a wide range of backgrounds and experiences to empower and inspire each other. Imagine your future with us.

ABOUT THIS ROLE
As a Senior Applied Scientist, you will solve large complex real-world problems at scale, draw inspiration from the latest science and technology to empower undefined/untapped business use cases, delve into customer requirements, collaborate with tech and product teams on design, and create production-ready models that span various domains, including Machine Learning (ML), Artificial Intelligence (AI) and Generative AI, Natural Language Processing (NLP), Reinforcement Learning (RL), real-time and distributed systems.

ABOUT YOU
Your work will focus on inventing and extending scientific approaches, models, and algorithms driven by customer needs at the product level, framing new research problems even when the problem is ill-defined and no textbook solution exists. You will lead the design, implementation, and delivery of scientifically complex, end-to-end solutions that are deployed into production, defining system-level requirements and writing a significant portion of the critical-path code. You will develop reusable science components and services that resolve architecture deficiencies and customers’ pain points, while making technical trade-offs for long-term/short-term. You will work independently with limited guidance, and your decision-making will consistently incorporate robust, data-driven business and technical judgment. You will drive your team’s scientific agenda, author internal or external peer-reviewed publications that validate the novelty of your work, mentor and develop other scientists, and build consensus across multiple teams. You will have the opportunity to innovate, invent, and think big, and influence the experiences of millions of customers. We are looking for a results-oriented Senior Applied Scientist with deep expertise in ML, NLP, Deep Learning, GenAI, and/or large-scale distributed computation.

As an Applied Scientist, you will...
- Understand complex, ambiguous use cases across the business and adopt/extend/design/invent solutions/models that are scalable, efficient, and automated, where neither the problem nor the solution is well defined
- Work closely with fellow scientists and software engineers (at Audible and Amazon) to build and productionize models, and deliver novel and highly impactful features
- Review models of peers for the purpose of reducing and managing risk to the business, while improving customer experience
- Lead the design, development, and production deployment of scientifically complex, end-to-end solutions for Content Understanding, Recommendations, and GenAI-based product features, defining system-level requirements
- Drive and lead initiatives that employ the most recent advances in ML/AI/GenAI, drive your team’s scientific agenda, and author peer-reviewed publications
- Mentor and grow scientists on the team and across Amazon, and push the boundary of innovation

ABOUT AUDIBLE
Audible is the leading producer and provider of audio storytelling. We spark listeners’ imaginations, offering immersive, cinematic experiences full of inspiration and insight to enrich our customers daily lives. We are a global company with an entrepreneurial spirit. We are dreamers and inventors who are passionate about the positive impact Audible can make for our customers and our neighbors. This spirit courses throughout Audible, supporting a culture of creativity and inclusion built on our People Principles and our mission to build more equitable communities in the cities we call home.

Basic qualifications

- Experience working with Data & AI related technologies, including, but not limited to, AI/ML, GenAI, Analytics, Database, and/or Storage
- Experience in developing and deploying LLMs in production on GPUs, Neuron, TPU or other AI acceleration hardware, or experience in machine learning, data mining, information retrieval, statistics or natural language processing
- PhD plus 5+ years of research experience, or a Master’s degree plus 10+ years of research experience in one of the following disciplines: Machine Learning, Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Data Science, Applied Math, or a related quantitative field
- 5+ years of experience in Deep Learning, Natural Language Processing/Understanding, GenAI and/or Reinforcement Learning
- Experience with Python, SQL, other scripting languages
- Experience delivering science solutions into production systems

Preferred qualifications

- 3+ years of building machine learning models or developing algorithms for business application experience
- Author of publications at top-tier peer-reviewed conferences or journals, cited by other scientists
- Experience with building Recommendation Systems and/or large-scale content understanding systems
- Experience with large-scale online experimentation / A/B testing to validate science solutions in production
- Machine Learning Pipeline orchestration with AWS (SageMaker, Batch, Lambda, Step Functions) or similar cloud platforms
- Experience with Agile Software Development, and programming in at least one compiled language such as Java, C++, C#
- Experience mentoring scientists and leading science/design reviews across teams, and domain knowledge of comparable products (digital, retail)

title: Security Engineer, AI Security
descriptionHtml:
Join the team that helps protect the Amazon and our customers. The scale of Amazon and diversity of customers means your work would have far-reaching impacts across a broad range of industries around the world.

Our highly collaborative, global team thrives on flexibility and is committed to each team member's growth regardless of where they are. If you want to grow your interest in AI/ML services like Amazon Bedrock, SageMaker, generative AI, large language models, and responsible AI - we're right here on the journey with you.

The Amazon AI Security team is looking for a Security Engineer to design security controls and help validate that our AI/ML services, applications, and emerging technologies are designed and implemented to the highest security standards. Your responsibilities include analyzing the security of AI/ML applications and services, discovering and addressing security issues, building security automation, and decisively taking action to mitigate emerging threats throughout a full secure development life-cycle (SDLC).

This role will provide career growth opportunities as you gain new security skills in the course of your work. Security Engineers on the AI Security team have an opportunity to experiment, learn, build tools, and work with teams building new AI/ML technology and services at a massive scale. Security Engineers at all levels have the opportunity to learn from and be mentored by those who are building and securing our AI services. A Security Engineer is also expected to be a mentor for others and be a trusted security advisor within the organization.

A Security Engineer at Amazon is expected to make significant contributions to the AI Security team and to multiple groups throughout Amazon. Security Engineers are expected to develop custom solutions to complex security risk problems and apply appropriate technologies while following security engineering best practices. This role requires a Security Engineer who can be trusted within AI Security and by teams throughout Amazon on at least one knowledge domain, while being able to apply security engineering best practices in a broad range of technical areas.

A Security Engineer must demonstrate strong Amazon Leadership Principles. This role requires the ability to foster constructive dialogue and seek resolution when confronted with differing opinions on security risks. Engineers in this role are expected to participate fully in the planning of the AI Security team and constantly seek opportunities for process improvement.

A successful candidate will need a combination of troubleshooting, technical, and communication skills. An AI Security Engineer must have the ability to take ownership and deliver multiple complex objectives which may include project and software development work.

Your responsibilities will include:
- Security reviews for AI/ML products, technologies, and services.
- Secure design, architecture, and implementation of AI/ML systems.
- Secure development life-cycle (SDLC) practices including threat modeling and security testing.
- Influence decision-makers and stakeholders throughout the organization in multiple teams to achieve a consistently high security bar.
- Lead penetration testing engagements and create new testing methods and exploits.
- Create security guidance and documentation.
- Develop security tools and automation.
- Develop and deliver security training and outreach to internal development teams.
- Develop and improve metrics that drive desired behavior and security outcomes.
- Lead security projects (including security reviews, tool development, and creation of new security practices) with end-to-end ownership.
- Support for mentoring, team building and recruiting activities

Our team puts a high value on work-life balance. Striking healthy harmony between your personal and professional life is crucial to your happiness and success here, which is why we aren't focused on how many hours you spend at work or online. Instead, we're happy to offer a flexible schedule so you can have a more productive and well-balanced life—both in and outside of work.

We are dedicated to supporting new members. We have a broad mix of experience levels and tenures, and we're building an environment that celebrates knowledge sharing and mentorship. We care about your career growth and strive to assign projects based on interests and desired growth areas, supporting you as you take on more complex tasks while your skills and confidence grow.

Here at Amazon, we embrace our differences. We are committed to furthering our culture of inclusion. We have ten employee-led affinity groups, reaching 40,000 employees in over 190 chapters globally. We have innovative benefit offerings, and we host annual and ongoing learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon conferences. Amazon's culture of inclusion is reinforced within our 16 Leadership Principles, which remind team members to seek diverse perspectives, learn and be curious, and earn trust.

Key job responsibilities
• Collaborate and communicate effectively with experienced cross-disciplinary Amazonians to design, build, and operate innovative products and services that delight our customers, while participating in technical discussions to drive solutions forward.
• Design and develop scalable solutions using cloud-native architectures and microservices in a large distributed computing environment.
• Participate in code reviews and contribute to technical documentation.
• Build and maintain resilient distributed systems that are scalable, fault-tolerant, and cost-effective.
• Leverage and contribute to the development of GenAI and AI-powered tools to enhance development productivity while staying current with emerging technologies.
• Write clean, maintainable code following best practices and design patterns.
• Work in an agile environment practicing CI/CD principles while participating in operational responsibilities including on-call duties.
• Demonstrate operational excellence through monitoring, troubleshooting, and resolving production issues.

A day in the life
The challenges SDEs solve for at Amazon are big and influence millions of customers, sellers, and products around the world. We are looking for individuals who are passionate about creating new products, features, and services from scratch while managing ambiguity and the pace of a company where development cycles are measured in weeks, not years.

Amazon Security values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. Why Amazon Security?
At Amazon, security is central to maintaining customer trust and delivering delightful customer experiences. Our organization is responsible for creating and maintaining a high bar for security across all of Amazon’s products and services. We offer talented security professionals the chance to accelerate their careers with opportunities to build
experience in a wide variety of areas including cloud, devices, retail, entertainment, healthcare, operations, and physical stores.

title: Program Manager - Vendor Risk , Business Continuity Management (BCM)
descriptionHtml:
The Mission
Every day, hundreds of millions of e-commerce transactions happen across our global marketplace. Our job? Make sure sellers can trust this platform with their business and that trust never breaks, even when things go wrong.
We detect and prevent fraud at massive scale. We protect selling partners across dozens of countries. And when disruptions hit natural disasters, Tech/infrastructure failures, vendor outages, we keep operations running.

This role puts you at the center of that resilience.

What You'll Own: As the Program Manager for Business Continuity Management, you won't just maintain playbooks, you'll build the system that keeps a global operation standing when things break. Specifically, you'll:
- Architect business continuity plans across sites and vendors, including Single Point of Failure (SPOF) analysis and vendor exit strategies
- Lead incident response coordination — detection, triage, routing, escalation, and recovery during Sev2+ disruptions affecting thousands of employees globally
- Run tabletop exercises and readiness drills with operational POCs across multiple international sites
- Build governance frameworks for compliance, vendor risk, and operational resilience and expand their coverage across the organization
- Partner cross-functionally with risk, compliance, operations, and technology teams to close gaps before they become incidents
- Drive site capability analysis to identify vulnerabilities and design mitigation strategies that work at scale

What Makes This Role Different
- Real impact, not theoretical frameworks. You'll manage live incidents and lead the recovery in real time.
- Global scope. Your work spans SPIV sites
- You'll build from the ground up. This isn't a maintenance role. You're expanding coverage, creating new plans, and shaping how the organization thinks about resilience.
- Direct line to strategy. Your frameworks feed directly into organizational risk posture and operational planning.

The Team: We're a compact, high-ownership group embedded within Selling Partner Identity Verification operations. Our backgrounds are diverse, risk management, operations, program management, compliance and that's by design. Complex problems need different lenses. We run lean, move fast, and don't hide behind process for process's sake. If you want a role where your work is visible, your decisions matter, and you're not buried three layers deep in an org chart, this is it.

You'll Thrive Here If You
- Get energized by ambiguity and building structure where none exists
- Think in systems, connecting compliance, vendor risk, incident response, and operational continuity into a single resilience model
- Communicate crisply across levels, from analysts on the ground to senior leadership
- Have a bias for action, you'd rather run a 70% solution now and iterate than wait for perfection
- Bring experience in business continuity, incident management, risk management, or operational resilience (or a credible combination)


Key job responsibilities
• Spearhead, Design and execute Business Continuity strategy for manual, 3P vendors and API vendors, that set new standards for operational resilience focusing on effective response and recovery capabilities aligned with key metrics (RTO, RPO)
• Transform our global operational framework by eliminating single points of failure through strategic planning and creative solution design
• Lead cross-functional initiatives with Workforce Management, Global Process Strategy, Operations, and Leadership to build future-proof business models
• Orchestrate regular tabletop training and exercises to prepare R&C for disruptions of varying severity
• Leverage insights from drills, exercises, and real events to continuously improve our continuity programs
• Conduct thorough Business Impact Analyses (BIAs) and formulate exit strategies

title: Software Engineer- Annapurna Labs (Tel Aviv / Haifa, Annapurna Labs
descriptionHtml:
Annapurna Labs designs and builds the custom silicon and systems software that power Amazon Web Services at scale — including **Nitro** (the hardware and hypervisor platform behind every modern EC2 instance) and **Graviton** (Amazon's Arm-based server processors used by millions of customers worldwide).

We are looking for talented **graduate software engineers** to join our Nitro and Graviton systems software teams. This is a hands-on engineering role where you'll write low-level, high-performance software that runs directly on Amazon-designed chips — the kind of work where the code you write in your first year runs in production across the world's largest cloud. You'll be mentored by senior engineers, ramp up on real systems from day one, and grow into an expert in embedded and systems software.

If you love understanding how things work all the way down to the hardware, this is the team for you.

Key job responsibilities
- Design, develop, test, and debug embedded and systems software (firmware, drivers, low-level services) for Amazon's Nitro and Graviton platforms.

- Write and optimize code primarily in **C** and **C++**, working close to the hardware.

- Collaborate with hardware, silicon, and verification engineers to bring up new chips and platforms.

- Debug complex issues across the software/hardware boundary using logic analyzers, JTAG, and system-level tooling.

- Contribute to code reviews, design discussions, and the continuous improvement of our software and processes.

- Learn continuously — from senior engineers, from the systems, and from a fast-moving, high-ownership environment.

A day in the life
No two days look exactly alike, but a typical one might include:

- Picking up a task from your team's backlog — a new driver feature, a firmware bug, or a bring-up item on a new chip revision — and pairing with your mentor to scope it.

- Writing and reviewing C/C++ code, then running it on real Amazon-designed hardware in the lab (or on emulation/simulation before silicon arrives).

- Debugging an issue that spans the software/hardware boundary — reading logs, attaching a debugger over JTAG, or reasoning through a trace with a hardware engineer sitting next to you.

- Joining a design discussion or code review where your questions and ideas are genuinely wanted — junior engineers here are expected to think, not just execute.

- Wrapping up by pushing your change through CI and watching it move toward production that serves millions of AWS customers.


You'll start with plenty of support and a clear ramp-up plan, and take on more ownership as you grow. Learning is part of the job, every day — and you'll always have experienced engineers around you to learn from.

About the team
Why Annapurna Labs

- Work directly on the silicon and software that run **the world's largest cloud** — real scale, real impact, from your first months.

- Deep technical mentorship from some of the best systems and silicon engineers in the industry.

- A rare chance to work across the full stack — from transistors to hypervisors — in one place.

- A culture of ownership, learning, and building things that matter.

Basic qualifications

- - Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Computer/Electrical Engineering, or a related field
- - Solid programming foundations in **C** and/or **C++**.
- - Strong understanding of computer science fundamentals: data structures, algorithms, operating systems, and computer architecture.
- - Ability to read and write clear, correct, maintainable code.
- - Fluent English (written and spoken).

Preferred qualifications

- - Academic projects, internships, or personal projects involving embedded systems, firmware, device drivers, operating systems, or low-level programming.
- - Familiarity with Linux, the Linux kernel, or real-time operating systems (RTOS).
- - Exposure to computer architecture concepts (CPUs, memory hierarchies, virtualization) — Arm architecture a plus.
- - Experience with hardware/software co-development, debugging tools, or scripting (Python, shell).
- - Curiosity, ownership, and a strong desire to learn how systems work end to end.

title: SLAM Software Engineer, RIVR
descriptionHtml:
RIVR, an Amazon company, is building Physical AI by deploying autonomous robots for real-world doorstep delivery. Operating daily in diverse urban environments, RIVR's robots continuously learn from and navigate the millions of scenarios encountered during deliveries. By owning the full stack from software to hardware, RIVR is purpose-built for safety, reliability, and the customer from day one.

Our robots require precise and real-time localization, which they achieve by utilizing onboard sensors such as IMUs, lidar, cameras and GNSS. In environments without existing maps, the robot must dynamically create a map while simultaneously localizing itself within it. As our next SLAM Engineer on a growing team, you will be an expert in laser- and camera-based localization techniques and SLAM and enhance these capabilities. You will shape our robots’ ability to navigate with pinpoint precision, and you will be part of a team focused on enabling our robots to navigate autonomously. If you are passionate about robotics and driven to innovate in SLAM and localization, we encourage you to join us in shaping the future of intelligent robotics.

Key job responsibilities
Develop state-of-the-art, online and offline localization and SLAM algorithms by fusing information from cameras, LiDARs, IMU, GNSS, and other sensors.
Design, validate, and improve algorithms on challenging real-world data.

Contribute to the dynamic mapping of the environment using data continuously gathered from ongoing robot deployments.

Assist in the creation of robust sensor calibration systems that perform reliably in complex and unpredictable environments.

Support the development of an efficient workflow to accurately capture ground truth data, and maps of deployment sites for algorithm evaluation.

Contribute to the implementation of deployment-ready code for the real robot, optimized for the robot’s computational constraints.

Create and maintain documentation and best practices to streamline knowledge sharing.

Basic qualifications

- A minimum of 3 years of industry or research experience.
- Background in computer vision, robotics or autonomous driving, with experience in areas such as 3D visual or LiDAR SLAM, place recognition, structure from motion, filtering, or Bayesian estimation.
- Strong mathematical fundamentals including linear algebra, vector calculus, probability theory, and mathematical optimization.
- Ability to write production-level code in modern C++, and prototype efficiently in Python.
- Experience with deploying SLAM or localization algorithms on hardware platforms.
- Master’s degree in a relevant field such as Robotics, Machine Learning, Computer Science, or a similar discipline.

Preferred qualifications

- Experience with state of the art deep learning algorithms for SLAM and localization.
- Publications at top-tier conferences.
- Experience with ROS/ROS2.

title: Consumer Insights Manager (Japan), Prime Video
descriptionHtml:
Prime Video reaches hundreds of millions of customers across more than 240 countries and territories, offering the broadest selection of movies and TV shows — all on demand, at any time, on any device. As we continue to grow, understanding what our customers want to watch next is at the heart of everything we do.

The Prime Video APAC Programming & Insights team is looking for a Consumer Insights Manager to lead customer-focused primary and secondary research projects across the region. In this role, you will serve as a center of customer voice for Prime Video in APAC — working closely with cross-functional stakeholder teams to shape customer-obsessed content and business strategies. You will partner with regional counterparts to build a strong insights foundation, establish scalable research mechanisms, and deliver actionable insights that inform decisions on a daily basis.

This role is based in Tokyo and primarily owns the audience insights roadmap for Japan, while also contributing to wider APAC Insights initiatives.

This role requires independent ownership of research deliverables. The ideal candidate will bring deep experience across a wide range of consumer research methodologies — both quantitative and qualitative. They will have robust experience creating strategic, actionable business recommendations from complex datasets, and hands-on expertise managing primary customer research studies and navigating stakeholder needs. They will skillfully manage multiple competing priorities to ensure high-quality, timely delivery of research, and thrive as a self-starter in environments of change and ambiguity.



Key job responsibilities
- Own end-to-end management of bespoke and streamlined consumer research projects — from ideation through delivery — including writing RFPs and questionnaires, analyzing primary and secondary data, and reporting results to stakeholders.
- Lead in-depth studies and conduct meta-analyses to produce consolidated learnings that support mid- and long-term business strategy.
- Design and implement scalable research mechanisms that ensure consistent insights delivery, contextualized with broader entertainment industry trends.
- Build collaborative relationships with cross-functional teams across Prime Video and Amazon MGM Studios, partnering with stakeholders to design consumer-focused research plans aligned with business goals.
- Collaborate on internal team initiatives to standardize best practices, streamline processes, and enhance impact.
- Contribute to the team's operational planning, including roadmap prioritization and resource coordination.

A day in the life
Your days will be varied — you might start by hosting a kickoff call to align on the scope of an upcoming research study with cross-functional teams, then review and respond to an ad-hoc audience insights and data request. By midday, you could be attending an org-level business review to provide audience inputs on emerging business questions at both service and title levels. Afternoons might focus on analyzing ongoing streamlined study data and writing a full report with rigorous analysis accompanied by actionable recommendations. Throughout it all, you will balance operational precision with strategic thinking across multiple studies and initiatives concurrently running at different phases across Business Planning, Content, Marketing, and Programming — and represent and advocate for the Prime Video customer in all analyses and meetings.

About the team
This role sits within the APAC Regional Programming & Insights team. The Insights function owns the full audience insights remit at both regional and local levels — covering Australia/New Zealand, Japan, and Southeast Asia — and drives customer-obsessed decisions across Business Planning, Content, Marketing, and Programming. The team serves as a trusted, strategic partner for cross-functional stakeholders.

As part of a broader regional team with colleagues throughout APAC, you will benefit from shared best practices while driving impact for your local audiences and business — Japan.

Basic qualifications

- Speak, write, and read fluently in Japanese
- Speak, write, and read fluently in English
- 5+ years of professional experience in market research or consumer insights
- Hands-on experience leading primary research studies, including both quantitative (e.g., online surveys) and qualitative (e.g., focus groups, ethnographies) methodologies
- Experience creating and delivering research reports and executive summaries that translate data into actionable business recommendations
- Experience communicating research findings and recommendations to cross-functional teams

Preferred qualifications

- Experience in the entertainment industry
- Experience on the research vendor side or within the insights function of a media, entertainment, or consumer business company
- Experience presenting research results and recommendations to senior leadership
- Demonstrated ability to operate with significant autonomy in ambiguous environments
- Understanding of marketing, measurement, and insights frameworks (e.g., brand tracking, campaign effectiveness)
- Experience with applied statistics, predictive analytics, and mixed-methodology research

title: Sr. Product Manager
descriptionHtml:
Are you excited about shaping products that reach millions of customers? Do you thrive when translating complex problems into clear strategies and actionable roadmaps? As a Sr Product Manager, you will lead product development of key features in our product roadmap, drive key business metrics, and develop requirements for innovative products for our customers.

You will work backward from customer needs, define compelling product strategies, and partner with engineering, design, and cross-functional teams to deliver meaningful outcomes. This role offers the opportunity to tackle ambiguous challenges, make high-judgment decisions, and drive products from concept through launch and beyond. If you are a self-starter who combines analytical rigor with creative problem-solving, we want to hear from you.

Key job responsibilities
- Define product vision, strategy, and roadmap by working backward from customer needs, and using first-principles thinking to set clear priorities and make transparent trade-offs across competing demands.
- Drive cross-functional collaboration with engineering, design, science, finance, marketing, and operations partners to deliver exceptional customer experiences on time and with high quality.
- Leverage data, customer research, usage patterns, and market trends to inform product decisions, define success criteria and KPIs, and continuously refine your roadmap investments for maximum impact.
- Influence alignment across teams with different priorities by producing clear, concise documents and driving product discussions with leadership, building consensus without direct authority.
- Own end-to-end product launches, monitor operational health post-release, and iterate rapidly by applying generative AI tools and experimentation to accelerate learning cycles and unlock new forms of innovation.

A day in the life
You might start your morning reviewing customer feedback and usage metrics to validate a hypothesis you tested last week. By mid-morning, you are in a design review refining prototypes with your UX partner, ensuring every interaction is intuitive and simple. After lunch, you lead a roadmap prioritization discussion with engineering, weighing technical trade-offs against customer value. Later, you draft a strategy document for an upcoming product initiative, pulling insights from recent market research and stakeholder conversations. Throughout it all, you balance deep analytical work with collaborative problem-solving.

- Bachelor's degree or equivalent
- Proficiency in SQL and data analytics
- Experience building program/product and roadmap strategy, managing end to end delivery, and communicating results to senior stakeholders
- Experience owning/managing large program or projects

Preferred qualifications

- Experience in supply chain, ecommerce, operations or retail
- Experience in influencing senior leadership through data driven insights

title: Operations Manager
descriptionHtml:
Job summary
Our WW Operations network delivers millions of packages and smiles to Amazon customers every day. We are looking for motivated, customer-focused individuals who want to join our team as an Operations Manager. In this role, you will lead and develop a team of salaried and hourly talent. You will be responsible for engaging your team during their shifts to maintain the highest levels of safety, quality, attendance, and performance. To achieve this, managers are expected to provide their team with the tools needed for success while driving improvements in productivity and efficiency through data-driven decisions and analytical problem-solving. You will also play a key role in maintaining our customer expectations to ensure customer orders are delivered at the right time, to the right location.

Our Operation’s workflow has three major components: First mile - where the product is housed and ready for order; Middle mile - where the order is hauled to your area; and Last mile - when the product is delivered to the customer’s door. Please note that all workflows have slight building variations, but one thing is constant: our vision and dedication to the customer.

Our fulfillment network launches new Operations sites every year, providing various opportunities for your professional growth. We hire Operations Managers based on location preference and the business’ current openings.

title: Senior Program Manager, AMZL Field Support
descriptionHtml:
Amazon's middle mile network moves at massive scale, and the technology on every tractor and trailer keeps it running. We are looking for a Senior Program Manager to own the reliability and performance of critical fleet technology platforms deployed across our middle mile transportation network, keeping our fleet connected and packages moving. In this role you will manage complex repair programs, vendor performance, and cross-functional partnerships with product engineering teams, OEM partners, and service providers to maximize device uptime and operational readiness across our tractor, trailer, and intermodal fleet.

You will work backward from network needs to diagnose root causes of device failures, implement systematic repair strategies, and drive continuous improvement initiatives that strengthen fleet technology reliability. You will own vendor relationships, establish performance accountability mechanisms, and coordinate device strategy across transportation networks, aligning shared vendor relationships and measurement standards to unlock scale and consistency.

Key job responsibilities
- Own end-to-end device operations and repair program execution for critical fleet technology platforms across the middle mile tractor, trailer, and intermodal fleet, defining program strategy and driving teams inside and outside the organization to deliver
- Manage third-party vendor relationships and performance — including SLA enforcement, cost efficiency, and repair quality — while partnering with product engineering and OEM teams to diagnose systemic device failures and accelerate resolution
- Analyze device health and failure data to identify root causes, implement preventive maintenance strategies, and build reporting mechanisms that enable proactive issue identification and data-driven decisions
- Coordinate device repair strategy across transportation networks, aligning intake mechanisms, vendor relationships, and measurement standards to capture scale and reduce complexity
- Communicate program status, technical risks, and recommendations clearly to senior leadership through well-structured narratives and regular business reviews

A day in the life
You might start the morning reviewing overnight device health trends and triaging new failure reports with your engineering counterparts. By mid-morning you are on a call with a repair vendor, working through turnaround-time gaps and agreeing on corrective actions. After lunch you pull together data for a leadership review, translating repair metrics into a clear narrative about fleet readiness. Later you join a design review with the product team to weigh in on a hardware change that could reduce a recurring failure mode. Throughout the day you move between strategic planning and hands-on problem solving, keeping multiple programs on track.

About the team
The Middle Mile Fleet Technology team is responsible for keeping Amazon's fleet technology running reliably at scale. We sit at the intersection of hardware engineering, service operations, and vendor management, and our work directly affects delivery performance across the network.

We are a collaborative group that values clear thinking, practical solutions, and a willingness to get into the details. If you enjoy solving complex operational problems and want to see the real-world impact of your work every day, this is a great place to be.

Basic qualifications

- 5+ years of program or project management experience
- Experience using data and metrics to determine and drive improvements
- Experience owning program strategy, end to end delivery, and communicating results to senior leadership

Preferred qualifications

- 2+ years of driving process improvements experience
- Master's degree, or MBA in business, operations, human resources, adult education, organizational development, instructional design or related field
- Knowledge of general AI tools
- Experience designing, implementing, and scaling upskilling, apprenticeship, or workforce development programs across large-scale operations or corporate environments, including forecasting workforce needs and leveraging analytics to drive program decisions

title: Strategic Account Manager, US Global Selling Team
descriptionHtml:
We are seeking a candidate with a passion for e-commerce and a desire to make a real impact on global customers in a Day One business. Our mission is to expand selection from US-based retailers and brand owners worldwide. Although we are already a multi-billion-dollar business, we believe we are just getting started, as less than 5% of US-based sellers have started their international journey. This role offers the opportunity to innovate and elevate the seller and customer experience on a global scale.
As a Strategic Account Manager on the Amazon Global Selling team, you will work with top Amazon.com sellers, helping them expand their online retail business to Amazon's stores worldwide. You will work with sellers leadership teams, identifying key decision-makers and aligning them to prioritize actions required to expand their online retail business to Amazon's global stores such as Amazon.co.uk, Amazon.de, Amazon.com.mx. You will build and cultivate strong relationships with sellers in your portfolio and be a trusted e-commerce and global sales advisor to the leadership in seller organizations. You will partner with external service providers to help your sellers obtain the required tax and product-level compliance certifications for selling in new markets. You will be comfortable with long sales cycles, often lasting more than 8 months, taking sellers through step-by-step processes to launch in a new market. Success in this role will be evaluated based on the scale of the sellers you manage, the number of new markets into which you help your sellers expand, unique selection additions in global markets, and the global sales revenue you drive from sellers in your portfolio. You will utilize a wide range of sales and negotiation skills and work across cross-functional areas to drive the performance of sellers in your portfolio.
In addition to your day-to-day role working with sellers, you will also contribute to business development and identify the correct input metrics that drive business growth for sellers in Amazon's global stores. You will use customer feedback, market growth trends, competitive best practices, and Gen AI developments to suggest new features required in our products and promotional programs to accelerate seller growth or improve the selling partner experience.
Ideal candidates will thrive in an ambiguous and dynamic environment where they must develop, evolve, and implement business strategies to deliver results, have relentlessly high standards, and operate as business owners with end-to-end responsibility to deliver business growth.


Key job responsibilities
• Build strong relationships with CXO-level stakeholders in sellers' organizations to drive decisions and actions required to launch sellers' businesses on Amazon's global online stores.
• Pitch CXO-level stakeholders on the benefits of selling their products on Amazon's global online stores in Europe, Asia, and South America.
• Guide sellers through the step-by-step process for global account registration, KYC, tax and product compliance, etc.
• Provide ongoing post-launch support on selection expansion, deals, sponsored ads, etc., to help sellers grow sales on Amazon's global stores.
• Prepare and conduct monthly business reviews with CXO stakeholders in sellers' organizations regarding progress and strategies to increase their revenue on Amazon's global websites.
• Collaborate with cross-functional stakeholders and program leaders to drive business growth.
• Pilot new initiatives and iterate the existing best practices to improve productivity and impact.
• Identify automation opportunities for manual tasks and partner with Gen AI product team to scale automation across our WW global selling team.


About the team
The Amazon Global Selling team's vision is to be the first choice for all US retail businesses to go global. We operate with the agility of a startup and a singular mission to empower US-based sellers to expand their businesses worldwide. We are committed to building an AI-native, agentic organization — one where AI agents increasingly handle execution at breadth and speed, while our account management team owns the strategy, the deep insights, the judgment, and the outcomes. The US Global Selling (USGS) team owns the full business lifecycle of North American sellers, expanding them into 20 global markets. Our mission is to make US selections available to customers worldwide. We're dedicated to simplifying global expansion and international selling for US-based sellers, working closely with them on both tech and non-tech aspects of product, supply chain, compliance, and international logistics.

- Experience prospecting, qualifying, and cold-calling companies

- Experience with sales targets, business development, and driving customer satisfaction

- Experience with pipeline management skills to include utilization of Salesforce or other CRM tools
- Experience and track record of exceeding sales goals
- Experience in a client facing consultative role working with large, complex enterprise customers
- Experience analyzing large datasets and translating them to actionable business insight

title: WHS Officer
descriptionHtml:
The WHS Officer will partner directly with site operations teams (First Mile/Middle Mile/Last The WHS Officer will partner directly with site operations teams (First Mile/Middle Mile/Last Mile) to implement company safety policies, ensure compliance with all local and regional regulations, and maintain a secure, healthful work environment. Leveraging lean principles and kaizen methodologies, this individual contributor will independently lead continuous improvement initiatives to mitigate conditional and ergonomic risks in processes, utilizing comprehensive risk assessments and safety data analysis to influence operational changes. The role requires good communication skills to deliver clear, consistent messages verbally and in writing, train Operations Leaders on safety protocols, and integrate best practices into company standards. Proven ability in teamwork, analytical thinking, sound judgment, and customer-focused problem-solving is essential to effectively collaborate across functions and drive meaningful safety outcomes. The WHS Officer will apply expertise in safety programs, environmental compliance, and ergonomics to support site teams, ensuring adherence to Amazon's safety frameworks while driving a culture of proactive risk management and operational excellence.

Key job responsibilities
Ensure compliance with Amazon Safety Policies, standards, and applicable local/regional/national regulations through direct guidance and oversight.
• Support assigned site(s) in implementing Amazon WHS procedures as directed by WHS leadership.
•Partner with site stakeholders to drive compliance with WHS standards, procedures, and local laws.
• Conduct comprehensive site walks engaging associates on hazard observation, coaching on WHS requirements, ergonomic postures, and Permit to Work compliance.
• Conduct frequent site safety inspections and audits to identify non-compliant equipment or processes.
• Complete area readiness checks for the Wellness Room and replenish supplies as needed.
• Conduct risk assessments for all processes and update them for change management at defined frequencies.
• Implement corrective solutions to eliminate risks and prevent injuries across facilities.
• Initiate corrective actions for findings identified during standard work implementation.
• Analyze weekly/monthly/quarterly safety metrics and incident trends to prioritize resource allocation to high-risk areas.
• Measure site performance against safety policy requirements and develop action plans to address deficiencies.
• Complete assigned tasks and stretch assignments to advance site safety goals.
• Assist in conducting safety inductions, toolbox talks, and awareness programs.
• Coach associates on new/existing WHS requirements and their operational impact.
• Promote a proactive safety culture through engagement and collaboration with stakeholders to resolve safety barriers.
• Maintain all records related to safety operations (regulatory/non regulatory inspections, audits, SOPs).
• Support the site safety manager in timely reporting of compliance status to leadership.
• Implement Kaizen or other initiatives to strengthen workplace conditions and safety performance.
• Deliver on-time, high-quality projects to support Operations teams.
• Collaborate with site operations and WHS leadership to address day-to-day risks and escalate compliance issues through inspections/audits.
• Complete peak readiness actions, provide updates, and contribute to lesson-learned sessions.
• We have a 5-day work week but given the 7 days a week operation, the 2 scheduled days off will vary based on shift patterns and business needs.
• For roles in last-mile and Amazon Fresh sites, manage multiple small sites within a city as required.

A day in the life
Daily Deep Dive of metrics, Site safety audit / inspections, Incident reporting and investigation, Training, TBT, FGDs, Startups at site, AWHS committee meeting, Communication on required safety matters, Safety compliance adherence with respect to Amazon WHS Policies and procedures, PPE issuance and compliance, Risk Assessment, Inventory management and procurement of safety supplies. 

About the team
Workplace, Health & Safety - Amazon India Operations

Basic qualifications

- Speak, write, and read fluently in English
- Bachelor's degree in science or equivalent
- 2+ years of experience in Workplace Health and Safety

Preferred qualifications

- A Health and Safety NVQ Level 3 or NEBOSH National General Certificate (or equivalent), or NEBOSH (National General Certificate)
- Experience in a fast paced, changing/growing organization
- Experience implementing lean principles and process improvement in an operational environment.
- Fulfillment Center or Manufacturing Safety experience with mix of exempt and non-exempt employees at a site of at least 200 people preferred.
- Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including comfort interfacing with site leaders.

descriptionHtml:

Since opening our virtual doors in 1995, we’ve been pushing the boundaries of ‘possible’ further and further.
