title: Technical Program Manager, Fauna
descriptionHtml:
Fauna Robotics is looking for a Technical Program Manager to own quality for robot behavior and data collection. You will write and maintain the test suite that every release and every new policy goes through. That suite has two layers. The first is a core set of regression tests that confirms, every time, that the robot's locomotion, manipulation, mode transitions, and autonomy hand-offs still behave as expected. The second, and harder, layer goes looking for the subtle problems a routine pass will miss: failures that appear only in particular sequences of events, under particular loads, or in the interaction between the operator, the teleoperation stack, and the robot. You will run these tests yourself on experimental hardware, write clear and reproducible reports, and work with the engineering teams until each issue is understood and resolved.

You will also help keep the data we collect at a high quality through hands-on, on-site work with the robots: supporting benchmark collections, reviewing recorded episodes, and tracking data problems back to their root cause, whether that's the operator, the teleoperation stack, the robot, or the pipeline. As new collection tasks come out of research, you'll pilot them on hardware with the data scientists who designed them, validate the tools and methods they depend on, and say whether they're ready to run at scale. You'll be the go-to person for bringing new data collectors and QA team members up to speed on our teleoperation stack, our data collection management and ingestion tools, and the basics of finding, triaging, and reporting bugs.

Key job responsibilities
- Own the release test suite for robot behavior and teleoperation. Write, maintain, and run test plans for updates to the teleoperation stack, internal and external software releases, and new robot policies.

- Maintain a repeatable core regression suite that every change must pass, and extend it with deeper, adversarial test cases designed to surface subtle, intermittent, or interaction-dependent failures across the operator, the teleoperation stack, and the robot.

- Run tests hands-on with experimental robots and in simulation. Write detailed, reproducible test reports and bug reports, and give clear go/no-go recommendations for each release and each new policy.

- Track issues through to resolution with software, controls, hardware, and ML teams. Keep a record of known issues, how to reproduce them, and workarounds.

- Support data quality through hands-on, on-robot testing: help run benchmark collections, review recordings against task requirements, flag problem episodes, and feed the failure patterns you find back to the teams that own the process and tooling.

- Pilot new data collection tasks alongside data scientists and research engineers: translate research intent into an executable protocol, run the first sessions yourself, and report back on feasibility, throughput, and data quality.

- Validate the data collection tools and methods behind each task before they're relied on at scale — define acceptance criteria, quantify failure modes, and make the go/no-go call. Iterate on task setups, scene design, and annotation schemas where the data doesn't hold up.

- Onboard and mentor new data collectors and QA team members on our teleoperation stack, the data collection management system, the ingestion and annotation tools, and how to report bugs well.

- Coordinate the day-to-day test and benchmark activities that data collectors take part in. Work with the data collection program manager, who owns the data collectors' work and priorities, to schedule robot time, sessions, and test coverage.

- Assess the spaces and resources that testing and collection depend on — lab and home-like environments, robot availability, headsets and peripherals, fixtures and props — and flag what's missing before it becomes a bottleneck.

Keep test documentation, checklists, SOPs, and run books up to date as the robot, the app, and our policies change.

Work safely around experimental hardware, and hold the people you train to the same standard.

About the team
Fauna Robotics, an Amazon company, is building capable, safe, and genuinely delightful robots for everyday life. Our goal is simple: make robots people actually want to live and interact with in everyday human spaces.
We believe that future won’t arrive until building for robotics becomes far more accessible. Today, too much effort is spent reinventing the fundamentals. We’re changing that by developing tightly integrated hardware and software systems that make it faster, safer, and more intuitive to create real-world robotic products.
Our work spans the full stack: mechanical design, control systems, dynamic modeling, and intelligent software. The focus is not just functionality, but experience. We’re building robots that feel responsive, expressive, and genuinely useful.
At Fauna, you’ll work at the frontier of this space, helping define how robots move, manipulate, and interact with people in natural environments. It’s an opportunity to solve hard problems across hardware and software with a team focused on making robotics accessible and joyful to build.
If you care about making robotics real for everyone and building systems that are as delightful as they are capable, we’re interested in hearing from you.

Basic qualifications

- 3+ years of technical product or program management experience
- Experience managing programs across cross functional teams, building processes and coordinating release schedules
- 3+ years of experience in quality assurance, test, or validation of hardware or hardware-plus-software products (robotics, consumer electronics, automotive, aerospace, XR, or similar), or in technical program management for such products
- Experience writing and running structured test plans and SOPs, and producing detailed, reproducible test and bug reports with logs, timestamps, media, and system context
- Experience working hands-on with physical robots or other experimental hardware in a lab or test environment, including diagnosing failures that span hardware, firmware, and software
- Experience teleoperating robots, or extensive hands-on use of VR/XR headsets
- Linux and command-line proficiency — able to run scripts and terminal tooling to drive, inspect, and debug hardware directly
- Able to work in a VR headset for extended sessions (multiple hours at a time) and to work safely around experimental robots, which includes standing, moving, and occasionally lifting equipment
- Able to lift up to 10 lbs and wear equipment weighing up to 30 lbs; continuous hand/eye coordination, fine manipulation, and kinesthetic awareness
- Experience training, onboarding, or mentoring others on technical tools or processes
- Ability to write technical documentation precise enough for an operator or support agent to follow without the author present

Preferred qualifications

- 3+ years of working directly with engineering teams experience
- Experience teleoperating robots with a Meta Quest 3 (or a similar VR teleoperation setup)
- Experience with robot learning data collection, such as demonstration data, episode annotation, or dataset quality review
- Experience validating robot control or learned policies on hardware before release
- Experience leading QA across a hardware, firmware, and software product ecosystem, including fleet-level validation testing and catching performance regressions before release
- Python scripting for hardware control; firmware flashing and diagnostic interfaces; electromechanical diagnostics (motors, sensors, thermal systems)
- Experience using LLMs or AI coding tools to build simple internal tools such as dashboards, web UIs, or report generators to speed up QA work
- Familiarity with issue trackers and test management tools, and with reading logs or telemetry to narrow down a failure
- Experience coordinating the daily work of operators or test technicians without being their direct manager
- Experience owning production incidents or executive escalations end-to-end in unfamiliar system architecture
- Experience running observational research or usability studies and translating interaction data into product direction
- Background in robotics, HRI, data operations, or games

title: Sr. Software Dev Engineer, Corporate Development Finance
descriptionHtml:
The Investment Management System (IMS) is the system of record for Amazon's corporate investment and warrant portfolios — more than $200 billion in value across 700+ positions, spanning minority investments, the four corporate funds, and commercial-activity warrants. IMS serves teams across the Mergers & Acquisitions (M&A) ecosystem, including Corporate Development, Business Development, Accounting, Tax, Legal, and Treasury.

When someone needs to know what a holding is worth today, how much of a warrant Amazon has earned through its commercial deals, or simply what Amazon owns and what it's worth, IMS is where they get the answer. IMS data feeds directly into Amazon's financial statements and supports real-time investment decisions, so accuracy and timeliness are non-negotiable. A core part of this role is keeping IMS accurate, trustworthy, and current — continuously ingesting new deals and milestones, and integrating and regularly reconciling with other internal and external systems (Amazon Lantern, Accounting, Tax, Legal, Treasury, Factset).

We are a small, high-ownership technical team with a unique organizational structure: we sit within a larger finance team. This is a deliberate decision to embed technical expertise directly alongside finance partners, enabling rapid collaboration, troubleshooting, and delivery. As a result, this role requires close, effective collaboration and communication with both technical colleagues and non-technical stakeholders and team members. The role indexes high on visibility, ownership, and business acumen.

You will manage a team of 2 to 4 software developers - setting technical direction, unblocking the team, conducting code reviews, and raising the bar on engineering quality. You will design and build the services, data pipelines, and web application that power IMS, and you will own the programs that deliver them. That means working directly with stakeholders and leaders across the M&A ecosystem, translating their needs into clear requirements, and driving the work through to reliable, compliant outcomes. You will drive the IMS roadmap end-to-end, prioritizing work, managing stakeholder expectations, and balancing near-term operational needs with longer-term platform investments.

Tech stack: a serverless, event-driven backend on AWS (Python), a PostgreSQL database, a React web application, and an AI assistant built on Amazon Bedrock — all deployed through infrastructure-as-code and Amazon's internal CI/CD, with AI-assisted development tools used daily.

Key job responsibilities
• Own the architecture and the hardest technical problems in IMS, including the services and APIs that serve investment and warrant data, the quarterly data pipelines that carry positions from one quarter to the next, and the checks that catch when IMS and upstream finance systems disagree.

• Own the data model and the financial calculations (such as internal rate of return, unrealized value, and warrant vesting progress), and write the code and tests that the rest of the team builds on.

title: Senior Solutions Architect, Europe North CSC Tech team
descriptionHtml:
Do you like helping customers make hard technical decisions and then seeing those decisions through to production? Until now, our customers in Europe North have been supported remotely. We are building a team in Stockholm so they can work with Solutions Architects who are in the room when it matters.
As a Senior Solutions Architect, you will be the technical lead for a portfolio of customers, working with Account Managers to help them succeed on AWS, with a focus on generative and agentic AI, data and analytics, and security, as well as migration and modernization. The role needs both technical depth and business acumen: you will shape architectures together with customer teams, and you will also understand the customer’s business well enough to tie each solution to measurable outcomes such as revenue, cost and time to market. You will also mentor the junior Solutions Architects and interns on the team and help them grow into confident customer-facing architects.

Key job responsibilities
• Own the technical engagement for your customers, from discovery to production launch, working alongside the customer and partner teams who design, build and run their solutions.
• Understand each customer’s business priorities and build the business case for the solutions you recommend, working with Account Managers on account plans and opportunities.
• Act as a trusted advisor to CTOs, business leaders and engineering teams. Review their architectures and work with them on improvements to AI strategy, security, reliability and cost.
• Lead technical workshops, and design and build demos and proofs of concept end to end that show customers their use cases working on AWS.
• Mentor junior Solutions Architects and interns through design reviews, joint customer engagements and regular feedback.
• Build deep expertise in at least one domain (e.g. GenAI, data and analytics, security) and turn your engagements into reusable assets for the wider team.


A day in the life
You might start the day on site with a customer’s engineering team, reviewing the agentic AI architecture they have designed and agreeing improvements together, with an intern alongside you. In the afternoon you review a junior colleague’s design before they present it, then build a demo for next week’s workshop.

About the team
You will join a team of Solutions Architects based in Germany, Switzerland, Spain, Sweden and the United Arab Emirates. We share knowledge, specialize in different domains and support each other on complex engagements. In Stockholm, you will be the senior architect on site, working alongside our Solutions Architect interns, and you will help shape how the team grows there.

- 8+ years of experience in specific technology domain areas (e.g. software development, cloud computing, systems engineering, infrastructure, security, networking, data and analytics)

title: Sr. Construction Manager, GES NA, Design and Construction
descriptionHtml:
As a Sr. Construction Manager within Global Engineering Services (GES) North America (NA) Design & Construction (D&C), you are Amazon's senior owner's representative responsible for the autonomous end-to-end delivery of complex construction projects — including large-scale new builds, retrofits, and expansions for sortation centers, delivery stations, and auxiliary buildings that power Amazon's logistics network.

You operate with a high degree of independence, executing day-to-day operations autonomously and routinely delivering the right outcomes with limited guidance — even when project strategy is not yet well-defined. You deliver a mix of tactical and strategic initiatives that impact multiple teams and/or geographies in support of significant business objectives. You own design oversight, external partner selection, contract negotiations, and project procurement — and you are accountable for the full performance of your external project management partners, architects, design consultants, general contractors, and subcontractors.

Beyond project delivery, you contribute to developing Amazon's internal and external construction networks, drive best practices across the organization, and are learning to force multiply — elevating the performance of the teams and partners around you. You write effective narratives and present complex decisions and trade-offs to Directors and VPs. You actively recruit, mentor, and develop other construction managers.

This role requires approximately 60% regional travel within North America, with potential travel to all North America locations based on business needs. Relocation assistance may be provided. Must be open to servicing Chicago area as well as Florida.

Key job responsibilities
Safety & Compliance
Own and enforce safety programs across internal and external teams; lead AHJ (Authorities Having Jurisdiction) negotiations for permitting and regulatory approvals; proactively eliminate safety and compliance risks

Project & Construction Management
Oversee end-to-end project management, design services, and external partner performance for complex projects; serve as senior owner's representative integrating construction, design, and internal stakeholders

Develop project strategies; oversee design evaluations, conformance reviews, and value engineering; monitor KPIs for safety, quality, cost, schedule, and sustainability; resolve complex issues and manage escalations
Budget, Schedule & Contract Management

Own project budgets and spend approvals; lead partner selection, contract negotiations, and procurement; review and approve cost/time change requests; ensure contracts are fit for purpose with appropriate SLAs
External Partner & Stakeholder Management

Align delivery from architects, GCs, and subcontractors to Amazon priorities; hold partners accountable; lead negotiations and collaborate with internal teams to eliminate dependencies and risks
Communication & Reporting

Drive alignment across diverse stakeholders; write narratives and present decisions to Directors/VPs; communicate budgets, schedules, and priorities clearly
Process Improvement & People Development

Drive continuous improvement and repeatable processes; mentor and develop construction managers; recommend improvements to project scoping and deployment

A day in the life
Each day, you operate as Amazon's owner's representative — autonomously driving the safe, on-time, and on-budget delivery of complex construction projects. Your day may include:
- Reviewing construction documents and providing strategic direction to stakeholders on complex projects
- Leading negotiations with GCs, developers, or regulatory authorities
- Presenting project status, risks, and trade-off decisions to senior leadership
- Monitoring project performance metrics and driving corrective actions
- Collaborating with internal stakeholders across operations, equipment, and facilities on project integration and handover planning
- Developing process playbooks based on lessons learned from current projects
- Conducting site visits to verify quality, safety, and schedule adherence

At Amazon, the GES NA D&C team is a diverse group of engineers, construction managers, and preconstruction professionals who deliver the physical infrastructure behind Amazon's logistics network. - 7+ years of experience negotiating construction, procurement, and/or labor contracts
- 7+ years of proficiency with AutoCAD and/or Building Information Modeling (BIM), and scheduling software (Primavera, MS Project, or similar)

The OTS ANCHOR (Analytics, Insights, and Centralized Hub for OTS Reporting) team is part of the WW IT Operations & RME organization, responsible for delivering data solutions that drive operational excellence across Amazon's global IT infrastructure. We build data pipelines, predictive models, develop analytical intelligence frameworks, and create AI-powered solutions that transform how Amazon manages, triages, and resolves IT operational incidents at scale pointing towards the Letting Data Tell the Story north start vision.

We are seeking a Data Scientist to help own the end-to-end data science charter for critical operational workstreams — from forecasting IT service demand and capacity planning to designing intelligent severity triaging models and building the analytical backbone for agentic AI solutions. You will work backwards from complex operational problems to create models and solutions that directly impact the efficiency and reliability of Amazon's IT operations worldwide.

Key job responsibilities

- Build and maintain severity classification and intelligent triaging models that process thousands of daily IT service tickets across global regions
- Develop anomaly detection systems to identify emerging patterns in operational data, supporting proactive incident prevention
- Apply econometric and statistical methods to measure the impact of operational interventions and inform resource allocation decisions
- Partner with engineering teams to productionize ML models via automated pipelines using AWS services (SageMaker, Step Functions, Lambda, Redshift)
- Design and conduct experiments to empirically validate model performance and operational impact
- Contribute to data quality monitoring frameworks and help maintain standards for operational data integrity
- Collaborate with cross-functional teams (ServiceNow platform, Decision Intelligence, Field Operations) to translate analytical insights into actionable recommendations
- Communicate findings, model performance, and recommendations to stakeholders and senior leaders through written documents and presentations
- Contribute to the team's science roadmap, identifying opportunities to apply ML/AI (including Generative AI) to operational challenges

title: Construction Manager , AMER SE
descriptionHtml:
AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we're the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we're looking for talented people who want to help.

You'll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You'll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you'll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

As a Data Center Construction Manager, you will be part of a creative, diverse team tasked with solving fascinating problems in constructing Amazon Data Centers. Our data centers are industry-leading examples of energy-efficient, cost-effective designs. You will work alongside partner teams such as Operations, Networking, Controls, Security, and Commissioning to build Data Centers that directly support our Customers.

As our Data Center Construction Manager, you will build some of the most interesting electrical and mechanical systems in the world. You will be on the construction site daily, interacting with the construction trades as Amazon's owner's representative. You will be directly responsible for driving cost, schedule, and quality while managing construction vendors and contractors building data centers.

At Amazon, we are all Owners and leverage unique opportunities presented to us by owning everything from design review to construction bidding to construction execution and final hand-off to our customers. We are a diverse, upbeat, creative team of engineers and managers working daily to develop innovative data centers for our Customers.

Key job responsibilities
The Data Center Construction Manager will be responsible for construction project management and oversight of construction-related activities as they relate to new builds or general capital projects. This includes ownership of the project scope, quality, schedule, and budget.

Some of the typical daily tasks of the Construction Manager:

-Direct interface with construction general contractors during the bidding, award, execution, and project closeout/punch list phases.

-Conduct negotiations with general contractors and evaluate bids/proposals with detail and accuracy.

-Create construction project scope and requests for proposals.

-Perform financial analysis of construction.

-Manage construction projects for specific initiatives aimed at increasing the resiliency of our data centers.

-Conduct constructability reviews of electrical and mechanical designs associated with the construction of new data centers or optimization of existing data centers.

-Manage construction documents including submittal review, RFIs, change orders, and invoicing.

-Ensure construction project quality control.
Record and report key construction metrics to team members and management.

-Drive teams to perform troubleshooting and root-cause failure analysis associated with equipment failures.

-Be a leader within the group as well as within internal and external teams that support the data center.

A day in the life
**Why AWS**
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

*Diverse Experiences*
Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

*Work/Life Balance*
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.

*Inclusive Team Culture*
Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon (gender diversity) conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.

*Mentorship and Career Growth*
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

About the team
AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

- Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or a related field
- Experience carrying new design concepts through exploration, development, and into deployment or mass production
- Experience in MS Excel, Word, and Windows Operating Systems
- Experience with power management and power monitoring systems

Preferred qualifications

- Knowledge of critical data center equipment
- Knowledge of engineering documentation, electrical diagrams and standard operating procedures
- Knowledge of building codes and regulations including Life Safety, BOCA, NFPA, NEC, or OSHA

title: Operations & Logistics Internship FCO5-Ardea
descriptionHtml:
****This position could be based in FCO5-Ardea. Please note that this role requires on-site presence. Relocation support will be provided****

Amazon Operations is the backbone of the Amazon customer experience. With over 50 fulfilment centres, hundreds of delivery stations, and tens of thousands of employees, the team works together to efficiently deliver items to customers. In the fulfilment centres, millions of items are picked and packed annually, while delivery teams work to get orders to customers on time. Safety is the top priority, and the operations culture is defined by teamwork, diversity, and a shared work ethic that keeps the business running smoothly. The team takes pride in delivering the quality service Amazon is known for globally.

Note: You must have the right to work in the country of employment by the start date.


Key job responsibilities
As an Amazon operations intern, you'll have the opportunity to apply your analytical skills to impactful projects that enhance the functionality and service of Fulfillment Centers, Sortation Centers, and Delivery Stations. Key aspects of the role include:
• Completing high-priority projects to the highest standard, demonstrating your ability to deliver results
• Analyzing data to identify operational challenges and opportunities for improvement
• Proposing and testing solutions, collaborating with the team to implement the most effective ones
• Developing communication and teamwork skills by working with managers, stakeholders, and frontline associates.
• Be on the move within the building to engage with various teams. This includes actively gathering knowledge by participating in activities such as pre-briefs, flow meetings, and discussions with the leadership team and associates.
• Ability to navigate the workspace and move between different areas is essential for this position.
• Displaying flexibility to work various schedules and shift patterns as required.
• Potential relocation to the designated work location.


A day in the life
Our internships are educational opportunities that allow you, our future managers, to discover how we lead and develop our teams of associates. You'll immerse yourself in the fast-paced, complex world of our Fulfillment Centers, Sortation Hubs, and Delivery Stations, witnessing how our managers engage their teams to fulfill customer expectations.

This internship will place you at the heart of our operations, enabling you to trace the journey of a customer order. You'll gain a realistic job preview of the full-time opportunities awaiting you within our organization.

You'll learn how our managers cultivate a safe, productive environment, harnessing the full potential of their teams through effective engagement and performance management strategies. This is your chance to develop skills that will propel you towards a rewarding career with Amazon.


About the team
Intern Community:
• As an Amazon Intern, you'll be part of a supportive community that empowers your growth and development. You'll collaborate with interns from around the world, networking and participating in social events to broaden your perspectives. You can also join specialized groups focused on areas like sustainability to explore your diverse interests.
Support:
• The internship program provides a robust support system, including weekly intern office hours, dedicated IT and HR support, and a program team committed to your success. This ensures you have the guidance and assistance needed to thrive.
Learning Sessions:
• Exclusive learning sessions will further enhance your skills, granting you access to Amazon's learning platforms and the expertise of industry leaders. These structured development opportunities will prepare you for the next step in your career.
Opportunities:
• Upon successful completion of the internship, you may be considered for a graduate role or a second internship, allowing you to continue your journey with Amazon. Additionally, you'll enjoy a competitive monthly salary, relocation support, and access to a range of employee benefits.

title: Engineering Operation Technician
descriptionHtml:
Join our dynamic team and become a critical guardian of technological infrastructure! As a Data Center Engineering Technician, you'll play a pivotal role in maintaining the heartbeat of mission-critical technology infrastructure, ensuring seamless operations that power global digital experiences. Your expertise will directly contribute to maintaining an extraordinary 99.999% uptime, keeping the digital world running smoothly and efficiently.

Engineering Technicians are Amazon’s front line when it comes to hands-on electrical and mechanical equipment troubleshooting. They will maintain, operate, and troubleshoot, Data Center Operation’s Mission Critical Facilities, which includes stand-by diesel generators and related fuel systems, as well as three phase electrical systems such as: switch gear, UPSs, PDUs, wet cell batteries and associated systems, CRAC, centrifugal chillers, cooling towers/water chemical system, air handlers and associated systems, pumps, & motors.

AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

NOTE: Amazon does not sponsor for immigration, including for H-1B, TN, and other non-immigrant visas, for this role.
NOTE: Lump sum stipend will be provided to eligible candidates who relocate for this position.


Key job responsibilities
- Daily building rounds to monitor and record information from electrical, mechanical, and fire/life safety equipment to ensure 24/7 reliability and availability
- Monitor Building Management Systems (BMS) and Electrical Power Management System (EPMS)
- Assist in troubleshooting of facility and rack-level events within internal Service Level Agreements (SLA)
- Perform rack installs and rack decommissioning within internal SLA
- Perform PM, troubleshooting, root cause analysis, and repair of electrical and mechanical equipment
- Technical writing to support change management program
- Monitor daily work requests and manage to resolution, and execute projects from conception to completion
- On-site support of contractors, sub-contractors and vendors, ensuring that all work performed is in accordance with established practices, procedures & local legislation
- Work schedule changes depending on specific site needs. Shifts can be up to 12 hours and may rotate on a predefined schedule. Some locations have on-call rotations.
- Role may support more than one location/site.

Physical Requirements:
- Willingness and demonstrated ability to work in the following physical conditions with reasonable accommodations:
- Regularly lift and/or move up to 39 pounds independently
- Participate in group lifts for 40+ pounds
- Maintain balance and perform construction tasks while on a ladder
- Regularly walk, use hands and fingers, handle or feel, reach with hands and arms, stoop, kneel, crouch or crawl, climb stairs, twist, bend, work above shoulders, grasp, carry, push and pull objects into position
- Work in an environment requiring provided ear protection

This role supports data centers in various operational stages. The position may be assigned to a facility still under development, which could require travel to established locations for training until your designated site becomes fully operational.

Essential Requirements:
- Ability to travel to or commute between data center locations as needed
- Willingness to temporarily work at alternative sites during training periods or until assigned facility is operational
- Travel frequency will vary based on business needs and operational status of assigned facility

Candidates must be able to travel (over 50 miles) or commute (less than 50 miles) to active data center sites as required by business needs

A day in the life
This role acts as Amazon’s front line when it comes to hands-on electrical and mechanical equipment preventative maintenance (PM) and troubleshooting, reporting to a site’s Data Center Facility Manager (FM). They will maintain, operate, and troubleshoot mission-critical data center facility equipment including stand-by diesel generators and related fuel systems, 3 phase electrical systems such as switchgear, UPS units, PDUs, and wet cell batteries and associated systems. Mechanical equipment includes CRAHU units, centrifugal chillers, cooling towers, water systems, air handlers and associated systems, pumps, and motors. Additional support equipment is included in the scope of the role which includes fire/life safety equipment, building automation systems, and general facilities equipment.

Basic qualifications

- 1+ years of electrical facilities maintenance, or 1+ years of mechanical facilities maintenance experience
- 1+ years of Microsoft Office products and applications experience
- Work flexible schedule including weekends, nights, and holidays

Preferred qualifications

- 2+ years of data center engineering experience
- Experience reading and writing procedures, technical documents, and engineering drawings
- Associate's degree in related field, or technical degree in related field

title: Onsite Medical Representative
descriptionHtml:
Join Amazon’s mission to become Earth’s safest place to work! At Amazon, we’ve set the ambitious goal to become the benchmark of safety excellence across all industries in which we operate. The Amazon Workplace Health & Safety (WHS) team sets the strategic direction to provide resources, best practices, and safe environments to proactively manage the health and wellbeing of our workforce. To support these goals, Amazon is seeking an experienced and dynamic Onsite Medical Representative (OMR) to join our team. In this position, you will work closely with the WHS Site Manager, WHS Specialist, and occasionally the Injury Prevention Specialist (IPS). This includes attending weekly associate safety committee meetings, greeting all new hires for the site or through daily one-on-one interaction. Additionally, the OMR will participate in weekly case management review meetings as necessary.

As an OMR, you will independently assess and administer first aid as well as offer guidance to Amazon Associates (AAs) on both occupational and non-occupational injuries or illnesses. You should be passionate about learning and advocating health and wellness principles to consistently support AAs on a daily basis. You will refer care to outside medical providers as needed, and learn about OSHA regulations, risk, and analysis.

The OMR will function as a part of the larger team onsite, assisting with all first aid needs and support safety operations as needed.

Responsibilities include but are not limited to:
- Provide first aid support and make referrals to outside medical providers as necessary.
- Minimize the AA risk of injury through awareness, education, and proactive engagement.
- Maintain all records of care provided to AAs.
- Coordinate and maintain the workers’ compensation and return to work programs for AAs with work-related injuries.
- Provide daily activity logs and end of shift reports.
- Engage with AAs and leadership on operations floor to provide coaching regarding observed at-risk work habits.
- Maintain a clean working environment and ensure appropriate medical supply inventory is maintained.
- Participate in training and certification to facilitate first aid, CPR and AED certifications classes.
- Maintain all first aid, CPR, AED credentials.
- Work flexible shifts which could include days, nights, holidays, and/or weekends.
- Assist with random saliva drug testing protocols.
- Maintain effective care delivery in emergencies and assist emergency response at the site.

Additional Job Elements include:
- Lift up to 49 pounds and frequently push, pull, squat, bend, and reach
- Stand/walk for up to 12 hours during shifts
- Work in an environment where the noise level varies
- Work in an environment that is subject to variable temperatures and weather (delivery stations include outside loading departments)
- Continuously climb and descend stairs (applies to sites with stairs)

For those that do not have an adult First Aid, CPR, AED certification from the American Heart Association or American Red Cross, must obtain within 3 weeks of start date.

Basic qualifications

- High school or equivalent diploma
- Current valid Basic Life Support (BLS) certification by an approved emergency cardiac care (ECC) provider; AND must have one of the following:
- Current valid Emergency Medical Technician (EMT) OR Paramedic Certification from the Department of Health OR the National Registry of Emergency Medical Technicians (NREMT); OR
- Current active Athletic Trainer Certification, by either the Board of Certification (BOC) or equivalent State Certification.

Preferred qualifications

- Certified to teach first aid, CPR, and AED training from American Heart Association or American Red Cross
- Proficient in Microsoft Office
- Experience with an industrial wellness program
- Experience managing musculoskeletal disorders, ergonomics, and coaching on body mechanics
- Demonstrated work experience with OSHA regulations and Workers Compensation
- Proficient in digital recordkeeping
- In the last year, six months job experience in the Military as a Combat Medic (U.S. Army), Field Medic (U.S. Army), Healthcare Specialist (U.S. Army), Hospital Corpsman (U.S. Navy), or Aerospace Medical Service Technician (U.S. Air Force)

The Global Network Delivery organization is looking to hire a highly motivated, best-in-class Network Deployment Planner to join our growing Planning and Implementation team within AWS Data Center Delivery. The team responsibilities involve scoping and planning interdependent capacity scaling projects and new network capacity deployments across several data center locations. They will review project forecasts and assure physical infrastructure resources are available for their execution.

The Network Deployment Planner will work closely with infrastructure supply chain & procurement, network engineering and technical program managers to plan and deliver customer capacity to the local data center installation & deployment technicians to facilitate smooth capacity execution.

The ideal candidate will possess a technology background that enables them to understand the complexities of the sophisticated network architecture of Amazon data centers. To be a qualified candidate you must be highly autonomous, very detail oriented, possesses strong written and verbal communication skills and have experience in managing network deployment projects. They will be competent in networking principles, data center operations, cable infrastructure and fiber solutions.

This position will provide the individual with high levels of autonomous work with minimal supervision to drive the stability and sustainability of our next-generation networks and to assist in the development of innovative ways to automate and scale our network as we expand. The desire and ability to work in a fast paced, ambiguous, collaborative environment is essential for success.



Key job responsibilities

title: Forward Deployed Engineer (Model Customization and Optimization), AWS Forward Deployed Engineering
locations: East Palo Alto, CA, United States
descriptionHtml:
As a Forward Deployed Engineer II (FDE II) on the Custom Model and Optimization team, you embed directly with strategic customers to build, optimize, and run custom generative AI models in production alongside their engineering teams. You own complete model workstreams end-to-end from defining the evaluation bar and preparing data, through training and inference optimization, to production deployment.

FDE IIs on this team works at the intersection of models and systems. They customize state-of-the-art open-weight and foundation models for new domains, languages, and modalities; migrate and optimize training and inference workloads on AWS Trainium and operate those models as production services. They are autonomous contributors who take on projects where the business goal is clear, but the path is not. They make design trade-offs with appropriate guidance, limit short-term workarounds, coach others on producing high-quality code, and train new team members.

Key job responsibilities
Embed within customer ML and engineering teams: Understand the customer's business, data, model stack, and operational constraints. Translate ambiguous goals into a measurable evaluation bar and a technical plan for your workstream such as model selection, customization approach, and serving architecture. Requires up to 25% travel.

Customize and post-train models. Adapt open-weight and foundation models to customer domains through continued pre-training, supervised fine-tuning, preference optimization, and reinforcement learning (including RLHF, RL with verifiable rewards, and multi-turn agentic RL). Build the data pipelines, synthetic data generation, and evaluation harnesses that prove a customized model out performs the baseline on the customer's own quality, latency, and cost bar. Apply these techniques to high-value patterns such as coding agents, domain foundation models, and multi-adapter serving.

Build large-scale training and inference systems. Design and implement distributed training and RL post-training pipelines using frameworks such as PyTorch FSDP2, Megatron-LM, Miles, and verl. Build RL interaction harnesses using NeMo Gym or OpenEnv to connect agent workflows, tools, environments, and reward functions to training. Develop production inference stacks with engines such as SGLang and vLLM, and optimize throughput, latency, memory footprint, and cost per token through quantization, parallelism, speculative decoding, and batching.

Optimize models on AWS chips. Migrate and tune training and inference workloads for AWS Trainium using the AWS Neuron SDK. Profile performance, close accuracy-parity gaps against GPU baselines, and develop custom kernels where needed. Benchmark rigorously and turn results into decisions customers can act on.

Accelerate impact beyond the engagement. Codify reusable fine-tuning recipes, evaluation frameworks, benchmarking tools, and optimization patterns that accelerate future deployments. Feed field learnings back to AWS service teams, including Amazon Bedrock, Amazon SageMaker AI, and AWS Neuron. Identify opportunities to expand model customization and optimization within your customer engagement.


About the team
The Custom Model and Optimization team, part of the Forward Deployed Engineering team partners with enterprises, AI-native startups, and foundation model providers to build, customize, and optimize generative AI models at scale. Our work spans domain foundation models, post-training of open-weight models, and moving training and inference workloads onto AWS Trainium. As embedded engineers within the AWS Forward Deployed Engineering motion, we bring deep model and optimization expertise to customers' most strategic AI workloads, and we turn what we learn into tooling and patterns that scale across AWS.

We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud. 

Inclusive Team Culture
AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee-led and company-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.

title: プロセスアシスタント
descriptionHtml:
このポジションの勤務地は京都府京田辺市です。

物流未経験からキャリアアップ可能なポジションです。私達と一緒に新たにAmazonの歴史を作り上げましょう！

現在は当たり前となった「お急ぎ便」「お届け日時指定便」「当日便」は、お客様の利便性を追求し実現した、日本発の配送サービスです。そのサービスを実現しているのはアマゾンの心臓部である物流拠点、フルフィルメントセンター（以下FC）の仕組みにあります。
FCはお客様のご注文に対して、より早く正確に商品を、多くの地域へ提供するため、入荷から出荷までの各工程において、Amazon独自のノウハウを活かした効率的かつ的確な管理を実施し、最新の自社テクノロジーを導入する事で更なる最適化に挑戦し続けている事業です。
そのFC事業は、日本で2005年に開業して以来、現在25拠点以上に成長しました。本年も継続して事業の拡大に伴い、私達と一緒にお客様起点に考え、更なるイノベーションを起こしていただける情熱的な仲間を「プロセスアシスタント」として募集します。

■業務内容■
「プロセスアシスタント」には、他業種・職種も含めこれまでの経験、スキルを活かし、改善点を模索しながら、より便利でお客様に満足いただける高い品質のサービスを提供できるビジネスをつくる事、そして先進テクノロジーと「People First」の考え方で、安全・快適・楽しい職場環境の構築を行う、将来の組織のリーダーを目指していただける事を期待しています。

具体的にはマネージャーのサポートのもと、以下の業務に責任をもち遂行いただきます。

① 安全・品質・作業効率の向上
安全安心な作業環境の維持・向上のため、日々の安全活動、品質チェックに加え、多岐にわたる問題解決・改善活動を行います。

② 日々のオペレーション対応
FCはAmazonの豊富な品揃えを実現する巨大な物流拠点です。商品を入荷、在庫として管理し、注文があった商品を出荷するという一連の流れを各工程間で連携をとりながら、業務を円滑に進める事が求められます。
お客様とお約束した期日までに商品を迅速かつ正確にお届けするため、時間ごとの計画に沿ってオペレーションを実施することに責任を持ちます。

③ 新規プロジェクトの導入・セール時など、オペレーション拡大時の準備
新しいサービスやシステムの導入に備え、現場での手順変更・導入方法を検討し円滑な導入に向けて準備を行います。また、新規入職者でもAmazonの標準作業に則った手順がスムーズに身につくためのトレーニング構築やマニュアルを作成します。

④ イレギュラーへの対応
作業で発生する様々な課題の原因を追求し問題解決を行います。また、再発防止策案の検討、実施を行います。

■働き方■
・勤務形態：1ヶ月単位の変形労働時間制のシフト勤務。
・勤務時間：1日8時間勤務、1ヶ月を平均して1週間40時間を超えない範囲で設定します。
・休日：年間120日（月平均10日）　
※原則、日勤、夜勤含めた2～3シフトで会社が決定し、遅くとも当月末日までに翌月分をお伝えします。シフトは日勤・夜勤の間にも必ず公休を挟み、負担が少ないよう配慮しています。
※1日の流れ：以下ページをご参照ください。
先輩社員インタビュー

■福利厚生■
下記ページをご確認ください。
福利厚生 | アマゾンジャパンキャリアサイト

■教育制度■
入社後、約1週間はAmazonのリーダーとして必要な会社のカルチャーや、FCの基本的な業務を一通り学ぶことができる座学の機会を提供します。各部署へ配属後は、トレーナーのもと、OJTで工程知識やツールの使用方法など基礎知識を学んでいきます。トレーニング資料も完備しており、相互に進捗を確認しながら独り立ちまでしっかりとサポートしますので、未経験者も安心してスタートができる環境です。
最先端の物流システムを学ぶことはもちろん、年齢・性別・国籍問わず様々な仲間と日々の業務を通して、次のステップとなるピープルマネージメントやビジネススキルを学ぶことができます。

■キャリアパス■
プロセスアシスタントからキャリアをスタートし、入荷/出荷チームのマネージャー、統括マネージャー、そしてFCの拠点長となった実績も多数あります。また、Amazonでは社内公募制度があり、国内外問わず他部署や異なる職種への異動にチャレンジし、社内で多様なキャリアを築くチャンスもあります。Amazonではご自身で学び成長することを推奨し、キャリア開発できるようサポートを行っています。
キャリアアップストーリー

■会社のカルチャー■
Amazonでは全員がリーダーです。個人の裁量に任される部分が多く、社員の個々の可能性を最大限に伸ばす事を重視しています。様々なバックグラウンドを持った社員が前職で培った多様な経験やスキルを活かして職位や役割に関わらず誰もがチャレンジできる環境です。
また年次有給休暇の取得を積極的に推進しており「働く」、「プライベート」も充実できる環境です。
失敗に寛容な文化：まずは試してみることにこだわります。好奇心を持って学びます。時にはリスクを取り、計画通りいかなかったとしても、よりよい成果に繋げられることが私たちの強みだと信じています。

最後に、募集しているポジションや組織、お仕事の詳細については以下のリンクよりご確認いただけます。

・勤務先のFCについて：京田辺FC
・プロセスアシスタントについて：プロセスアシスタント/シフトアシスタント特設サイト
・FCで働くリーダーのインタビュー：プロセスアシスタント３名のインタビュー
・フルフィルメントセンター部門のご紹介：フルフィルメントセンター (FC)
・職種：オペレーション

※FC内の様子も下記動画からご覧いただけます！
一部の拠点のみとなりますが、より職場環境をイメージ出来るかと思いますのでぜひご覧ください！

title: Solutions Architect, Alps ISV
descriptionHtml:
This role is within the EMEA Independent Software Vendors (ISV) organization. You will be working with Software Vendors in Austria, in order to help them be successful on AWS, working backwards from their needs.

Solutions Architects work close to customers. They engage with organizations at all stages of their cloud adoption and are responsible for the overall technical relationship between customers and AWS. They make recommendations on architecture, security, cost, performance, reliability, and operational efficiency. They work to understand the customer's needs and give prescriptive guidance on how to create business value with AWS technology.

Solutions Architects lead activities such as architecture reviews, white-boarding sessions, demos, and technical workshops.

They collaborate with other teams such as account management, professional services, support, product teams, and the AWS partner ecosystem.

In this role, you will get to practice your creativity, linking technology to tangible solutions and educating AWS customers about the art of the possible. You will have the opportunity to define or invent cloud-native reference architectures for a variety of use cases. (e.g., Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, Serverless, and Container-based architectures, Analytics and Big Data, DevOps or Security).

The Solutions Architecture team is a diverse group of technologists from a variety of backgrounds. Practical knowledge of the AWS platform is desired but not required, provided you have a sound technical foundation and a desire to learn. You will have the support to grow your expertise in industry and technology areas of depth. Every day you will learn something new from your customers, your peers, and your experiments.

At Amazon, you will be encouraged and rewarded for doing what is suitable for the customer's long-term success. We value your passion for discovering, inventing, and building on behalf of customers.

Amazon has always been, and always will be, committed to diversity and inclusion. We seek builders from all backgrounds to join our teams, and we encourage our employees to bring their authentic, original, and best selves to work.


Key job responsibilities
• Help Austrian ISVs accelerate their challenging, mission-critical projects, from architecture design to hands-on implementation. Recommend best-practice architectures in line with their long-term business outcomes, and build alongside customers: prototypes, proofs of concept and production-ready code when it speeds up their journey. Agentic AI and SaaSification are key topics, as are containerization and adding innovative services to their solutions.
• Build technical relationships with customers and act as their trusted advisor, earning credibility by working hands-on with their engineering teams. The customer's best interests will shape the guidance you provide.
• Share the voice of the customer to inform the AWS feature roadmap.
• Help create and share best practices, technical content and new reference architectures (e.g., white papers, code samples, open-source repositories, reusable assets, blog posts).
• Evangelize and educate about AWS technology (e.g., through hands-on workshops, hackathons, user groups, meetups, public speaking, online videos or conferences).
• Develop deep expertise in technical domains relevant to your interests and your customers' outcomes, including staying hands-on with the latest AWS services and AI-assisted development tools.

descriptionHtml:
We are looking for a motivated and results-driven Category Manager to join our Global Procurement Operations (GPO) CAPEX Category team within the Equipment, Mobility & Infrastructure (EMI) organization. In this role, you will own end-to-end category management for the Racking (Storage) subcategory across Europe and Latin America, supporting Amazon's fulfillment, sortation, and logistics network.

You will develop and execute sourcing strategies, drive cost savings, manage supplier relationships, and partner cross-functionally to deliver best-in-class storage solutions at optimal total cost of ownership. You will report to the Global Storage Category Leader and work closely with Engineering, Operations, Finance, and regional stakeholders to ensure procurement strategies are aligned with business priorities and network expansion plans.

Key job responsibilities
Category Strategy & Execution: Develop and execute regional category strategies for Racking across Europe and Latin America, including market analysis, spend segmentation, should-cost modelling, sourcing roadmaps, and supply chain optimisation.

Strategic Sourcing & Supplier Management: Lead competitive sourcing events (Requests for Proposal/Quote/Information), negotiate commercial terms, and execute contracts that deliver best value. Build and manage strategic supplier relationships — from vendor scouting and qualification through regular business reviews, performance tracking, and continuous improvement in cost, quality, delivery, and sustainability.

Cost Optimisation & Market Intelligence: Identify and deliver year-over-year cost savings through negotiation, value engineering, specification optimisation, demand management, and consolidation opportunities. Monitor industry trends, technology shifts, raw material dynamics (particularly steel), and supply market conditions to proactively inform category strategy.

Risk Management & Compliance: Proactively identify and mitigate supply chain risks including single/sole source dependencies, geopolitical exposure, and capacity constraints. Maintain catalogue accuracy, drive catalogue coverage improvements, and ensure supplier compliance with contractual obligations and Amazon's Supplier Code of Conduct.

Stakeholder Engagement & Process Improvement: Partner with Engineering, Safety, Supply Chain, Finance, Legal, and Operations stakeholders to align sourcing strategies with business requirements. Identify and implement process improvements across the procure-to-pay cycle; define and report on key metrics that measure effectiveness.

This role is open for candidates based in Luxembourg, Barcelona or London.

Bachelor's degree
Experience in strategic sourcing including vendor negotiations, contract management, and financial analysis
Experience being responsible for and leading large, complex negotiations
Experience in stakeholder management, dealing with multiple stakeholders at varied levels of the organization
Knowledge of Excel (Pivot Tables, VLookUps) at an advanced level and SQL
Experience in defining and implementing process improvement initiatives using data and metrics

title: Hardware Development Engineer I, Relay Fleet & Yard Devices
descriptionHtml:
Cargo theft and fraud cost our business hundreds of millions of dollars a year, and most of it happens to trailers with no device smart enough to notice. You will design the electronics that give trailers and yards the senses to catch it, on a hardware team inside a fleet tracking and telemetry organization that carries products from the lab bench to the road. Across the full hardware lifecycle (schematic and PCB design, prototype bring-up, test, and qualification), you will build edge-compute gateways, tamper-resistant GPS, smart locks that act as a virtual seal, tire-pressure and door sensors, on-trailer cameras with collision radar, and automated yard gates that read plates and raise barriers. This matters now because we are expanding into new regions and moving intelligence onto the device, where a warning can fire in seconds and prevent a loss.

- Design, develop, and validate hardware — PCBs/PCBAs, high-speed digital and RF circuitry, subsystems, and custom test fixtures.
- Bring up, test, troubleshoot, and optimize hardware prototypes in a lab environment.

- Collaborate cross-functionally (mechanical, thermal, power, RF, software, manufacturing) to gather requirements, define hardware architectures, and prepare for integration.
- Identify hardware design risks and drive mitigations.

title: Senior Equipment Engineer, Annapurna Labs
descriptionHtml:
We are seeking an experienced Senior Equipment Engineer to join our team in South Korea. This is the team's **first hire in country**, making it a foundational role with significant ownership and visibility. This role will provide technical leadership for automated test equipment (ATE) operations at our OSAT partners, driving excellence in test cell qualification and problem resolution.

Key job responsibilities
Lead and execute new test cell qualification and bring-up activities at OSAT partners

Serve as the primary technical escalation point for complex issues at OSAT facilities

Drive resolution of sophisticated setup challenges involving thermal, electrical, and mechanical systems

Conduct comprehensive technical audits at OSAT partners to ensure compliance with quality standards

Develop and deliver technical training programs for new team members and OSAT partners

Review and approve test cell configurations for production release

Partner with cross-functional teams to optimize test cell performance and reliability

Lead continuous improvement initiatives for test cell efficiency and yield

A day in the life
As our first engineer based in South Korea, you will be the on-the-ground technical anchor for our OSAT operations in the Incheon area — a foundational role with real ownership and visibility.

A typical week blends hands-on floor time with focused remote work:

- **On-site at the OSAT (3+ days/week):** You start the day walking the test floor — reviewing overnight test cell performance, checking in on qualification or bring-up activities in progress, and acting as the first point of contact when the OSAT team hits a complex thermal, electrical, or mechanical setup challenge. You run technical audits, review configurations for production release, and partner directly with the partner's engineers to keep yield and reliability on track.

- **Remote days (work from home):** You focus on the deeper work — analyzing test data, preparing audit findings, building training materials for OSAT partners and new team members, and syncing with cross-functional teams across time zones (including colleagues in Israel).

- **Quarterly business trips:** You travel to OSATs outside South Korea (Taiwan, Malta) to support bring-up and qualification, or to Israel for training and team collaboration.


Because you'll be the first local hire, you'll also help shape how the team operates in-country — setting the standard for how we engage our Korean OSAT partners.

About the team
You will join Annapurna Labs' Equipment Engineering team, which provides the technical backbone for our semiconductor test operations across our OSAT (Outsourced Semiconductor Assembly and Test) partners. The team owns test cell qualification, bring-up, and sustaining engineering for the ATE and handler fleet that validates our custom silicon.

As a globally distributed team — with engineers in Israel and a growing presence across APAC, including Taiwan — we work hand-in-hand with our OSAT partners to ensure every test cell runs reliably, efficiently, and to spec. Establishing a dedicated engineer in South Korea is a key step in expanding our regional footprint and deepening our partnership with local OSATs. You will be the team's first presence in Korea, working closely with colleagues across these sites while building the local engineering relationship from the ground up.

Basic qualifications

- Bachelor's Degree in Mechanical Engineering
- 5+ years of hands-on experience with automated test equipment
- **ATE testers** — proficiency in at least one of the below:
- Advantest (EVA Scale, SmartScale)
- Teradyne UFP ("UltraFLEX Plus")
- **ATC handlers** — proficiency in at least one of the below:
- HonPrec Inc. (HPI) — 1028CH / CA, 9046LS
- Chroma ATE — 3160-H
- Cohu — EclipseX
- Demonstrated expertise in complex problem solving across thermal, electrical, and mechanical domains
- Strong project management and stakeholder communication skills

Preferred qualifications

- Knowledge in electrical engineering at practical engineer level is a significant advantage
- Experience with semiconductor test and handling equipment
- Track record of leading technical teams or mentoring junior engineers
- Strong analytical and data-driven decision-making skills
- Excellent communication skills in English; Korean proficiency highly desired
- Experience working with OSAT partners in Asia

title: Area Manager, Operations
descriptionHtml:
Operations is the beating heart of Amazon. This key part of our business makes sure we fulfil and dispatch orders efficiently so that our customers get their items on time. As an Area Manager, you’ll make sure your site is running as smoothly as it should so that we can meet customer demand. You will be leading a team that helps keep our operations safe, efficient, and of a high quality and taking on a number of projects across our network to drive productivity.

Key job responsibilities
Create, oversee, and drive a culture of safety and wellbeing
Analyse and implement changes to keep quality and productivity at a consistently high level
Oversee projects to streamline processes, optimise productivity and increase quality of service for customers within your area of responsibility
Analyse shift performance against relevant business objectives, and put in place actions to improve our operational excellence
Work collaboratively with management-level colleagues to standardise shift practices

A day in the life
You’ll work on a shift pattern at one of our sites, making sure it is as productive as it can be. Your main focus will be to own and drive a culture of safety and uphold quality and shift performance standards. You’ll also oversee process improvements within your area and drive implementation. A typical day is varied, including everything from routine team management and daily operational responsibilities to process improvement and wide-scale operational contingency tasks. You’ll also be a role model and mentor to new managers.

About the team
Amazon Logistics, or AMZL, handles ‘last mile’ delivery duties in partnership with third-party distribution businesses. We utilise creative thinking and continuous improvement initiatives to get millions of physical products into the hands of our customers. Our goal is to make our customers’ delivery experience as smooth as possible and roll out global delivery solutions for our newest concepts, like Amazon Fresh, Prime Now and Amazon Restaurants.

There are two sides to what we do. Our ‘under the roof’ associates process millions of products for dispatch to our delivery teams. Our team is people-focused and supportive, particularly as lots of our people work through the night. We focus mostly on operations, with 24/7 shifts in most of our locations.

Meanwhile, our ‘on the road’ people work with Amazon Flex - a network of delivery contractors. Every year, we continually raise the bar for customer experience with new, innovative delivery services. We look for new ways to overcome industry wide logistics challenges and new ideas to reduce our carbon footprint, supported by a portfolio of cutting-edge vehicles (including Electric Vehicles) and technology to help us do just that.

Basic qualifications

- Are enrolled in or have completed a Bachelor's degree

Preferred qualifications

- Have you completed a Master's degree?

title: Data Center Security Specialist
descriptionHtml:
Are you passionate about protecting critical infrastructure and ensuring the safety of the systems that millions of people rely on every day? We are looking for a Data Center Security Specialist II to serve as the primary physical security contact for an assigned data center site or campus. In this role, you will manage day-to-day security operations, oversee vendor performance, and ensure compliance with established security standards and policies. You will play a hands-on role in maintaining and improving security systems such as access controls, video surveillance, and intrusion detection — all while collaborating with operations teams and partner organizations to deliver a consistently secure environment. If you are a detail-oriented security professional who thrives on solving problems and driving operational improvements, we want to hear from you.

Our team is dedicated to safeguarding the data center infrastructure that our customers depend on around the clock. We work closely with operations, engineering, and partner teams to maintain the highest security standards while continuously looking for ways to improve. We value collaboration, knowledge-sharing, and a commitment to getting the details right. If you are looking for a role where your work has a direct and meaningful impact on the security of critical systems, this is the team for you.

Key job responsibilities
- Serve as the primary on-site contact for physical security posture, managing security tasks, strategy, and priorities for your assigned data center site or campus.
- Conduct inspections, audits, and walkthroughs to identify vulnerabilities, ensure compliance with security standards and policies, and coordinate repairs and preventative maintenance for security equipment.
- Manage vendor relationships by assessing compliance with established work orders, tracking service deliverables and SLAs, and escalating corrective actions as needed.
- Review and triage operational request tickets in accordance with SLAs, and communicate security policies and procedures to partner teams effectively.
- Respond to security incidents, support post-incident investigations, and contribute to business continuity planning and process improvement initiatives.

A day in the life
Your day begins with a walkthrough of your assigned site, checking that access control systems, cameras, and intrusion detection hardware are functioning properly. You review overnight incident reports and triage incoming operational tickets, prioritizing items that need immediate attention. You meet with contract security vendors to review performance metrics and approve work activities that may affect physical security. You also collaborate with data center operations teams to address emerging issues, document findings, and refine standard operating procedures.

Basic qualifications

- 2+ years of overseeing security operations and working with security vendors/contractors experience
- Knowledge of one or more of the following domains: access-control system and methodology, network security, application- and system-development security, security architecture and models, cryptography, and operations security

Preferred qualifications

- Bachelor's degree or equivalent, or 2+ years of law enforcement or security-related experience
- Knowledge of Microsoft Office products and applications, including Word, PowerPoint, Excel, Outlook, InfoPath, SharePoint, etc.

title: Software Engineering Manager, AWS EKS
descriptionHtml:
Amazon's Elastic Kubernetes Service (EKS) is looking for a Software Engineering Manager for one of our infrastructure team that manages EKS compute products including EKS Auto and EKS worker node AMI. We have an ambitious road-map that seeks to redefine how our customers build their applications and run them at scale on AWS and Kubernetes.

Amazon EKS allows our customers to use Kubernetes at scale without the undifferentiated heavy lifting required to manage Kubernetes. Our mission is to accelerate the adoption of AWS by providing the best possible experience for customers using Kubernetes. We are growing fast and we are expanding our team to help build additional features for our customers. This is a great time to join a growing team and help influence what we can do for customers who are adopting Kubernetes as a cornerstone in their AWS strategy.

As a leader of the EKS compute and runtime team you will be responsible for building and owning core services responsible for EKS products including EKS Auto and EKS Hybrid. The teams charter is to manage Kubernetes worker nodes and related software components that help monitor and repair nodes. It is a critical team that helps manage AI/ML workload infrastructure.

Your team will build solutions to ensure the safety and stability of software the team operates, integrate with other AWS services with an eye towards simple and streamlined interfaces. You will own staffing and managing the engineering team, product development, setting the team culture, best practices, and organizational planning. The successful candidate will be able to deal with ambiguity and will need to think big.

In addition to our core compute and runtime charter, this team is at the forefront of running AI/ML and inference workloads on Kubernetes. We ship EKS-optimized AMIs with dual NVIDIA driver support so the newest GPU instance families are ready out of the box without separate per-driver AMIs or slower boot times; we're building a hardware-isolated pod runtime that gives each pod strong isolation on shared nodes to unlock secure multi-tenant and emerging agentic AI use cases; we're accelerating fast model loading to cut cold-start and scale-up latency for large models on GPUs; and we continuously advance GPU and node health monitoring in the EKS Node Monitoring Agent, classifying GPU and fabric faults and detecting failing hardware, so large inference fleets stay healthy and nodes aren't needlessly replaced. It's an exciting opportunity to shape how AWS customers run the next generation of AI/ML workloads at massive scale.

The ideal candidate will be passionate about the potential of cloud computing, and about building simple and elegant software solutions and customer-centric products. This leader has thrived and succeeded in delivering high quality technology products/services in a hyper-growth environment where priorities shift quickly. The candidate is a leader who can prioritize well, communicate clearly and compellingly and who understands how to drive a high level of focus and excellence with a strong team. AWS in general, and this business in particular, operates at very large scale and on critical workloads, so a passion and discipline around operational excellence is key. A high level of ownership and accountability is a must.

For more information on service, please visit https://aws.amazon.com/eks/

Our organization principles: https://github.com/aws/containers-roadmap/blob/master/PRINCIPLES.md

Mentorship & Career Growth

Our team is dedicated to supporting new members. We have a broad mix of experience levels and tenures, and we're building an environment that celebrates knowledge sharing and mentorship. Our senior members enjoy one-on-one mentoring. We care about your career growth and strive to assign projects based on what will help each team member develop into a better-rounded individual and enable them to take on complex tasks in the future.

Basic qualifications

- 3+ years of engineering team management experience
- 7+ years of working directly within engineering teams experience
- 3+ years of designing or architecting (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
- 8+ years of leading the definition and development of multi tier web services experience
- Knowledge of engineering practices and patterns for the full software/hardware/networks development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, certification, and livesite operations
- Experience partnering with product or program management teams

Preferred qualifications

- Experience in communicating with users, other technical teams, and senior leadership to collect requirements, describe software product features, technical designs, and product strategy
- Experience in recruiting, hiring, mentoring/coaching and managing teams of Software Engineers to improve their skills, and make them more effective, product software engineers

About the team

title: Principal Applied Scientist, Frontier AI Assets , Frontier AI Assets
descriptionHtml:
The Frontier AI Assets (FAI) team is looking for a passionate, talented, and inventive Principal Applied Scientist with a strong deep learning and reinforcement learning background to build the training and evaluation assets that advance frontier Generative AI (GenAI) with Large Language Models (LLMs).

AI models become more capable largely because of the learning environments, the RL gyms, in which they are trained. FAI builds those gyms and the platform that certifies them, so that model training teams across Amazon can rely on high-quality, graded assets. As a Principal on this team, you will set the technical direction for how these gyms and the tooling around them are built, evaluated, and scaled.


Key job responsibilities
As a Principal Applied Scientist with FAI, you will:

•Set technical direction across data collection, sampling, and evaluation for RL gyms focused on agentic tool use across a range of real-world domains.
•Design and lead experiments that produce reliable, efficient signal on what drives model improvement.
•Build gym-building tooling and automated quality control that scale with demand.
•Advance the science of how gyms are evaluated and validated before they're used in model training.
•Act as a hands-on technical leader: produce exemplary, high-quality assets yourself, and audit and support more junior scientists and engineers.
•Partner closely with domain experts and cross-functional teams, turning real-world problems into challenging, high-value tasks.
•Lead scientific reviews, scrutinize experimental design and verification, probe assumptions, and align teams toward coherent strategies. Contribute to hiring, mentorship, and the development of other scientists.


About the team
The FAI team has the mission to push the envelope in GenAI with LLMs, in order to provide the best-possible experience for our customers. We build frontier training and evaluation assets, RL gyms and the certification platform behind them, that directly shape how Amazon's models are trained and improved. We value scientific depth, hands-on building, and turning research into measurable impact at scale.

Basic qualifications

- Experience programming in Java, C++, Python or related language
- PhD in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Mathematics, or a related technical field; or Master's degree with significant additional applied research experience.
- Strong hands-on experience building machine learning models and systems for real-world applications, with deep learning and neural methods.
- Experience with reinforcement learning and/or building RL gyms, learning environments, or agentic tool-use systems.
- Experience setting technical direction across data, modeling, and evaluation, and dealing with ambiguity and competing objectives.
- Experience leading experienced scientists/engineers and developing more junior members.

Preferred qualifications

- 10+ years of relevant work in industry or academia experience
- Experience building automated evaluation, quality-control, or verification tooling for training data or environments.
- Experience with agentic tool use and improving the capabilities of LLMs (for example multi-step, tool-using agents).
- Track record of creating novel algorithms and advancing the state of the art; peer-reviewed contributions in premier journals and conferences.
- Experience with large-scale distributed training/compute and modern ML frameworks.
