title: Data Scientist III (AmSec), Veritas
descriptionHtml:
At Amazon, we are obsessed with customer trust. Amazon Security enables Amazon's business leaders to build and operate securely while protecting the confidentiality and integrity of Amazon and customer data. We assess risk, classify data and systems, detect intrusion, and drive mitigation at scale.

Veritas is Amazon's single source of truth for applications and services and the resources that make them up, spanning both Stores/Devices (SDO) and AWS. Security teams across Amazon rely on Veritas to understand attack paths, assign issue ownership, track the flow of sensitive data, and reason about risk across one of the largest and most diverse technology footprints in the world.

We are seeking a talented, self-directed Senior Data Scientist to work on cutting-edge security technologies. You will take the lead on large, ambiguous problems that have not been solved before - defining both the problem and the solution approach autonomously. You will design and run experiments, research new algorithms, and find new ways to protect Amazon's customer trust. You will work closely with talented software engineers and security engineers who transform your prototypes and models into production. You should thrive in ambiguous environments and enjoy fast-paced settings where learning new concepts quickly is essential. You leverage exceptional technical expertise, strong statistical skills, and data acumen to analyze large volumes of business data and make Amazon safer. Your strong communication skills enable you to influence across multiple teams and to work effectively with both business and technical partners, including senior leadership.

Key job responsibilities
- Define problems and solution approaches autonomously in ambiguous, open-ended security problem spaces where no established pattern exists. - Process and analyze large data sets using the full range of techniques required, selecting the ideal method from a wide range of data science disciplines.
- Deliver scalable models that analyze large data sets efficiently.
- Build mathematical models to detect and classify specific data elements with high accuracy.
- Prototype models in high-level modeling languages such as R, or in software languages such as Python. A software team will partner with you to transform prototypes into production.
- Take the lead on large projects that require both business and technical domain expertise, delivering significant benefit to the business.
- Influence multiple teams and build consensus across business, science, and engineering stakeholders; advise senior managers and directors on data-driven security decisions.
- Mentor and develop other scientists; perform data science technical assessments and participate in science and data-engineering code reviews.
- Create, enhance, and maintain technical documentation, and present findings to other scientists and business leaders, keeping teams current on relevant scientific advancements.

Basic qualifications

- 5+ years of data querying languages (e.g. SQL), scripting languages (e.g. Python) or statistical/mathematical software (e.g. R, SAS, Matlab, etc.) experience
- 4+ years of data scientist experience
- Experience with statistical models e.g. multinomial logistic regression

Preferred qualifications

- 2+ years of data visualization using AWS QuickSight, Tableau, R Shiny, etc. experience
- Experience managing data pipelines
- Experience as a leader and mentor on a data science team

title: Facility Operations Center (FOC) Engineer, Facility Operations Center
descriptionHtml:
At Amazon, we're working to be the most customer-centric company on Earth! Amazon is a place where builders can build. We hire the world's brightest minds and offer them an environment in which they can invent and innovate to improve the experience for our customers.

The Data Center Infrastructure Operations organization is looking for an individual with proven skills to help support our Amazon Dedicated Cloud (ADC) Facility Operations Center. The Facility Operations Center is responsible for 24X7 monitoring of the data center’s physical infrastructure. This team will ensure that the customer experience will be optimal and gratifying by way of consistency, reliability and attention to detail.

The ideal candidate should have a basic understanding of Data Center Infrastructure as well as have proficient computer and communication skills. The successful candidate will be responsible for providing assistance and support to the onsite operations teams. The position will help ensure overall availability and reliability to meet or exceed defined service levels. If you are passionate about the customer experience, you think and act globally, and you want to contribute to the operational excellence of Amazon Data Centers, then this is be the place for you!

This position requires that the candidate selected be a US Citizen and must currently possess and maintain an active TS/SCI security clearance with Polygraph. The position further requires the candidate to opt into a commensurate clearance for each government agency for which they perform AWS work.

Key job responsibilities
- Able to properly respond, acknowledge, investigate, and dispatch critical alarms
- Monitor the facility infrastructure platform
- Perform change management tasks
- Create and issue tickets
- Follow verbal and written directions
- Have an intermediate level of understanding of critical infrastructure
- Proficient computer and communication skills
- Required shift-work, overtime, and/or rotating schedules to support a 24X7 environment (Rotating shift work equates to weekends, nights, holidays and overtime shifts)

A day in the life
The Facility Operations Center (FOC) serves as the centralized 24/7 remote monitoring center for AWS data center’s critical physical facilities infrastructure systems.

We support availability by assisting internal teams in communicating prompt and accurate alarm and event notifications.

title: Sr. Technical Program Mgr., Robotics & Innovation - AMZL
descriptionHtml:
Amazon Logistics (AMZL) is on a mission to build the most advanced last-mile delivery network in the world. Our Central Engineering – Robotics & Innovation team is at the forefront of this transformation, developing and deploying automation and robotic systems that power delivery stations across North America and beyond. Our objective is to fully automate our Delivery Stations, achieving zero-touch unit-to-recipient (UTR) operations end-to-end.
We are seeking an experienced, innovative, and customer-obsessed Technical Program Manager to drive the end-to-end lifecycle of robotics and automation programs — from early ideation and concept validation through large-scale field deployment and performance ramp-up. This is a high-impact, high-visibility role that combines strategic program leadership with deep technical engagement across robotics, mechatronics, controls, and software disciplines.
If you thrive in a fast-paced, entrepreneurial environment and want to make a measurable difference in how Amazon delivers to customers — come help us make history.


Key job responsibilities
Own end-to-end program management for robotics and automation initiatives across the AMZL delivery station network - scope, schedule, cost, risk, and performance.
Lead cross-functional teams spanning hardware engineering, software development, controls, operations, RME, process engineering, and external vendors to deliver integrated robotic solutions at scale.
Drive the full technology lifecycle: ideation to concept design to prototyping to pilot validation to GA deployment to continuous performance improvement.
Define pilot criteria, success metrics, and GO/NO-GO frameworks for new automation technologies entering the AMZL network.
Develop and maintain detailed deployment plans, including critical path scheduling, resource planning, and sequencing, validated through simulation and modeling tools.
Author business cases and strategic narratives for introducing new automation to the delivery station network; present to Director- and VP-level audiences.
Capture voice-of-the-customer directly from field operations (Ops, Maintenance, ACES, Process Engineering, Associates) and translate insights into actionable engineering and roadmap improvements.
Partner with BI and Data Engineering teams to establish KPI frameworks and performance visibility dashboards for deployed robotic systems.
Drive continuous improvement across deployment cycle time, system reliability, and operational throughput, identifying bottlenecks and delivering measurable efficiency gains.
Lead technical design reviews; propose and influence solution architectures for robotic cells, autonomous vehicles, material handling, and sortation systems.
Manage contractor and vendor relationships; ensure delivery commitments are met to quality, timeline, and cost targets.
Lead value engineering initiatives to minimize CAPEX while maintaining performance standards.
Travel 25-50% to delivery stations and partner sites across North America for field validation, deployment support, and stakeholder engagement.


A day in the life
Your day could start with a technical design review for a robotic induction system being piloted at in delivery station, shift to a vendor alignment call on a mechatronics integration timeline, and end with drafting a VP-level narrative on program status for a quarterly business review. You are the connective tissue between the engineers building the future of AMZL and the operators running it today - making sure what we invent actually works at Amazon scale, safely and reliably.
It's always Day 1.



About the team
The Robotics and Innovation team within AMZL Central Engineering develops and deploys automation solutions that drive our objective of fully automated, zero-touch unit-to-recipient (UTR) delivery-station operations, eliminating manual risk and unlocking throughput at scale. We are part of the Worldwide (WW) AMZL team, partnering closely with peer Robotics and Innovation organizations across geographies to share technology, standards, and best practices.
We are a set of diverse individuals who work coherently to solve customer problems with the most innovative solutions. We put heavy emphasis on empowering our employees to maintain work life harmony. The team works with innovative technologies in the market to bring into AMZL to solve complex technical problems. It is a fine balance between working on writing strategic business cases to understanding the deep human machine interfaces.

Basic qualifications

- Experience managing programs across cross functional teams, building processes and coordinating release schedules
- 7+ years of working directly with engineering teams experience
- Bachelor's degree
- 5+ years of technical product or program management experience
- Experience managing complex, cross-functional programs involving robotics, automation, mechatronics, or industrial hardware systems
- Experience owning/driving roadmap strategy and definition end-to-end
- Experience working directly with engineering teams (hardware, software, controls) through the full product development lifecycle
- Experience managing vendors, contractors, and external technology partners

Preferred qualifications

- 5+ years of project management disciplines including scope, schedule, budget, quality, along with risk and critical path management experience
- Experience managing projects across cross functional teams, building sustainable processes and coordinating release schedules
- Experience defining KPI's/SLA's used to drive multi-million dollar businesses and reporting to senior leadership
- Experience deploying robotics, autonomous vehicles, sortation, or industrial automation in a fulfillment, logistics, or manufacturing environment
- Experience with simulation and modeling tools (e.g., AnyLogic, SIM3D, NavisWorks, or equivalent)
- Knowledge of Six Sigma, Lean manufacturing, or equivalent continuous improvement methodologies
- Experience building business cases for technology adoption, including ROI modeling and pilot framework design
- Experience with Machine Learning, IoT, or AI-enabled automation platforms is a plus

title: Senior Manufacturing Engineer, Amazon Leo
descriptionHtml:
Amazon Leo is an initiative to increase global broadband access through a constellation of 3,236 satellites in low Earth orbit (LEO). Its mission is to bring fast, affordable broadband to unserved and underserved communities around the world. Amazon Leo will help close the digital divide by delivering fast, affordable broadband to a wide range of customers, including consumers, businesses, government agencies, and other organizations operating in places without reliable connectivity.

Export Control Requirement: Due to applicable export control laws and regulations, candidates must be a U.S. citizen or national, U.S. permanent resident (i.e., current Green Card holder), or lawfully admitted into the U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum.

We're looking for a Senior Manufacturing Engineer to Lead Optical Head Assembly production development.

As the lead Manufacturing Engineer for a Line Replaceable unit at Amazon Leo, you will be directly responsible for the production process development, introduction, improvement, & maintenance of a key module on our next generation spacecraft. You’ll be the leading technical voice for a team of manufacturing engineers working on the product, solving challenging technical problems associated with delivering an ultra-high-performing optical, electrical, and mechatronic module to space.

You will serve as a key lynchpin connection design/development, factory operations, quality engineering, program management, and more as you drive the manufacturing processes, we use from initial production introduction to full rate production. You will leverage your expertise in Manufacturing systems design to partner with development on the design of future iterations of the Optical Head Assembly and our associated production test systems & tooling.

You’ll solve complex industrial challenges associated with balancing production velocity, exceptional quality, and cost competitive production concepts while ensuring smooth technical execution of current production operations. You’ll be a key animating force in the increase in production capacity through vision & execution of capital investment for production scaling & automation.

Key job responsibilities
- Conceptualize, design, develop, and improve production processes (assembly, integration, test processes) through collaboration/leadership of a team of manufacturing engineers.
- Serve as primary technical interface to development team for Optical Head Assembly, participating as the lead technical voice from the factory in Design Reviews, key technical escalations, and new product development activities.
- Support operations team directly by being a high solving power engineer, capable of bringing multiple diverging technical perspectives together in high pressure escalation moments such as quality containments.
- Own the capacity increase roadmap for production including defining the relevant capital equipment required for rate increase and helping to lead the design, procurement, install, and qualification of new rate enabling equipment.


A day in the life
- 25% - On the shop floor, working with production teams to implement new processes, review & solve key technical blockers in production, performing production development testing, etc.
- 25% - Independent development work such as deep diving on available data sets to identify and implement key production improvement actions, acting on quality escapes by developing and implementing new quality control measures, developing & executing to existing roadmaps for capacity increase, process simplification, etc.
- 40% - Meeting settings, collaborating with others on topics such as new design introductions, production process change management, production solution finding reviews, etc.
- 10% - Mentorship settings with other engineers on the team, performing collaborative work & coaching to develop the team members skillsets, while ensuring common team execution to your technical vision

About the team
The Optical Inter-Satellite Link Production team is a multi-disciplinary organization responsible for all aspects of production of the key modules enabling satellite-to-satellite communication. The Manufacturing Engineering Team is the technical arm of this organization, with 50+ engineers from all disciplines collaborating on all aspects of technical development & execution in production. As a Lead Manufacturing Engineer, you will be the technical leader of a team of 6-10 manufacturing engineers.

- 8+ years of experience as a manufacturing engineer in discrete manufacturing
- Bachelor's degree or above in a Mechanical, Electrical, Industrial, or Aerospace engineering

- 4+ years of experience in regulated manufacturing environment (aerospace, medical devices, or pharmaceuticals)

descriptionHtml:

The Amazon Web Services Professional Services team is seeking a skilled Delivery Consultant specializing in VMware to AWS migrations. In this role you will work closely with customers to design, execute, and manage large-scale VMware estate migrations to AWS, delivering measurable business outcomes across every phase of the programme lifecycle. You will be a key player in driving customer success, providing technical expertise, migration best practices, and hands-on delivery leadership from initial assessment through production cutover.



With deep expertise in VMware environments and AWS migration services, you will lead enterprise data centre exit programmes spanning multiple countries and regulatory jurisdictions. You will assess VMware workloads through discovery tooling and application owner interviews, define migration strategies and target architectures, assign R-strategies across the portfolio, and design wave plans that respect dependency groupings, capacity constraints, and regulatory frozen zones. As a trusted advisor you will guide customers through risk mitigation, architecture decisions, and the organizational change that large-scale VMware exits require.



The AWS Professional Services organization is a global team of experts that help customers realize their desired business outcomes on AWS. We work together with customer teams and the AWS Partner Network to execute enterprise cloud computing initiatives through a collection of offerings that help customers achieve specific outcomes related to cloud adoption and migration at scale.


What Makes This Role Different

VMware estates are not just infrastructure. They are the operational core of enterprise businesses built over decades. You will not be running a lift and shift. You will be designing the path from a legacy platform to a modern, cloud-native foundation, and making that transition invisible to the business. The complexity is real, the stakes are high, and the outcomes are permanent.

Key job responsibilities
Design and implement complex, scalable, and secure AWS target architectures for VMware workload migrations, covering compute, network, storage, and virtualization layers

Lead end-to-end VMware estate assessments using discovery tooling and application owner interviews, producing portfolio disposition recommendations with R-strategy assignments across rehost, replatform, refactor, retire, retain, and relocate

Provide technical guidance and troubleshooting support throughout delivery, ensuring adherence to AWS Well-Architected principles and optimizing wave sequencing to minimize risk and business disruption

Act as a trusted advisor to customers on VMware licensing optimization, infrastructure modernization, and emerging AWS capabilities relevant to their environment

Share knowledge within the organization through mentoring, training, and creating reusable migration artifacts, runbooks, and cutover playbooks that partners can execute at scale

- Experience with the software development lifecycle and agile and iterative delivery methods

descriptionHtml:
At Amazon, we strive to be Earth’s most customer-centric company, where people can come to find and discover anything they might want to buy online. At Amazon Transportation, we are building a world-class last mile operation, significantly complimented by our brand new service, which works directly with independent contractors – called delivery partners – to make deliveries to our customers. With this new last mile delivery service (Amazon Flex), individuals can now be their own boss delivering Amazon packages. It is powered by a mobile app that works in concert with our advanced logistics systems that allows delivery partners to on board, schedule delivery times, guide them through their deliveries with in-app mapping and navigation, and more. The approach and technology are nothing short of disruptive, and promise to challenge traditional approaches, and change the way the industry operates.

We are continuing to build a high paced and lean Japan team to implement and expand our last mile capabilities across key segments of Japan Transportation business. Amazon is now looking to hire an experienced, passionate, dynamic, analytical, innovative, hands-on, and (most importantly) customer-obsessed program manager.

We are seeking a Sr. Program Manager in Japan to help establish Amazon Transportation’s last mile delivery as the preferred provider in this specific space in order to build our network of Delivery Partners to drive product utilization and service optimization within the Amazon Transportation world. Internally, this leader will work directly with functions that cut across the organization, including technology, transportation, operations and customer service, to drive a great customer experience for our program. This position will be responsible for volume planning, both short-term and long-term, for Amazon Flex.

The successful candidate will be self-motivated, passionate, highly analytical and detail-oriented, possess superior interpersonal and communication skills, and be comfortable working independently to drive growth and change in a fast-paced environment. Amazonはお客様がオンラインで購入したいと思う全ての商品を見つけることができる、地球で最も顧客中心の企業になるべく努めています。Amazon Logistics（AMZL）部門ではお客様へ商品をお届けするために、デリバリーパートナーと呼ばれる個人事業主の方々と直接契約を結ぶ新しいサービスであるAmazon Flexを活用することで、世界規模のラストマイルオペレーションを構築しようとしています。この新しいラストマイルサービスを用いてAmazonの荷物を配達することで、誰もが個人でビジネスを始めることができるようになります。Amazon Flexは、プログラムへの登録、配達スケジュールの管理、地図とナビゲーションによる効率的な配達やその他様々な機能を可能とするスマートフォンアプリによって支えられています。Amazon Flexのテクノロジーは革新に満ち、伝統的な手法へ挑戦し、ラストマイル業界そのものを変化させる可能性を秘めています。

私たちはAmazon Flexを日本のAMZL全体へ拡大するために、スピード感のある革新的な組織を日本で構築している最中です。Amazonは経験、情熱、行動力、分析力、革新、責任感、そして何よりも重要な顧客中心の考え方を持ったSr. Program Manager（Sr. PM）を募集しています。

日本におけるPMは、Amazon Flexがマーケットのサービスプロバイダーとしての地位を確立するために尽力することを期待されています。そのためにPMは、Amazon Flexの採用率向上、サービス効率改善のために必要となるデリバリーパートナーのネットワーク構築を行います。我々のプログラムに対するより良い顧客体験を実現するために、PMはラストマイルの配達を行うデリバリーステーション及びテクノロジー、トランスポーテ―ション、オペレーション、カスタマサービスなどAmazon社内の複数の他部署とともに業務に取り組みます。このポジションは、短期および長期でのAmazon Flexの物量計画に責任を持ちます。

自立の精神に富み、サービスの発展に情熱を発揮し、高度な分析力を誇り、細部への注意を怠らず、優れた対人およびコミュニケーションスキルを持ち、自律的に働くことを喜びと感じるような方は、素早く変化する環境での成長・革新をもたらす必要があるこのポジションへの理想的な応募者といえます。優れたBias for Actionはこの職務への必須要素であり、応募者は確かなる成果を生み出した実績を持っていなければなりません。

title: パートナーディベロップメントマネージャー - Technology Partnerships, AWS
descriptionHtml:
Partner Development Manager - Technology Partnerships, AWS（ISV PDM）は、日本発および海外発のテクノロジーパートナー/独立系ソフトウェアベンダー（ISV）とのパートナーシップを構築し、両社を成功に導くビジネス開発担当者です。ISV PDMは、ソフトウェア/SaaSソリューションを持つテクノロジーパートナーに対して、クラウド・コンピューティングを活用したソリューションの構築、共同マーケティングや共同販売の推進、を含むGo-to-Market（GTM）活動を推進します。共同販売には、AWS Marketplaceを活用した拡販も含みます。担当するパートナーとそのAWS上で稼働するソリューションのSubject Matter Expertとなり、パートナー戦略とValue propositionsを深く理解し、GTMプログラムの作成を支援します。
ISV PDMはCustomer Facing Role となり、担当するパートナーの経営陣やチャンピオンおよびAWSの各関係者と連携し、新たなビジネスモデルやソリューション販売について戦略的に考え、行動することが求められます。日本発のパートナーであれば海外展開、海外発のパートナーであれば、その本社Leadershipと、日本でのビジネス展開を協議・推進する機会もあるため、ビジネスレベルの英語ができることが望ましいです。本Role は People Manager ではありません。

Key job responsibilities
・担当するテクノロジーパートナーの窓口として、経営層から担当者まで幅広く信頼関係を築き、パートナーシップ全体に責任を持っていただきます。
・パートナーと一緒に、どの市場・どのお客様に向けてどう売っていくかを考え、共同の事業計画を立てて実行します。
・AWS 営業と協力して新しい商談をつくり、パートナーと AWS が一緒に提案・販売する活動を、商談の発掘から受注まで進めます。
・AWS Marketplace を通じて、パートナーの製品がより多くのお客様に購入されるよう支援します（個別の価格・条件での販売や、販売代理店を通じた販売も含みます）。
・AWS の技術担当（パートナーソリューションアーキテクト）と協力し、パートナーの製品やサービスが AWS 上でより良く動き、他社と差別化できるよう支援します。生成AI を活用した機能づくりの支援も含みます。
・パートナーや AWS 営業と商談の状況を定期的に確認し、進まない原因を見つけて、社内の専門チームと協力して素早く解決します。
・AWS 営業にパートナー製品の強みや提案先を伝え、社内でパートナーを応援してくれる仲間を増やしていきます。
・イベントやキャンペーン、お客様向け説明会などを企画・実施し、AWS のパートナー制度や資金支援も活用しながら、パートナーの成長を後押しします。
・売上や商談数、AWS Marketplace での取引額などの数字を追いかけて報告し、データをもとに取り組みを改善します。
・パートナーの声を AWS 社内に届け、課題があれば関係チームに働きかけて、パートナーとお客様にとってより良い仕組みづくりにつなげます。

title: Applied Scientist, Amazon Redshift
descriptionHtml:
Amazon Redshift is the world’s most popular fully managed cloud data warehouse. Tens of thousands of enterprise customers use Redshift to crunch through exabytes of data in the cloud to make business critical decisions every day. To stay ahead in such a mission critical setting, at Redshift, we must always re-invent ourselves for customers. We are always looking for the innovative engineers to help shape the future of Redshift.

We are looking for an Applied Scientist to build deep learning models that predict query resource consumption, enabling intelligent workload management at massive scale. Query resource prediction is at the heart of Redshift's workload management, determining how queries are scheduled, scaled, and executed across the system.

This is a unique opportunity to shape the future of intelligent query management for the world's most popular cloud data warehouse, powering analytical workloads for Fortune 500 companies, startups, and everything in between. You will bring deep expertise in one or more areas such as deep learning, graph neural networks, or reinforcement learning, with the ability to work in a fast-moving and collaborative environment to deliver broad business impact at scale.

Key job responsibilities
As an Applied Scientist on the Redshift Query Optimizer team, you will research and develop deep learning models that power resource prediction for one of the world's largest cloud data warehouses. You will take ownership of the end-to-end ML lifecycle, from problem formulation and data analysis to model training, evaluation, and production deployment. You will design novel approaches to understand queries and predict resource needs across diverse and evolving workloads. You will run experiments at scale on real production data, and collaborate closely with systems engineers to deliver low-latency inference in a highly available environment. You will publish your research at top-tier academic venues and contribute to the broader ML-for-systems community. And you will help shape the science roadmap for autonomous database operations while mentoring fellow scientists and engineers.

About the team
AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Why AWS? Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Inclusive Team Culture Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.

Mentorship & Career Growth We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Work/Life Balance We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.

Basic qualifications

- 3+ years of building models for business application experience
- PhD, or Master's degree and 4+ years of CS, CE, ML or related field experience
- Experience programming in Java, C++, Python or related language
- Experience programming with at least one modern language such as Java, C++, or C# including object-oriented design

Preferred qualifications

- Experience in state-of-the-art deep learning models architecture design and deep learning training and optimization and model pruning
- Experience in solving business problems through machine learning, data mining and statistical algorithms
- Experience in patents or publications at top-tier peer-reviewed conferences or journals

title: Program Manager, UDE
descriptionHtml:
DESCRIPTION
Amazon.com, Inc. (NASDAQ:AMZN), a Fortune 500 company based in Seattle, opened on the World Wide Web in July 1995 and today offers Earth's Biggest Selection. Amazon.com, Inc. seeks to be Earth's most customer-centric company, where customers can find and discover anything they might want to buy online, and endeavors to offer its customers the lowest possible prices. Today, we operate retail websites in nine countries, offering millions of products in more than 40 categories worldwide, and we still like to work hard, have fun and make history!

SPEG UDE Program is looking for a highly skilled and analytical Program Manager, to drive Upstream Defect Elimination (UDE) initiatives across our Selling Partner Efficiency & Growth (SPEG) organization, delivering measurable business impact through strategic defect prevention at source.

Key Responsibilities include.
1) Lead high-impact UDE projects in cost optimization and revenue generation by identifying systemic defects, influencing upstream team roadmaps, and driving cross-organizational alignment.
2) Establish comprehensive governance frameworks for UDE programs, including pipeline development, quality controls, and executive reporting mechanisms.
3) Partner with senior leaders (L6-L7) across multiple VP organizations to secure bandwidth and prioritize defect elimination over reactive fixes.
4) Drive headcount optimization goals through strategic UDE implementation, building robust pipelines that exceed targets while maintaining rigorous quality standards.

Candidate Profile:
Core Competencies:
Strategic Vision & Execution - Demonstrates ability to identify opportunities, build comprehensive pipelines, and exceed ambitious targets. Translates complex technical problems into executive-level strategic narratives that secure leadership buy-in across multiple VP organizations.
Cross-Functional Partnership - Proven track record partnering with L6-L7 leaders across multiple VP organizations to influence roadmaps without direct authority. Builds trust through data-driven insights and vendor advocacy, converting bottom-line initiatives to top-line priorities.
Program Governance Excellence - Establishes scalable frameworks including quality controls, standardized methodologies, and executive reporting mechanisms. Maintains rigorous oversight of 30+ concurrent initiatives while driving accountability through structured reviews and clear escalation paths.
Financial Acumen - Quantifies complex business impacts across COI, iGMS, VCtS, and HC savings with Data Science’s & finance validation. Secures pre-approvals and entitlement sign-offs through systematic methodology alignment with RBS Finance and Data Sciences teams.
Technical Problem-Solving - Conducts root cause analysis on systemic defects, designs upstream solutions, and drives end-to-end implementation across legacy systems. Navigates technical complexities while managing engineering dependencies and resource constraints.
Stakeholder Management - Orchestrates workshops with 10+ cross-functional teams, presents strategic documents to retail leaders, and maintains regular engagement with senior stakeholders. Translates technical details into business outcomes for executive audiences.
What makes this candidate exceptional: They combine strategic thinking with execution rigor, influence without authority, and scale solutions from marketplace-specific pilots to worldwide implementations, all while maintaining the highest quality standards and exceeding every measurable goal.

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS
3+ years of program management experience with demonstrated success managing complex, cross-organizational initiatives spanning multiple VP organizations
Proven ability to influence technical roadmaps and secure alignment from senior leaders (L6-L7) across multiple organizations without direct authority
Strong analytical and financial acumen to quantify business impact across COI, iGMS, VCtS, and HC savings metrics with finance validation
Track record of exceeding ambitious goals through strategic planning, systematic execution, and rigorous quality standards
Demonstrated capability conducting root cause analysis on systemic defects and designing upstream solutions across legacy systems
Experience managing engineering dependencies and navigating technical complexities while balancing resource constraints
Strong stakeholder management skills orchestrating workshops with 10+ cross-functional teams and presenting to L6-L7 retail leaders
Ability to translate technical details into business outcomes and strategic narratives for executive audiences

- Background in defect elimination, process optimization, or operational excellence initiatives highly valued
- Experience with SQL queries
- Project management certificate
- Lean Six Sigma certificate – GB or BB

title: Senior Manager de Seguridad y Salud
descriptionHtml:
En Amazon, necesitamos personas con talento y experiencia que nos ayuden a operar de forma segura y eficiente. Como Senior Responsable de Workplace Health and Safety (WHS), tu función es clave para impulsar mejoras estratégicas en tus centros y a nivel regional. Liderarás y desarrollarás tu equipo, definirás la agenda de seguridad y colaborarás con la alta dirección para integrar una cultura de seguridad e inclusión en tus operaciones.

Key job responsibilities
- Dirigir los equipos en el centro y colaborar transversalmente para garantizar el cumplimiento de las leyes, directrices y políticas de la empresa en materia de seguridad y salud.
- Utilizar herramientas internas de reporting para analizar datos y proporcionar a la dirección la información necesaria para tomar decisiones en materia de seguridad.
- Desarrollar, implementar y mantener programas de formación en seguridad, iniciativas de ergonomía y programas de prevención para mejorar la cultura de seguridad.
- Realizar evaluaciones de riesgos para nuevos procesos y máquinas, revisar cambios en los procesos estandarizados y actualizar las evaluaciones de riesgos existentes.
- Promover el compromiso con las medidas de seguridad y salud laboral entre la dirección y los empleados para fomentar una sólida cultura de seguridad.

A day in the life
Este es un puesto extremadamente variado, basado en uno de nuestros centros, que te permitirá contribuir directamente a numerosos aspectos de nuestra cultura de seguridad. Gestionarás los estándares de seguridad y salud mientras mejoras la funcionalidad y eficiencia. También liderarás tu equipo y les ayudarás a implementar cambios en respuesta al feedback de los empleados o a aprovechar oportunidades de mejora continua de procesos. Tu función es fundamental para garantizar la seguridad de los empleados, gestionar su satisfacción y supervisar su bienestar y productividad. Asumirás la responsabilidad de la salud y seguridad para fomentar una cultura centrada en el trabajo seguro.

About the team
El equipo de Workplace Health and Safety (WHS) desempeña un papel fundamental para garantizar el bienestar mental y físico de nuestro personal en el trabajo. Nuestro equipo trabaja con responsables, asociados y administraciones locales en todos nuestros centros, asegurando el cumplimiento de las políticas de Amazon y las normativas legales, y garantizando la seguridad de nuestros entornos de trabajo. El equipo ofrece una variedad de oportunidades, desde Técnicos de Seguridad hasta Responsables de Programas. Independientemente de tu puesto, contribuirás al desarrollo y la implementación de la estrategia de seguridad en toda la red.

Basic qualifications

- Formación universitaria y formación como técnico/a superior en prevención de riesgos laborales (Incluye las especializaciones en Seguridad en el Trabajo, Higiene Industrial y Ergonomía, y Psicosociología aplicada), de acuerdo con los reglamentos españoles en materia de salud y seguridad.
- Experiencia relevante en el cumplimiento de la legislación local en materia de salud y seguridad.
- Experiencia relevante en la gestión de equipos.
- Nivel avanzado de español e inglés intermedio (B2), tanto escrito como hablado.

Preferred qualifications

- Experiencia con metodologías Lean, 5S o Kaizen.
- Experiencia en la planificación o gestión de iniciativas medioambientales.
- Pertenencia a un organismo profesional en el ámbito de la seguridad y salud laboral.
- Experiencia en la gestión y comunicación con una amplia variedad de partes interesadas, incluyendo compañeros, colaboradores directos y dirección.

title: Sr. Associate - Quality Analyst, Global Solutions & Risk Compliance (GSRC)
descriptionHtml:
The Global Solutions and Risk Compliance (GSRC) organization is a component of Amazon's operations, dedicated to ensuring the compliance of its products and services worldwide. GSRC's core mission is to keep customers, partners, and associates safe while protecting the company from legal and regulatory risks. With a diverse global team spanning across India, China, Poland, Romania, Netherlands, Jordan, Philippines and Costa Rica, GSRC partners with its stakeholders to classify products and ensure regulatory and legal compliance for product listings. GSRC raises the bar on quality by implementing operational changes matching the everchanging regulatory space. The team designs global, consistent, and scalable solutions and prioritize a blend between technology-driven and human decision-making processes. GSRC believes that innovation thrives on diversity, fostering an inclusive and equitable culture that empowers employees with opportunities for learning and development.

Key job responsibilities
Your job responsibilities as a Sr. Compliance Associate-Quality Analyst may include:
• Performs quality audits on a daily basis using Standard Operating Procedure (SOP) and achieves self-utilization, productivity and quality as per defined targets.
• Must be able to comprehend SOPs with minimal support and identify opportunities.
• Identifies anomalies through audits (SOP defects, Process gaps etc.).
• Uses knowledge and identifies defect/s & preliminary root causes, explains the rationale
• Proposes solutions on quality/productivity and work on milestones with managers
• Expertise in research – finding specific information (eg: products, regulations etc) in a timely manner.
• Prepares key insight trends and share reports on regular basis.
• Provide feedbacks to the associates and close loop on audit observations.
• Respond to stakeholders with guidance and flags any updates to Lead/Manager

About the team
Amazon is an E-commerce and Cloud Computing company with headquarters in Seattle, Washington. Since 1995, Amazon has focused on being “the world’s most customer centric company.” Our customers are worldwide, and include not just consumers, but also our sellers and vendors (selling partners). World-class retail brands and individual sellers increase their sales and reach new customers by leveraging the power of the Amazon e-commerce platform. To meet our selling partners’ needs, our smart, diverse, customer-obsessed employees are constantly innovating and building on new ideas.
The Operational Risk Compliance (ORC) organization exists to keep our customers and partners safe, protect associates, and ensure legal and regulatory compliance. We coordinate the aspects of product transactions that are regulated (distribution, shipping, sale, and import/export). Global Solutions and Risk Compliance (GSRC) is the operational arm of the ORC organization. This involves analyzing product import documentation and flagging hazardous risks. We are also responsible for keeping Amazon customers safe and informed by coordinating actions around worldwide program teams to classify products and ensure Amazon’s product listings follow regulatory and legal compliance guidelines. These actions include removing products from the site and from our warehouses, and contacting customers with pertinent sustainability information. The ORC team partners with GSRC supports regulatory compliance requirements for Amazon’s worldwide programs such as Dangerous Goods, Chemical Safety Compliance, Global Trade Services, Transport Risk Compliance, Sustainability, Extended Producer Responsibility and Food Safety. GSRC has offices across India, China, Poland, Romania, Jordan, Philippines and Costa Rica and supports compliance related needs for worldwide Amazon marketplaces.

Basic qualifications

- Bachelor's degree
- 1+ years of logistics, transportation, supply chain, import/export operations, or data entry/data administration experience
- Knowledge of Excel at a basic level (e.g., UX navigation, math & logical functions, lookup functions, etc.)
- Speak, write, and read fluently in English
- Work 40 hours/week, and overtime as required
- Experience performing accurate data entry and analysis

Preferred qualifications

- High school or equivalent diploma
- Bachelor's degree in logistics, transporation, supply chain, or business
- Licensed customs broker
- Experience in international logistics, cross-border transportation and supply chain, or U.S. Customs rules and regulations
- Experience in customs

descriptionHtml:
Amazon Business is reimagining procurement for organizations worldwide. We help millions of customers—from small businesses and schools to hospitals, non-profits, government agencies, and large enterprises—transform their procurement with cost savings, greater productivity, and purchasing analytics. Our customers benefit from business-tailored features including Business Prime, business-only pricing, approvals workflows, purchasing system integrations, and dedicated support.

Public Sector procurement across Europe is undergoing significant digital transformation, and you will be at the forefront. We are looking for a Senior Account Executive in the German Amazon Business Government team, a self-starter who is prepared to own and execute the German Public Sector Greenfield strategy for Government entities and drive growth with our most valuable Government customers in line with Amazon Business strategic direction.

As part of our Amazon Business team, you own a portfolio of German Government customers ensuring effective executive engagement with the most complex public customers, and achieving scale through partners, marketing and public policy. You are responsible for identifying high-potential customers and making Amazon Business a key solution for their procurement needs. You are responsible for building strong customer relationships, identifying and nurturing high-value opportunities and creating multi-year growth strategies that deliver measurable results. You are also helping to identify and win public tenders and frameworks and build partnerships with think tanks and decision makers. This role requires an individual with executive presence who can speak fluently about our business and investments across Germany and suitably represent our business with customer and partner executives. This leader will build strong C-level relationships, especially with procurement leaders.

Amazon Business is a fast-paced, evolving environment and the ideal candidate thrives under ambiguity, has strong business judgement and a desire to evolve our ways of thinking whilst implementing new programs and processes. We are looking for a candidate with genuine relationship-building skills: strategic thinking, executive presence, ability to navigate complex organizations, project management capabilities, analytical mindset, and autonomy. The ideal candidate will have experience in public procurement working with Government Ministries/Authorities/Agencies/Entities and a track record of success, including implementing programs that deliver incremental value and revenue to the business.


Are you ready to shape how businesses buy and grow on Amazon? We are looking for a resourceful and customer-focused Senior Account Executive to join our Sales and Account Management team. In this role, you will own relationships with a portfolio of business customers, helping them unlock the full value of Amazon's products and services. You will drive revenue growth by identifying customer needs, crafting tailored solutions, and navigating complex sales cycles from prospecting through strategic account expansion. Your work will directly influence long-term business outcomes, and you will have the opportunity to operate both strategically and tactically — building plans that deliver results today while positioning customers for success tomorrow. If you are a self-starter who thrives in a fast-paced environment and is motivated by meaningful customer impact, we want to hear from you.

• Identify Germany's Public Sector customers’ needs, with a focus on government entities (Federal, State, and local levels), develop partnerships & solutions exceeding their expectations

• Lead cross-functional projects with internal teams (Product, Marketing, Technical Solutions) to deliver customized solutions that drive customer adoption and spend growth.
• Build long-term relationships with senior internal and external customer stakeholders including CPOs, VPs, Directors, etc.
• Expand expertise of the DE Public Sector within Amazon Business

A day in the life
Your focus in this role is helping large Government organizations transform how they manage purchasing. Much of your time will be spent with customers, engaging senior leaders across finance, procurement, operations, and technology to understand their priorities, uncover opportunities, and shape solutions that deliver meaningful business impact. You’ll balance growing strategic accounts with developing new opportunities across your territory, using your account management skills to build relationships, navigate complex organizations, and drive long-term adoption. You’ll also lead thought leadership initiatives, bringing Government leaders together through events and conversations to share ideas, challenge the status quo, and explore new ways to operate.

Our team is on a mission to transform how businesses purchase and operate by delivering solutions that save time, reduce costs, and simplify procurement. We work collaboratively across functions and geographies, and we value creative problem-solving and a genuine commitment to our customers' success. As the team continues to grow, you will play a key role in shaping our strategy and helping us reach new milestones. If you are excited about building something meaningful at Amazon, this is the place to be.

title: Product Marketing Manager — Tech, AWS Product Marketing
descriptionHtml:
Serverless is how modern applications get built. You'll own the story.

AWS Lambda processes over 15 trillion invocations per month. Lambda durable functions are redefining how developers build resilient, long-running workflows. Lambda MicroVMs are giving AI agents and multi-tenant platforms VM-level isolation with near-instant startup. EventBridge is the connective tissue of event-driven architectures everywhere. This is the most consequential application platform shift happening in cloud today, and we need a Product Marketing Manager — Tech who can own the narrative across the entire AWS Serverless portfolio.

In this role, you won't just market products. You'll shape how the world thinks about building modern applications. You'll work backwards from developers and architects to influence roadmap priorities, craft positioning that becomes the vocabulary customers use to describe their own architectures, and launch capabilities that set the pace for the industry. You'll partner directly with Product and Engineering leaders, principal engineers, and field leaders across a portfolio that includes AWS Lambda, Lambda durable functions, Lambda MicroVMs, Amazon EventBridge, AWS Step Functions, and the broader serverless ecosystem.

This is a high-visibility role with direct access to AWS leadership and a front-row seat to the platform that underpins AI-native, event-driven, and serverless-first architectures.

Why this role

- Massive scale, massive impact. Lambda alone powers trillions of invocations. The decisions you make about positioning and messaging reach millions of developers worldwide.

- AI meets serverless. Lambda MicroVMs and durable functions are at the center of how developers build agentic AI workflows, code execution sandboxes, and autonomous systems. You'll define how AWS shows up in this space.

- Direct partnership with product and engineering leaders who view marketing as a strategic function, not a downstream execution team.

- High-visibility stage including re:Invent keynotes, analyst briefings, executive customer meetings, Hacker News front-page launches.

- Ownership and autonomy. You'll own an entire product narrative end-to-end, not execute someone else's playbook.

- A team culture that rewards bold thinking, intellectual curiosity, and a bias for action.

Key job responsibilities
- Own product positioning and launches for one or more products in the AWS Serverless portfolio (Lambda, Lambda durable functions, Lambda MicroVMs, EventBridge, Step Functions). From naming and messaging through launch day execution and post-launch iteration.
- Translate complex serverless architectures into customer value. Create technical narratives, demos, and reference architectures that help builders understand when to use functions vs. workflows vs. event buses vs. MicroVMs, and how these primitives compose into production-grade systems.

- Influence product strategy by synthesizing signals from customer conversations, competitive intelligence, analyst feedback, and usage data into actionable recommendations for product teams.

- Be the product expert in the room. Represent your products in executive briefings, re:Invent stage talks, analyst interactions, and field enablement sessions.

- Drive adoption with technical audiences. Develop content strategies that reach developers, architects, and technical decision-makers through the channels they trust.

- Partner cross-functionally with product management, developer relations, solutions architecture, and sales to align on ICPs, use cases, and GTM motions.

Basic qualifications

- Bachelor's degree or equivalent in a technology field
- Experience conveying complex technical concepts to both technical and business audiences

Preferred qualifications

- MBA, or Master's degree in management, business administration, economics, engineering, marketing
- Experience developing detailed go to market plans

descriptionHtml:
Amazon's Fulfillment Channels BI team is seeking a talented, self-driven and experienced Business Intelligence Engineer to lead its advanced analytics wing for the India Self Ship business. This pivotal role gives you the opportunity to work with an exceptionally innovative team, slice and dice multi-dimensional, high-depth data mines, and build complex data models that drive data-driven insights for high-impact decisions spanning seller experience, customer delivery experience, and Self Ship Product/Program initiatives.

Are you customer obsessed, flexible, smart and analytical, strategic yet execution-focused, and passionate about e-commerce logistics? Are you an experienced, entrepreneurial leader with a strong work ethic? If yes, this opportunity will appeal to you.

To be successful in this role, you will roll up your sleeves, innovate, and quickly become a subject matter expert on Self Ship performance across sellers, carriers, and market segments in India. You will be a self-starter, comfortable with ambiguity and large data sets spanning orders, shipments, GMS, C2P (Click to Pick), C2D (Click to Delivery), and delivery experience (DEA) metrics. You will be part of the Central Analytics team, working closely with Stakeholders, Data Engineers, Business Intelligence Engineers, and Business Analysts to drive the Self Ship charter forward. Strong communication skills are essential, as you will translate data-driven findings into actionable insights for Product and Program leadership.

You will have demonstrated proficiency in SQL across a variety of databases (e.g., Athena/Presto), BI tools, and R or Python to analyze large data sets.

Key job responsibilities
Passionate about working with huge data sets and be someone who loves to bring datasets together to answer business questions. You should have deep expertise in creation and management of datasets and exposure at implementing and operating stable, scalable data flow solutions from production systems into end-user facing applications/reports. These solutions will be fault tolerant, self-healing and adaptive.
Detail-oriented and must have an aptitude for solving unstructured problems. You should work in a self-directed environment, own tasks and drive them to completion.
Excellent business and communication skills to be able to work with business owners to develop and define key business questions and to build data sets that answer those questions

Basic qualifications

- 2+ years of analyzing and interpreting data with Redshift, Oracle, NoSQL etc. experience
- Experience with data visualization using Tableau, Quicksight, or similar tools
- Experience with one or more industry analytics visualization tools (e.g. Excel, Tableau, QuickSight, MicroStrategy, PowerBI) and statistical methods (e.g. t-test, Chi-squared)
- Experience with scripting language (e.g., Python, Java, or R)
- Bachelor's degree

Preferred qualifications

- Master's degree, or Advanced technical degree
- Knowledge of data modeling and data pipeline design
- Experience with statistical analysis, co-relation analysis

title: Software Development Engineer II, Alexa Connectivity Devices
descriptionHtml:
We are building a new device software team in Bangalore to power the next generation of Amazon connected devices. As a wireless software engineer on our new Bangalore device software team, you will bring up new wireless capabilities and build new features. You will collaborate with stakeholders across Alexa Devices and Alexa Cloud teams to define roadmaps, plan requirements, make prioritization trade-offs, and feature development. You will partner with principal engineers to brainstorm solutions, solve problems, and deliver features.

Key job responsibilities
Integrate, optimize, and maintain Wi-Fi and BLE protocol stacks on device platforms

Debug and resolve wireless connectivity issues: throughput, range, coexistence, roaming

Work with antenna engineers on matching network tuning and radiation pattern optimization

Implement and test mesh networking protocols (BLE Mesh, Wi-Fi EasyMesh)

Optimize wireless power consumption through duty cycling, listen intervals, and wake patterns

Develop RF test automation scripts for production line calibration and testing

Support regulatory certification testing (FCC, CE, BIS, TELEC) for wireless subsystems

A day in the life
As a member of the team, you will serve as the technical leader for device software development and operations. You will collaborate with stakeholders across Alexa Devices and Alexa Cloud teams to define roadmaps, plan requirements, make prioritization trade-offs, and feature development. You will partner with principal engineers to brainstorm solutions, solve problems, and deliver features.


About the team
The Alexa Connected Devices team delivers low-latency, low-cost, highly reliable, and scalable connectivity between Alexa-enabled devices and the Alexa Cloud. We improve the speed and reliability of customer interactions with Alexa while simplifying the developer experience by abstracting connection management. Our services handle tens of billions of transactions daily. This is a highly visible role spanning inception, feature development, and partnering closely with tier-1 Cloud Services. The ideal candidate is passionate about Alexa and thrives delivering high-quality device capabilities in a hyper-growth environment.

Basic qualifications

- 4+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
- 2+ years of non-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
- Experience programming with at least one software programming language
- 4+ years of embedded firmware development experience
- Experience with RF lab equipment including VNA, power meters, spectrum analyzers, vector signal generators
- Integrate, optimize, and maintain Wi-Fi and BLE protocol stacks on device platforms
- Experience with BLE stack development or integration (GAP, GATT, L2CAP)
- Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, or equivalent practical experience

Preferred qualifications

- 3+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience
- Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent
- Experience in network capture and systems troubleshooting
- Experience with Wi-Fi 6/6E (802.11ax) or Wi-Fi 7 (802.11be)
- Familiarity with the Matter protocol specification and certification process
- Experience with wireless coexistence (Wi-Fi/BLE/Zigbee on shared 2.4 GHz band)
- Understanding of mesh networking: routing (RPL), network formation, self-healing
- Familiarity with wireless chip vendors: Qualcomm, MediaTek, Realtek, NXP, Silicon Labs

descriptionHtml:
Amazon Leo is Amazon’s low Earth orbit satellite network. Our mission is to deliver fast, reliable internet connectivity to customers beyond the reach of existing networks. From individual households to schools, hospitals, businesses, and government agencies, Amazon Leo will serve people and organizations operating in locations without reliable connectivity.

Are you passionate about building and operating networks at unprecedented scale? descriptionHtml:

As a Mechatronics & Robotics Technician, you will use your skills to support the Operations Maintenance team in repairing and maintaining material handling equipment and pneumatic systems throughout the building. You will have the opportunity to install, maintain, and repair automated packaging and distribution equipment. In addition to developing your skills, you will mentor junior technicians to grow in their roles.

But wait, there is more: We provide lightweight fire-resistant daily wear and composite toe safety shoes for your safety!

Here is what you can expect with the Reliability & Maintenance Engineering (RME) selection process for Mechatronics & Robotics Technicians: (Timeframe: Approximately 30-days)

Step 2: Amazon Recruiting will review your application and invite the most qualified candidate to complete a pre-employment assessment.

Step 3: If you meet the role qualifications, you will receive an invitation from Amazon Recruiting (do-not-reply@criteriacorp.com) to begin your Criteria assessment. You have 5 days to complete.

Step 4: Once you successfully meet the pre-employment assessment requirements, you will be invited to complete a video interview. Your video interview invitation will be from HireVue (interviews@hirevue.com) and you will have 7 days to record your interview.

Step 5: Your video interview will be reviewed by the Amazon Hiring Team and you will be notified of next steps via email within 5 business days.


Key job responsibilities

title: Sr. Implementation Engineer, Amazon Leo
descriptionHtml:
Amazon Leo is an initiative to launch a constellation of Low Earth Orbit satellites that will provide low-latency, high-speed broadband connectivity to unserved and underserved communities around the world.

The Role:
Be part of Amazon Leo’s sub-team responsible for defining and implementing the digital chip SOCs for communications via Low Earth Orbit satellites and Amazon gateways. This is a unique opportunity to define a groundbreaking wireless solution with few legacy constraints. The team works with customer requirements and wireless system teams to define modems, high-speed interfaces, embedded processors, and DSP solutions in latest CMOS generation technologies.

In this role you will:
• As the implementation engineer you will work with the ASIC design team to develop the chip power intent using UPF
• As the implementation lead you will work with the ASIC design team to validate UPF at RTL and netlist level using industry standard tools
• As the implementation lead you will set up the flow for both logic and physical synthesis flow for various technology nodes.
• Develop implementation methodologies while embracing AI flow.
• Work with the ASIC design and DFT teams to understand the design and create timing constraints.
• Check the RTL design for clean synthesis run, perform STA and LEC on netlist.
• Work with RFIC teams to make sure the top level integration of analog blocks are done properly and correct by construction, including formal connectivity checks.
• Work with P&R teams to ensure a smooth hand off of netlists, ensure the timely execution of the P&R responsibilities by that team.
• Participate in flow reviews of all the blocks with the P&R team to ensure that they achieve the best PPA for all blocks.
• Lead the timing sign-off for the post P&R database.
• Ensure that the chip meets the required DFM criteria by verifying the IR/EM results.

Export Control Requirement:
Due to applicable export control laws and regulations, candidates must be a U.S. citizen or national, U.S. permanent resident (i.e., current Green Card holder), or lawfully admitted into the U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum.

Basic qualifications

title: EHS Specialist
descriptionHtml:
Join Amazon’s mission to become Earth’s safest place to work! At Amazon, we’ve set the ambitious goal to become the benchmark of safety excellence across all industries in which we operate. As a Workplace Health & Safety Specialist (WHSS), you'll be at the forefront of transforming workplace safety culture at one of the world's most innovative companies. Your expertise and dedication will directly protect employees, ensuring they return home safely to their families every day. You'll facilitate new approaches to safety, combining technology with human-centered solutions to create an environment where safety and productivity thrive together. This isn't just about maintaining safety standards – it's about revolutionizing how we think about and implement workplace safety, making a lasting impact on our people and operations. As your building's designated safety champion, you'll have the unique opportunity to build relationships, influence positive change, and help write the next chapter in Amazon's commitment to becoming Earth's Safest Place to Work.

Core Impact Areas:
Safety Program Excellence & Implementation - Drive comprehensive safety programs through data-driven strategies. Lead daily safety audits, incident investigations, and risk assessments while implementing innovative solutions to prevent injuries. Deliver engaging safety training that resonates with associates and promotes a proactive safety culture. Champion continuous improvement initiatives that enhance workplace safety while maintaining operational efficiency.

Associate Advocacy & Cultural Leadership - Serve as a trusted safety advisor and advocate for associate wellbeing, building strong partnerships across all levels of the organization. Foster a culture where safety is everyone's priority through effective communication, coaching, and positive reinforcement. Develop strong relationships with frontline associates and leadership to drive behavioral changes and ensure safety best practices become natural habits. Transform safety data into compelling narratives that influence positive change and drive engagement in safety initiatives.

Additional Job Elements include:

Lift up to 49 pounds and frequently push, pull, squat, bend, and reach
Stand/walk for up to 12 hours during shifts
Work in an environment where the noise level varies
Work in an environment that is subject to variable temperatures and weather (delivery stations include outside loading departments)
Continuously climb and descend stairs (applies to sites with stairs)
Maintain effective care delivery in emergencies and assist emergency response at the site


Must be available to work flexible shifts including days, nights and/or weekends.

For those that do not have an adult First Aid, CPR, AED certification from the American Heart Association or American Red Cross, must obtain within 3 weeks of start date.

Basic qualifications

- High school or equivalent
- A minimum of 1 year in an Environmental Health & Safety (EHS) related field OR; A Bachelor’s degree in EHS-relevant background OR; 6 months experience performing in a safety-related role within Amazon
- Knowledge of OSHA regulations specifically 29 CFR 1910
- Experience using Microsoft Word and Excel in a professional capacity
- Experience maintaining confidentiality in matter involving security and/or personnel issues in the workplace

Preferred qualifications

- Bachelor’s degree or higher, preferably in a safety related field
- Strong communication, teamwork, analysis, judgment, and customer focus skills
- Experience leading and managing a team, ability to analyze accident data, new processes, and machinery for potential safety concerns, and conduct job hazard and job safety analyses
- Experience in emergency response and currently holds First Aid and CPR certificates
- Experience in workers compensation case management

The Software Defined Network (SDN) controller team is building the brain driving the Leo Network. Innovation is in our DNA and we tackle the problems presented by a dynamic network at global scale. It is our responsibility to ensure that the network works and our customer has a one-of-a-kind experience using our service.

Our team will design, implement and operate the control plane that provides a high throughput telecom service comprised of Low Earth Orbit satellites, customer terminals, gateways, Cloud services and terrestrial network infrastructure that connects into public and private networks.

Do you want to put code in space? Have you wanted an opportunity to develop the core wireless and networking for an advanced global telecom service spanning both space and terrestrial networks? Have you wondered what it takes to solve a multi-dimentional resource allocation problem at global scale?

The SDN team designs, implements and operates Leo's network control plane. This service enables a high throughput telecom service using a system of LEO satellites, customer terminals, gateways, cloud services, and terrestrial network infrastructure that connect into public and private networks.

For this role, you will:

descriptionHtml:
Join Amazon's Devices & Services Financial Planning & Analysis team and shape the financial strategy behind innovative products like Alexa, Ring, FireTV, and Kindle. We are seeking a Senior Financial Analyst to lead Variable and Non HC Fixed Opex across the Devices organization.

We seek a strategic thinker who can manage a broad portfolio of spend categories, drive AI-powered innovation in financial processes, and serve as a trusted business partner to senior stakeholders.

Key job responsibilities

Work across a team of finance professionals while championing AI adoption to automate and improve core workflows.

Serve as a trusted business partner to VP and Director-level stakeholders, translating complex financial data into strategic recommendations that inform executive reviews and drive decision-making.

A day in the life
As a Senior Financial Analyst on our Opex Financial Planning & Analysis team, you'll own the financial strategy behind some of our largest and most complex cost pools. Your day might include deep-diving into Variable Opex variances to surface insights for leadership, partnering with engineering and marketing teams to sharpen Non-HC spend forecasts, or presenting cost optimization recommendations in executive reviews that shape how we invest across Devices & Services.

Your work directly impacts how leadership understands the cost structure, efficiency levers, and investment trade-offs within our portfolio.


About the team
We are a collaborative Financial Planning & Analysis team dedicated to supporting the strategic growth of Amazon's Devices & Services organization. Our mission is to provide clear, data-driven financial insights that enable informed decision-making across our diverse product lines.

We work in a fast-paced, global environment where we partner closely with product teams, operations, and executive leadership to translate financial data into actionable business strategies. We're committed to modernizing our processes through technology and innovation, and we're excited to welcome someone who can help us leverage new tools and methodologies to enhance our impact.

Joining our team means becoming part of a group that values analytical rigor, clear communication, and a shared commitment to supporting Amazon's continued innovation in consumer devices and services.

title: Sr. Manager - Prog. Mgmt.- Profitability, RBS - SPEG UDE
descriptionHtml:
The Sr Manager - Profitability UDE leader is responsible for setting the strategy and direction of the profitability UDE programs and the role aims to deliver ~$1B combined free-cash-flow (FCF) and cost-out impact (COI) annually. Amazon’s CtS has increased by 26% since 2019 with an overall global defect entitlement of $30B, out of which the role is expected to identify, and resolve for defects ($3.2B COI entitlement over next three years) which directly impact all vendors across MPs (including T2/T3). In 2027, the role holder will primarily focus on defects eroding vendor profit margin in Amazon P&L through four primary (not limited to) charters, a) Vendor Agreements , b) Product Cost & Pricing, c) Vendor Returns; and d) Bad Actor or Vendor Abuse.
Unpacking and defining a path forward for these charters is complex, a) requires deep knowledge of business, various systems (e.g. CCOGS, VOPS, Pricing, VCS, Vendor Central) and regional compliance/legal nuances, b) the aforementioned mechanisms are legacy system/processes with often issues being endemic in nature deep rooted across multiple Org leaders, and c) complex stakeholder landscape resulting from fragmented ownership and related interdependencies. This requires the role holder to exhibit right judgement and orchestrate the decision making within 10+ upstream business and system owning matrix organizations through finding the right balance between influencing without authority, using escalation as a mechanism, driving consensus, and exhibiting ownership to drive the solutioning through tech and/or policy changes.

Key job responsibilities
This requires decision making capability on three key areas, a) Strategic Thinking, b) Business Acumen, and c) Change Management and Stakeholder Engagement.
Strategic Thinking: The incumbent must align seven VP organizations (e.g. NA/EU Retail, SPIV, SPFT, APM, AFT, SCOT) across a multitude of UDEs in an environment where none of the teams own the systems e2e. This requires independent strategic thinking to identify clear problem statements in an uncharted territory and Insistence on the Highest Standards as this involves critical risk management, and decisions affect both CX and SPX. Any proposed changes must carefully balance multiple conflicting factors including SPX, customer satisfaction, and financial impact to Amazon.
Business Acumen: The role owner needs to be able to understand ever evolving business requirements across different teams (e.g. SP management, compliance, regulations), competing nature of complex business metrics decisions (e.g. selection, speed, margins), and quantum of P&L implications of business decisions, and then define defect taxonomies for defect elimination. This involves sharp business acumen exhibiting understanding of Retail/3P business dynamics, relevant systems and displaying consistently high bar on Are Right a Lot, i) to decide when to move fast or slow down to deliver specific objectives assessing the risks and benefits; ii) understand and disambiguate trade-offs between business outcomes to improve quality of results; and iii) apply high-judgment when data is not sufficient to set course for disruptive ideas.
Change Management and Stakeholder Engagement: The role owner needs to be able to actively engage with and Earn Trust of leaders across seven VP organizations, to align priorities, influence strategies and timelines of deliveries. This involves complex stakeholder management through docs and reviews at L8+ and ability to Influence without Authority, represented in, i) optimizing cross-organizational priorities; ii) resolving conflicts via win-win outcomes; and iii) escalating timely and decisively to maximize business results.

Basic qualifications

- 7+ years of team management experience
- Experience managing P&L

Preferred qualifications

- Experience implementing repeatable processes and driving automation or standardization
- Experience communicating and presenting to senior leadership

Como técnico/a sénior de ingeniería de mantenimiento y fiabilidad, nos ayudarás a ir siempre un paso por delante, adoptando las últimas tecnologías e identificando formas nuevas y más eficientes de trabajar. Aplicar las mejores prácticas en el uso seguro de los equipos y supervisar al personal para garantizar que todos siguen los procesos correctamente.
