title: Public Relations and Communications Assistant Apprentice (24-month fixed term contract)
descriptionHtml:
Ever wondered how one of the world's most recognised brands shapes the conversations that matter? Whether you're a school leaver with a passion for communication or looking for a career change into public relations, public affairs, and corporate communications, this is your opportunity to learn the craft from the inside - at Amazon.

Amazon is looking for creative, curious individuals to join our Public Relations (PR) and Communications Assistant Apprenticeship. You'll be based in one of our corporate offices, embedded in a team that shapes how Amazon communicates with the media, policymakers, stakeholders, and the public. This is a hands-on role - you'll contribute to real campaigns, create real content, and build real relationships, all while working towards a nationally recognised qualification.

This programme is designed for natural communicators with a genuine interest in current affairs, media, and the world around them - the kind of person who reads the news and has an opinion, follows political and policy debates, and understands that how a story is told matters just as much as the story itself. Throughout your apprenticeship you'll learn to build, protect, and maintain reputation for one of the world's most dynamic brands, growing your writing voice and the confidence to contribute to campaigns that reach millions. We move fast, fail fast, and fix faster, so you'll be encouraged to bring ideas and learn by doing.

A day in the life can involve:
- Scanning the news, political, and regulatory landscape and flagging relevant coverage, policy developments, and industry stories to the team
- Drafting a media summary, updating a stakeholder briefing, or preparing talking points ahead of a meeting
- Supporting a live campaign - drafting press materials, creating social content, coordinating with journalists, or pulling together a briefing pack for a spokesperson
- Developing content for an integrated campaign across earned, owned, and social channels
- Researching audiences and stakeholders, and analysing the impact of recent coverage using monitoring tools
- On study days, working through your apprenticeship modules and building your portfolio of evidence

This could be for you if you're the person who ran the school newsletter, organised a charity event, managed a society's social media, captained a debate team, wrote to your MP, or always had a knack for getting people's attention with the right words at the right time. Or maybe you've spent a few years in another role and found yourself naturally gravitating towards communication - writing updates, coordinating events, managing stakeholders, following policy debates, or being the person everyone comes to when something needs to be said well. Great communicators aren't just born - they step up. If that sounds like you, this programme is your next step.

What you'll learn
- Over the programme, you'll develop the knowledge and skills to support PR and communications at a global scale, including:
- How to build, protect, and maintain reputation for brands, organisations, and individuals
- Media relations - understanding the media landscape, building relationships with journalists and commentators, and drafting press materials
- Public affairs awareness - the political and regulatory landscape and how it informs communications strategy
- Campaign planning and delivery - from research and strategy through to execution and evaluation across earned, owned, paid, and social channels
- Narrative and messaging development - translating complex topics into compelling, audience-appropriate content
- Stakeholder engagement - identifying, mapping, and communicating with media, policymakers, and internal colleagues
- Research and analysis - audience insights, media monitoring, and measuring and reporting campaign impact
- Professional ethics - applying codes of practice, legislation, and regulation, with a focus on inclusion and sustainability

You'll work towards the Level 4 Public Relations and Communications Assistant Apprenticeship, alignment with the Public Relations and Communications Association (PRCA) criteria for Individual Membership. As a working student, your focus is to complete your studies in your 20% off-the-job time by learning and developing the skills, knowledge, and behaviours to work towards successful graduation. You'll be set objectives and goals by your training provider and manager to support your studies.

You'll build your skills over a 24-month period, starting in September. These skills will help you develop personally and professionally. Your apprenticeship will be made up of classroom/virtual-based training to cover knowledge, on-the-job training at your Amazon base location, online learning, as well as mentoring from our experienced team members.

We value different perspectives and experiences, and we're dedicated to creating an inclusive environment where everyone can thrive. Our employee-led affinity groups – including communities for women in tech, LGBTQ+ employees, and underrepresented minorities - foster a culture of inclusion that empowers us to be proud of our differences. These groups provide community, mentorship, and a platform for your voice to be heard. We're committed to building a workforce that reflects the customers and communities we serve.

We're continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth's Best Employer. That's why you'll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship, and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Your career isn't a straight path - it's a journey you build as you go. A universe of opportunity awaits, and your next adventure starts here.

Please note: as part of your off-the-job learning, you may be required to travel to a training centre, which may differ from your primary work base. Candidates should be prepared for occasional travel as part of the programme.

Basic qualifications

- To qualify for this programme, you must:
- Be 18 years or over before the start date (September 2027)
- Have the right to live and work in England at the point of enrolment (June 2027). If you are on a visa, this must enable you to legally work and reside in England for the entire duration of the programme from enrolment.
- Have lived in the UK or in the European Economic Area (EEA) for the last 3 years prior to the start date
- Not be registered to study on a UK government funded course ending August 2027 or later
- Be prepared to travel for external/mandatory training as part of the apprenticeship
- 5 GCSEs at grade 4-9 (A-C) or above (or equivalent) including Maths and English
- 2 A Levels (or equivalent) including a minimum of grade B in an English subject and grade C or above in one other subject
- Please note, if you have received educational qualifications outside of the UK then we will require a Statement of Comparability to confirm your eligibility for the scheme. Please ensure you obtain one during the application process, through UK ENIC: https://www.enic.org.uk/
- Previous qualifications will be reviewed for funding eligibility and offers are subject to funding approval
- PLEASE NOTE: This position is a 24 month fixed-term contract. You must NOT already have a qualification in a similar subject at the same or higher level than this apprenticeship.
- This Apprenticeship assumes the candidate has some or little knowledge/experience of the occupation

Preferred qualifications

- A genuine interest in current affairs, politics, media, and how stories are told
- Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with an instinct for the right words at the right time
- Curiosity about the world around you - you follow the news and form your own opinions on it
- A creative mindset and an eye for detail
- Comfortable building relationships and working collaboratively across teams
- Familiarity with social media platforms and digital content
- A proactive, organised approach to juggling varied tasks and deadlines
- Evidence of communicating or organising something - e.g. running a newsletter, managing a society's social media, writing, debating, or coordinating an event

title: Associate Solutions Architect, AWS National Security Solutions Architecture Team
descriptionHtml:
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is seeking a Senior Solutions Architect to support our National Security Customers.

As a Solutions Architect on AWS National Security Team, you will serve as a trusted technical advisor to AWS customers in the Intelligence Community – you are the “face of Amazon” to our customers; you will engage on a broad variety of technical challenges which are not just complex, but mission-critical. This is a high visibility role where you collaborate with, and influence, both external stakeholders and internal AWS teams including sales and platform engineering. National Security Solutions Architects (SAs) are regarded as technical “thought leaders” within the Intelligence Community who evangelize emerging technologies not only on a conceptual level, but also on a practical, architectural level.

As a National Security SA, you’ll solve problems at both the business and technical levels – you'll work backwards from our customers’ requirements, envisioning new solutions and strategies we can leverage that would enable agencies to operate more efficiently and better execute on their mission objectives. You'll make the puzzle pieces fit together from the technical side and deliver the offering to the customer at scale. Frequently, you will be responsible for mission-critical solutions with National Security implications.

Often, the best way to innovate around a customer challenge is to create a new product altogether. This position offers you the unique opportunity to enhance existing AWS service features and even create entirely new tools to adapt to our customers’ requirements within the complex technical constraints of the cleared environment.

Amazon Web Services is looking for experienced and motivated technologists who align with our Leadership Principles and possess a unique balance of technical depth and strong interpersonal skills.

You will partner with customers, AWS Sales and other AWS teams to craft highly scalable, flexible and resilient cloud architectures that address Intelligence Community customer business problems and accelerate the adoption of AWS services.

In collaboration with sales, you will drive revenue growth across a broad set of customers. As a trusted customer advocate, you will help organizations understand best practices around advanced cloud-based solutions, and how to migrate existing workloads to the cloud. You will have the opportunity to help shape and execute strategies to build mindshare and broad use of AWS within the Intelligence Community.

The ideal candidate must be self-motivated with a proven track record in software/technology sales or consulting. The ability to connect technology with measurable business value is critical to a solutions architect. You should also have a demonstrated ability to think strategically about business, products, and technical challenges.

This position requires that the candidate selected be a US Citizen and must currently possess and maintain an active TS/SCI security clearance.

Key job responsibilities
• Architect cloud-based solutions in response to complex technical challenges
• In partnership with the sales team, formulate and execute a sales strategy to exceed revenue objectives through the adoption of AWS
• As a key member of the business development and sales team, ensure success in building and migrating applications, software and services on the AWS platform
• Educate customers of all sizes on the value proposition of AWS, and participate in deep architectural discussions to ensure solutions are designed for successful deployment in the cloud
• Conduct one-to-few and one-to-many training sessions to transfer knowledge to customers considering or already using AWS
• Capture and share best-practice knowledge among the AWS solutions architect community
• Author or otherwise contribute to AWS customer-facing publications such as whitepapers and other reusable content
• Build deep relationships with senior technical individuals within customers to enable them to be cloud advocates
• Act as a technical liaison between customers, service engineering teams and support

About the team
About AWS
AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Why AWS?
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Inclusive Team Culture
Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.

Mentorship & Career Growth
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Work/Life Balance
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.

Basic qualifications

- Knowledge of cloud architecture
- Experience with one of the following programming languages: Python, Ruby, Node.js, C#, or C++
- Experience with two or more of the following: networking fundamentals, security, storage or databases (relational or NoSQL), operating systems (Unix, Linux, or Windows)
- Current, active TS/SCI US Government Security Clearance

Preferred qualifications

- Experience implementing a cloud-based technology solution
- Experience in any of the following: Cloud Architecture, Systems Design, Software Development, Infrastructure Architecture, Data Engineering or DevOps

title: Engineering Operation Technician
descriptionHtml:
Join our dynamic team and become a critical guardian of technological infrastructure! As a Data Center Engineering Technician, you'll play a pivotal role in maintaining the heartbeat of mission-critical technology infrastructure, ensuring seamless operations that power global digital experiences. Your expertise will directly contribute to maintaining an extraordinary 99.999% uptime, keeping the digital world running smoothly and efficiently.

Engineering Technicians are Amazon’s front line when it comes to hands-on electrical and mechanical equipment troubleshooting. They will maintain, operate, and troubleshoot, Data Center Operation’s Mission Critical Facilities, which includes stand-by diesel generators and related fuel systems, as well as three phase electrical systems such as: switch gear, UPSs, PDUs, wet cell batteries and associated systems, CRAC, centrifugal chillers, cooling towers/water chemical system, air handlers and associated systems, pumps, & motors.
AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.
You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.
NOTE: Amazon does not sponsor for immigration, including for H-1B, TN, and other non-immigrant visas, for this role.
NOTE: Lump sum stipend will be provided to eligible candidates who relocate for this position.


Key job responsibilities

• Daily building rounds to monitor and record information from electrical, mechanical, and fire/life safety equipment to ensure 24/7 reliability and availability
• Monitor Building Management Systems (BMS) and Electrical Power Management System (EPMS)
• Assist in troubleshooting of facility and rack-level events within internal Service Level Agreements (SLA)
• Perform rack installs and rack decommissioning within internal SLA
• Perform PM, troubleshooting, root cause analysis, and repair of electrical and mechanical equipment
• Technical writing to support change management program
• Monitor daily work requests and manage to resolution, and execute projects from conception to completion
• On-site support of contractors, sub-contractors and vendors, ensuring that all work performed is in accordance with established practices, procedures & local legislation
• Work schedule changes depending on specific site needs. Shifts can be up to 12 hours and may rotate on a predefined schedule. Some locations have on-call rotations.
• Role may support more than one location/site.
Physical Requirements:
• Willingness and demonstrated ability to work in the following physical conditions with reasonable accommodations:
• Regularly lift and/or move up to 39 pounds independently
• Participate in group lifts for 40+ pounds
• Maintain balance and perform construction tasks while on a ladder
• Regularly walk, use hands and fingers, handle or feel, reach with hands and arms, stoop, kneel, crouch or crawl, climb stairs, twist, bend, work above shoulders, grasp, carry, push and pull objects into position
• Work in an environment requiring provided ear protection
This role supports data centers in various operational stages. The position may be assigned to a facility still under development, which could require travel to established locations for training until your designated site becomes fully operational.
Essential Requirements:
• Ability to travel to or commute between data center locations as needed
• Willingness to temporarily work at alternative sites during training periods or until assigned facility is operational
• Travel frequency will vary based on business needs and operational status of assigned facility
Candidates must be able to travel (over 50 miles) or commute (less than 50 miles) to active data center sites as required by business needs.


A day in the life
This role acts as Amazon’s front line when it comes to hands-on electrical and mechanical equipment preventative maintenance (PM) and troubleshooting, reporting to a site’s Data Center Facility Manager (FM). They will maintain, operate, and troubleshoot mission-critical data center facility equipment including stand-by diesel generators and related fuel systems, 3 phase electrical systems such as switchgear, UPS units, PDUs, and wet cell batteries and associated systems. Mechanical equipment includes CRAHU units, centrifugal chillers, cooling towers, water systems, air handlers and associated systems, pumps, and motors. Additional support equipment is included in the scope of the role which includes fire/life safety equipment, building automation systems, and general facilities equipment.

Basic qualifications

- 1+ years of Microsoft Office products and applications experience
- 1+ years of electrical/mechanical/industrial water experience
- Ability to work on a flexible schedule including days, nights, and/or weekends.

Preferred qualifications

- 2+ years of data center engineering experience
- Industrial-scale chiller plant operation
- Associate or higher education in related field

title: Transaction Mgr expérimenté/e, GOES EU Real Estate
descriptionHtml:
Amazon recherche un(e) Transaction Manager expérimenté(e) pour rejoindre son équipe Immobilier (Real Estate) et jouer un rôle clé dans le développement du réseau européen en France.

À ce poste, vous serez chargé(e) d’identifier des sites et de réaliser les audits préalables nécessaires afin de sécuriser des emplacements destinés à différents types d’infrastructures logistiques ainsi qu’au stockage des véhicules utilitaires électriques (EV). L’objectif est d’offrir à Amazon davantage de flexibilité et d’options, en soutenant à la fois la croissance des activités opérationnelles d’Amazon et l’adaptation à long terme du réseau existant.

Le poste implique une collaboration étroite avec les différentes équipes de l’Immobilier ainsi qu’avec les autres fonctions de l’entreprise. Vous participerez notamment à l’analyse stratégique du réseau existant afin de déterminer les solutions immobilières les plus adaptées.

Basé(e) au siège parisien d’Amazon et rattaché(e) au Head of Real Estate France, Spain & Belgium, vous serez amené(e) à voyager régulièrement en France et en Europe.

Dans le cadre de vos fonctions, vous serez responsable de la réalisation, dans les délais impartis, de nouvelles opérations immobilières couvrant notamment :

les contrats de location ;
les projets de développement Build-to-Suit (construction d’un bâtiment spécifiquement conçu pour répondre aux besoins d’Amazon) ;
les accords d’option ;
les acquisitions conditionnelles de terrains ;
les acquisitions d’investissements immobiliers ou de bâtiments existants.

Vos responsabilités comprendront notamment la coordination avec des interlocuteurs internes et externes afin de définir les besoins, les négociations commerciales et juridiques, les audits techniques (technical due diligence), l’analyse financière approfondie des opérations immobilières ainsi que les analyses d’investissement et de rentabilité, notamment les études de faisabilité financière des promoteurs et les scénarios de sortie.

Vous contribuerez également à la présentation des opérations à la direction et assurerez le pilotage des projets jusqu’à leur finalisation.

Avant tout, vous devrez être capable de gérer la complexité et l’incertitude afin de proposer des solutions immobilières stratégiques et économiquement optimisées pour répondre aux besoins d’occupation des activités opérationnelles d’Amazon.

Key job responsibilities
Gérer simultanément le portefeuille de plusieurs transactions immobilières.
Utiliser votre réseau professionnel et votre expérience pour identifier de nouvelles opportunités auprès de différents acteurs externes : courtiers immobiliers, propriétaires fonciers, organismes publics et promoteurs.
Piloter les négociations avec les propriétaires, agents immobiliers et avocats.
Disposer d’une connaissance approfondie du processus de développement immobilier, notamment en matière de regroupement et de maîtrise foncière, d’obtention des autorisations administratives nécessaires, de financement, de planification des coûts et de profil d’investissement du secteur.
Communiquer les attentes, les besoins et l’état d’avancement des transactions aux principaux partenaires internes et externes.
Assumer la responsabilité principale de l’ensemble des aspects commerciaux afin de garantir la signature et la finalisation des contrats immobiliers de manière cohérente, fiable et conforme aux objectifs et aux délais du programme.
Collaborer étroitement avec de nombreuses équipes, notamment Amazon Operations, Launch & Expansion, Network Planning, Legal, Finance, Public Policy, Pre-construction ainsi que Design & Construction, afin de mener à bien des projets à fort impact.

A day in the life
Vous collaborerez étroitement avec de nombreuses équipes, notamment Amazon Operations, Network Planning, Legal, Finance, Public Policy, Pre-construction, Design & Construction, Asset Management et Lease Administration, afin de réaliser les projets conformément aux besoins et aux priorités de l’entreprise.

Basic qualifications

- Maîtrise courante du français et de l’anglais, à l’oral comme à l’écrit, correspondant à un niveau C1 ou supérieur (nécessaire pour la rédaction de contrats et la négociation avec des parties prenantes internationales).
- Un diplôme dans le domaine de l’immobilier ou dans une discipline équivalente est privilégié.
- Expérience professionnelle significative et pertinente, démontrant une progression constante ainsi qu’un haut niveau d’expertise dans le domaine.
- Expérience significative en négociation immobilière et en gestion de transactions, idéalement dans le secteur de la logistique, en France.
- Expérience dans la gestion de projets d’investissement importants (large capital projects), avec des résultats démontrés en matière de livraison dans les délais, dans le respect du budget et des normes de sécurité en France.
- Réseau professionnel étendu en France auprès des courtiers immobiliers, promoteurs, propriétaires fonciers, organismes publics et partenaires financiers/investisseurs.
- Connaissance approfondie du droit de l’urbanisme, des projets de développement immobilier et de la maîtrise/regroupement foncier.
- Connaissance du cycle de vie des actifs physiques (biens immobiliers et bâtiments), notamment en matière d’acquisition et de cession d’actifs.
- Expérience dans la gestion et le suivi de prestataires et de ressources externes, notamment en matière de négociation de contrats et de gestion des fournisseurs.
- Expérience avérée dans la gestion de projets de grande envergure, avec une expérience du reporting auprès de multiples parties prenantes internes et externes.
- Solides compétences financières, notamment une expertise en valorisation immobilière et en analyse d’investissement.

Preferred qualifications

- Expérience dans la communication avec un large éventail d'interlocuteurs, notamment des collègues de même niveau et des membres de la direction.
- Capacité à anticiper, suivre et contrôler efficacement différentes relations avec des prestataires et ressources externes, notamment en matière de négociation de contrats et de gestion des fournisseurs.
- Bonne compréhension des moyens d’innover dans les services immobiliers afin d’optimiser la satisfaction des clients et la productivité.
- Bonne connaissance des tendances du marché immobilier, des meilleures pratiques et du marché des prestataires.
- Capacité à travailler en collaboration et à établir de solides relations avec les clients et les partenaires.
- Capacité à adopter une approche stratégique et globale des besoins immobiliers spécifiques des différentes unités opérationnelles.
- Capacité à comprendre et à évaluer les différents besoins des clients et à proposer, lorsque cela est nécessaire, des solutions et services adaptés.
- Capacité à prendre des décisions rapidement et de manière déterminée, en responsabilisant les autres et en assumant soi-même la responsabilité des tâches, des actions et des besoins de développement.
- Compréhension des principes de développement durable et ESG appliqués au développement immobilier.
- La maîtrise d’autres langues constitue un atout.

title: Senior Software Development Engineer, Robotics Perception
descriptionHtml:
Amazon is seeking exceptional talent to help develop the next generation of advanced robotics systems that will transform automation at Amazon's scale. We're building robotic systems that combine cutting-edge AI, sophisticated control systems, and advanced mechanical design to create adaptable automation solutions capable of working safely alongside humans in dynamic environments. This is a unique opportunity to shape the future of robotics and automation at an unprecedented scale, working with world-class teams pushing the boundaries of what's possible in robotic dexterous manipulation, locomotion, and human-robot interaction. This role presents an opportunity to shape the future of robotics through innovative applications of the latest software and AI tools for robots.

At Amazon we leverage advanced robotics, machine learning, and artificial intelligence to solve complex operational challenges at an unprecedented scale. Our fleet of robots operates across hundreds of facilities worldwide, working in sophisticated coordination to fulfill our mission of customer excellence.

We are building the brains of our next-generation robots - a stack that:
- Enables deployment of robots at Amazon scale
- Enables unprecedented generalization across diverse tasks
- Seamlessly integrates with large models and optimal control techniques
- Integrates with human-safe safety solutions

As a Senior Software Development Engineer on our on-robot software team, you will lead productization across perception, localization and mapping (SLAM), navigation, and spatial memory on the robot. This software tells the robot where it is and what is around it, so planning, manipulation, and safety can act. You will partner with applied scientists to turn their research prototypes into fast, reliable production components on embedded GPUs. You will set the architecture, interfaces, and engineering standards the team builds to, and decide where models run and how they share compute. You will lead designs across science and engineering teams, and build the evaluation that shows whether a change made the robot better.

Join us in building the next generation of intelligent robotics systems that will transform the future of automation and human-robot collaboration.

Key job responsibilities
- Set the technical direction for the robot's perception, SLAM, navigation, and spatial memory software, and lead the engineers who build it
- Own how well the robot perceives and navigates in real facilities, and drive the fixes when it falls short
- Work with applied science leaders to bring research from prototypes to production
- Make tradeoffs across the stack, such as what runs on the robot versus in the cloud and how models share limited compute
- Define how perception and mobility work with planning, manipulation, and safety, and create alignment across teams
- Build the evaluation strategy that shows robot performance improvements, and use it to set priorities with science and program partners
- Raise the engineering bar through design reviews, mentoring, and hiring

Basic qualifications

- 5+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
- 5+ years of programming with at least one software programming language experience
- 5+ years of leading design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
- Experience as a mentor, tech lead or leading an engineering team
- Bachelors or Master's degree, or 10+ years in CS, ME, EE or related field experience
- Experience designing and shipping perception, computer vision, SLAM, or navigation software for robots, autonomous vehicles, or other real-world systems

Preferred qualifications

- Master's degree or PhD in Robotics, Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or a related field, with a focus on computer vision, state estimation, or machine learning
- Experience leading perception, SLAM, or navigation software for robots or autonomous vehicles deployed in production
- Experience optimizing machine learning models or computer vision pipelines for real-time inference on embedded GPUs (e.g., NVIDIA Jetson, TensorRT, ONNX Runtime, CUDA)
- Experience with 3D perception and state estimation, such as stereo depth, visual, visual-inertial, or lidar odometry, SLAM and loop closure, mapping, or localization
- Experience with navigation and autonomy stacks (e.g., ROS 2, Nav2, costmaps, global and local planning)
- Experience integrating vision-language or other foundation models into robot perception or navigation, such as open-vocabulary detection and segmentation, semantic maps, or language-guided navigation
- Experience with model compression and quantization (INT8/FP8, pruning, distillation) and GPU profiling tools such as NVIDIA Nsight Systems or Nsight Compute
- Experience with multi-camera and multi-sensor pipelines (e.g., GMSL cameras, lidar, time synchronization) and serving multiple models on shared accelerators (e.g., Triton Inference Server)
- Experience deploying models across heterogeneous accelerator platforms (GPU, NPU, DSP)
- Experience building simulation-based or hardware-in-the-loop evaluation for perception, localization, or navigation
- Experience using AI coding assistants and agents to speed up development, with sound judgment about reviewing and verifying their output
- Excellent written and verbal communication, with a track record of leading technical work across science and engineering teams
